name: LeanCert.Analysis.IntegralTail.of_exponential
statement:
theorem of_exponential (f : ℝ → E) (b C a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (Ioi b)))
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Ioi b, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a*x)) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ioi b) ∧
      ‖∫ x in Ioi b, f x‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a*b) / a
proof:
:= by
  have hg := (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (neg_neg_of_pos ha) b).const_mul C
  have hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Ioi b), ‖f x‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a*x) :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)
  refine ⟨hg.mono' hf hb, ?_⟩
  have ht := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg hb
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (neg_neg_of_pos ha)] at ht
  convert ht using 1
  ring

name: LeanCert.Analysis.IntegralTail.of_gaussian
statement:
theorem of_gaussian (f : ℝ → E) (b C a : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (Ioi b)))
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Ioi b, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a*x^2)) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ioi b) ∧
      ‖∫ x in Ioi b, f x‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a*b^2) / (a*b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := of_exponential f b C (a*b) (mul_pos ha hb) hf (fun x hx => by
    apply (hbound x hx).trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := (hb.trans hx).le
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha.le (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx.le) hx0)])
  have he : -(a*b)*b = -a*b^2 := by ring
  simpa only [he] using h

name: LeanCert.Analysis.IntegralTail.remainder_eq
statement:
theorem remainder_eq (f : ℝ → E) (a b : ℝ)
    (hhead : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b) (htail : IntegrableOn f (Ioi b)) :
    (∫ x in Ioi a, f x) - (∫ x in a..b, f x) = ∫ x in Ioi b, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_interval_add_Ioi' hhead htail]
  abel

name: LeanCert.Analysis.ParametricIntegral.continuous_integral
statement:
theorem continuous_integral {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [FirstCountableTopology X]
    (F : X → α → E) (c : X → ℝ) (g : α → ℝ) (hc : Continuous c)
    (hg : Integrable g μ) (hg0 : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, 0 ≤ g a)
    (hFm : ∀ x, AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ∀ x, ‖F x a‖ ≤ c x * g a)
    (hFc : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, Continuous (fun x => F x a)) :
    Continuous (fun x => ∫ a, F x a ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro x₀
  apply continuousAt_of_dominated (bound := fun a => (c x₀+1)*g a)
    (Eventually.of_forall hFm) _ (hg.const_mul _) (hFc.mono fun _ h => h.continuousAt)
  have hn : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, c x < c x₀+1 := hc.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by linarith)
  filter_upwards [hn] with x hx
  filter_upwards [hb, hg0] with a ha hga
  exact (ha x).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx.le hga)

name: LeanCert.Analysis.ParametricIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
    (F F' : 𝕜 → α → E) (c : 𝕜 → ℝ) (g : α → ℝ) (hc : Continuous c)
    (hg : Integrable g μ) (hg0 : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, 0 ≤ g a)
    (hFm : ∀ x, AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ)
    (hF'm : ∀ x, AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x) μ)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ∀ x, ‖F' x a‖ ≤ c x * g a)
    (hd : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => F y a) (F' x a) x)
    (x₀ : 𝕜) (hi : Integrable (F x₀) μ) :
    Integrable (F' x₀) μ ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ a, F x a ∂μ) (∫ a, F' x₀ a ∂μ) x₀
proof:
:= by
  let s := {x | c x < c x₀+1}
  have hs : s ∈ 𝓝 x₀ := hc.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by linarith)
  apply hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le hs
    (Eventually.of_forall hFm) hi (hF'm x₀) _ (hg.const_mul (c x₀+1))
    (hd.mono fun _ h x _ => h x)
  filter_upwards [hb, hg0] with a ha hga
  intro x hx
  exact (ha x).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hx) hga)

name: LeanCert.Analysis.pow_mul_exp_neg_le
statement:
theorem pow_mul_exp_neg_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (m : ℕ) :
    x^m * Real.exp (-x) ≤ (2^m * (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-x/2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (x/2) (show 0 ≤ x/2 by positivity) m
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < m.factorial := by positivity
  have hp : x^m ≤ (2^m * (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp (x/2) := by
    have h' := (div_le_iff₀ hf).mp h
    have h'' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h' (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2^m by positivity)
    simpa [div_pow, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (show (0 : ℝ) < 2^m by positivity)),
      mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h''
  have he : Real.exp (x/2) * Real.exp (-x) = Real.exp (-x/2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  simpa only [mul_assoc, he] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (Real.exp_pos (-x)).le

name: LeanCert.Analysis.SeriesTail.of_majorant
statement:
theorem of_majorant (f : ℕ → E) (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hg : Summable g) (hbound : ∀ k, ‖f (k + N)‖ ≤ g k) :
    Summable f ∧ ‖(∑' n, f n) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ ≤ ∑' k, g k
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Summable (fun k => f (k + N)) := hg.of_norm_bounded hbound
  have hf : Summable f := (summable_nat_add_iff N).mp ht
  refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
  have he := hf.sum_add_tsum_nat_add N
  have hrem : (∑' n, f n) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n = ∑' k, f (k + N) := by
    rw [← he]
    abel
  rw [hrem]
  exact tsum_of_norm_bounded hg.hasSum hbound

name: LeanCert.Analysis.SeriesTail.of_geometric
statement:
theorem of_geometric (f : ℕ → E) (N : ℕ) (A r : ℝ)
    (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hbound : ∀ k, ‖f (k + N)‖ ≤ A * r ^ k) :
    Summable f ∧ ‖(∑' n, f n) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ ≤ A / (1-r)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).mul_left A
  have h := of_majorant f N _ hg hbound
  simpa only [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1, div_eq_mul_inv] using h

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
    {num den num' den' : ℝ → ℝ} {w b lo hi : ℝ}
    (hnum0 : num w = 0) (hden0 : den w = 0)
    (hnumc : ContinuousOn num (Icc w b))
    (hdenc : ContinuousOn den (Icc w b))
    (hnumd : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, HasDerivAt num (num' x) x)
    (hdend : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, HasDerivAt den (den' x) x)
    (hden'pos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < den' x)
    (hlo : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, lo * den' x ≤ num' x)
    (hhi : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, num' x ≤ hi * den' x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo w b) :
    num t / den t ∈ Icc lo hi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hwt, htb⟩ := ht
  have hIccSub : Icc w t ⊆ Icc w b := Icc_subset_Icc_right htb.le
  have hIooSub : Ioo w t ⊆ Ioo w b := Ioo_subset_Ioo_right htb.le
  
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀mem, hc₀⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope den den' hwt
    (hdenc.mono hIccSub) (fun x hx => hdend x (hIooSub hx))
  have hdent_pos : 0 < den t := by
    have hd'c₀ := hden'pos c₀ (hIooSub hc₀mem)
    have htw : (0 : ℝ) < t - w := by linarith
    have hEq : den t - den w = den' c₀ * (t - w) := by
      rw [hc₀]
      field_simp
    have hpos : 0 < den' c₀ * (t - w) := mul_pos hd'c₀ htw
    rw [← hEq, hden0] at hpos
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨c, hcmem, hc⟩ := exists_ratio_hasDerivAt_eq_ratio_slope num num' hwt
    (hnumc.mono hIccSub) (fun x hx => hnumd x (hIooSub hx))
    den den' (hdenc.mono hIccSub) (fun x hx => hdend x (hIooSub hx))
  rw [hnum0, hden0, sub_zero, sub_zero] at hc
  
  have hcb := hIooSub hcmem
  have hd'c := hden'pos c hcb
  constructor
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hdent_pos]
    have h1 : lo * den' c ≤ num' c := hlo c hcb
    have h2 : lo * den' c * den t ≤ num' c * den t :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hdent_pos.le
    have h3 : (lo * den t) * den' c ≤ num t * den' c := by nlinarith [hc]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hd'c
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hdent_pos]
    have h1 : num' c ≤ hi * den' c := hhi c hcb
    have h2 : num' c * den t ≤ hi * den' c * den t :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hdent_pos.le
    have h3 : num t * den' c ≤ (hi * den t) * den' c := by nlinarith [hc]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hd'c

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.expm1_div_self_mem
statement:
theorem expm1_div_self_mem {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (Real.exp t - 1) / t ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) (Real.exp 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
    (num := fun x => Real.exp x - 1) (den := fun x => x)
    (num' := fun x => Real.exp x) (den' := fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    (w := 0) (b := 1) (lo := 1) (hi := Real.exp 1)
    (by simp) rfl
    ((Real.continuous_exp.sub continuous_const).continuousOn)
    (continuous_id.continuousOn)
    (fun x _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).sub_const 1)
    (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_id x)
    (fun _ _ => one_pos)
    (fun x hx => by simpa using Real.one_le_exp hx.1.le)
    (fun x hx => by simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx.2.le)
    ht
  simpa using h

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds_left
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds_left
    {num den num' den' : ℝ → ℝ} {a w lo hi : ℝ}
    (hnum0 : num w = 0) (hden0 : den w = 0)
    (hnumc : ContinuousOn num (Icc a w))
    (hdenc : ContinuousOn den (Icc a w))
    (hnumd : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a w, HasDerivAt num (num' x) x)
    (hdend : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a w, HasDerivAt den (den' x) x)
    (hden'pos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a w, 0 < den' x)
    (hlo : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a w, lo * den' x ≤ num' x)
    (hhi : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a w, num' x ≤ hi * den' x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo a w) :
    num t / den t ∈ Icc lo hi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hat, htw⟩ := ht
  have hIccSub : Icc t w ⊆ Icc a w := Icc_subset_Icc_left hat.le
  have hIooSub : Ioo t w ⊆ Ioo a w := Ioo_subset_Ioo_left hat.le
  
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀mem, hc₀⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope den den' htw
    (hdenc.mono hIccSub) (fun x hx => hdend x (hIooSub hx))
  have hdent_neg : den t < 0 := by
    have hd := hden'pos c₀ (hIooSub hc₀mem)
    have htw' : (0 : ℝ) < w - t := by linarith
    have hEq : den w - den t = den' c₀ * (w - t) := by
      rw [hc₀]
      field_simp
    have hpos := mul_pos hd htw'
    rw [← hEq, hden0] at hpos
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨c, hcmem, hc⟩ := exists_ratio_hasDerivAt_eq_ratio_slope num num' htw
    (hnumc.mono hIccSub) (fun x hx => hnumd x (hIooSub hx))
    den den' (hdenc.mono hIccSub) (fun x hx => hdend x (hIooSub hx))
  rw [hnum0, hden0, zero_sub, zero_sub, neg_mul, neg_mul, neg_inj] at hc
  
  have hcb := hIooSub hcmem
  have hd'c := hden'pos c hcb
  have hquot : num t / den t = num' c / den' c := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hdent_neg.ne hd'c.ne']
    calc num t * den' c = den t * num' c := hc.symm
      _ = num' c * den t := mul_comm _ _
  rw [hquot]
  exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hd'c).mpr (hlo c hcb), (div_le_iff₀ hd'c).mpr (hhi c hcb)⟩

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds_two_sided
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds_two_sided
    {num den num' den' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b w lo hi : ℝ} (hw : w ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hnum0 : num w = 0) (hden0 : den w = 0)
    (hnumc : ContinuousOn num (Icc a b))
    (hdenc : ContinuousOn den (Icc a b))
    (hnumd : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt num (num' x) x)
    (hdend : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt den (den' x) x)
    (hden'pos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, x ≠ w → 0 < den' x)
    (hlo : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, x ≠ w → lo * den' x ≤ num' x)
    (hhi : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, x ≠ w → num' x ≤ hi * den' x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo a b) (htw : t ≠ w) :
    num t / den t ∈ Icc lo hi
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne htw with h | h
  · 
    have hsubI : Icc a w ⊆ Icc a b := Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2.le
    have hsubO : Ioo a w ⊆ Ioo a b := Ioo_subset_Ioo_right hw.2.le
    have hne : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a w, x ≠ w := fun x hx => hx.2.ne
    exact quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds_left hnum0 hden0
      (hnumc.mono hsubI) (hdenc.mono hsubI)
      (fun x hx => hnumd x (hsubO hx)) (fun x hx => hdend x (hsubO hx))
      (fun x hx => hden'pos x (hsubO hx) (hne x hx))
      (fun x hx => hlo x (hsubO hx) (hne x hx))
      (fun x hx => hhi x (hsubO hx) (hne x hx))
      ⟨ht.1, h⟩
  · 
    have hsubI : Icc w b ⊆ Icc a b := Icc_subset_Icc_left hw.1.le
    have hsubO : Ioo w b ⊆ Ioo a b := Ioo_subset_Ioo_left hw.1.le
    have hne : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, x ≠ w := fun x hx => hx.1.ne'
    exact quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds hnum0 hden0
      (hnumc.mono hsubI) (hdenc.mono hsubI)
      (fun x hx => hnumd x (hsubO hx)) (fun x hx => hdend x (hsubO hx))
      (fun x hx => hden'pos x (hsubO hx) (hne x hx))
      (fun x hx => hlo x (hsubO hx) (hne x hx))
      (fun x hx => hhi x (hsubO hx) (hne x hx))
      ⟨h, ht.2⟩

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.DerivLadder.pos_of_top
statement:
theorem pos_of_top (k : ℕ) : ∀ (w b : ℝ) (L : DerivLadder k w b),
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < L.f k x) →
    ∀ i ≤ k, ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < L.f i x
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro w b L htop i hi x hx
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hi
    exact htop x hx
  | succ k ih =>
    intro w b L htop i hi x hx
    cases i with
    | succ j => exact ih w b L.tail htop j (by omega) x hx
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨hwx, hxb⟩ := hx
      have hcont : ContinuousOn (L.f 0) (Icc w x) :=
        (L.cont 0 (by omega)).mono (Icc_subset_Icc_right hxb.le)
      have hderiv : ∀ y ∈ Ioo w x, HasDerivAt (L.f 0) (L.f 1 y) y :=
        fun y hy => L.deriv 0 (by omega) y (Ioo_subset_Ioo_right hxb.le hy)
      obtain ⟨c, hcmem, hc⟩ :=
        exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (L.f 0) (L.f 1) hwx hcont hderiv
      have hpos1 : 0 < L.f 1 c :=
        ih w b L.tail htop 0 (Nat.zero_le k) c (Ioo_subset_Ioo_right hxb.le hcmem)
      have htw : (0 : ℝ) < x - w := by linarith
      have hEq : L.f 0 x - L.f 0 w = L.f 1 c * (x - w) := by
        rw [hc]
        field_simp
      have hpos := mul_pos hpos1 htw
      rw [← hEq, L.zero 0 (by omega)] at hpos
      linarith

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.quotient_mem_of_derivLadder
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_of_derivLadder {w b lo hi : ℝ} :
    ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ∀ (N D : DerivLadder k w b),
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < D.f k x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, lo * D.f k x ≤ N.f k x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, N.f k x ≤ hi * D.f k x) →
    ∀ t ∈ Ioo w b, N.f 0 t / D.f 0 t ∈ Icc lo hi
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro _ N D hpos hlo hhi t ht
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · 
      exact quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
        (N.zero 0 (by omega)) (D.zero 0 (by omega))
        (N.cont 0 (by omega)) (D.cont 0 (by omega))
        (N.deriv 0 (by omega)) (D.deriv 0 (by omega))
        hpos hlo hhi ht
    · 
      
      have hDpos1 : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < D.f 1 x := fun x hx =>
        DerivLadder.pos_of_top (k + 1) w b D hpos 1 (by omega) x hx
      have hq : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, N.tail.f 0 x / D.tail.f 0 x ∈ Icc lo hi :=
        fun x hx => ih hk N.tail D.tail hpos hlo hhi x hx
      have hlo1 : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, lo * D.f 1 x ≤ N.f 1 x := by
        intro x hx
        have h : lo ≤ N.f 1 x / D.f 1 x := (hq x hx).1
        have hp := hDpos1 x hx
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hp] at h
        exact h
      have hhi1 : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, N.f 1 x ≤ hi * D.f 1 x := by
        intro x hx
        have h : N.f 1 x / D.f 1 x ≤ hi := (hq x hx).2
        have hp := hDpos1 x hx
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hp] at h
        exact h
      exact quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
        (N.zero 0 (by omega)) (D.zero 0 (by omega))
        (N.cont 0 (by omega)) (D.cont 0 (by omega))
        (N.deriv 0 (by omega)) (D.deriv 0 (by omega))
        hDpos1 hlo1 hhi1 ht

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.expm1_sub_self_div_sq_mem
statement:
theorem expm1_sub_self_div_sq_mem {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (Real.exp t - t - 1) / t ^ 2 ∈ Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) (Real.exp 1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quotient_mem_of_derivLadder 2 (by omega) expm1SubLadder sqLadder
    (fun x _ => by
      show (0 : ℝ) < 2
      norm_num)
    (fun x hx => by
      show 1 / 2 * (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp x
      have := Real.one_le_exp hx.1.le
      linarith)
    (fun x hx => by
      show Real.exp x ≤ Real.exp 1 / 2 * 2
      have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx.2.le
      linarith)
    t ht
  exact h

name: LeanCert.ConstantFactory.continuous_qProd
statement:
private theorem continuous_qProd (S : Finset Nat) :
    Continuous fun u : ℝ => qProd S u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on S ?empty ?insert
  · simpa [qProd] using (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
  · intro n S hn hS
    have hfactor : Continuous fun u : ℝ => 1 - u ^ n :=
      continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.pow n)
    simpa [qProd, Finset.prod_insert hn] using! hfactor.mul hS

name: LeanCert.ConstantFactory.qProd_union_eq_observer_sum
statement:
theorem qProd_union_eq_observer_sum (R Q : Finset Nat) (hdisj : Disjoint R Q)
    (u : ℝ) :
    qProd (R ∪ Q) u =
      ∑ A ∈ Q.powerset,
        (subsetSign A : ℝ) * (qProd R u * u ^ subsetWeight A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [qProd, Finset.prod_union hdisj]
  change qProd R u * qProd Q u =
    ∑ A ∈ Q.powerset,
      (subsetSign A : ℝ) * (qProd R u * u ^ subsetWeight A)
  rw [qProd_powerset_expand Q u]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A hA
  ring

name: LeanCert.ConstantFactory.F_union_eq_observerIntegral
statement:
theorem F_union_eq_observerIntegral (R Q : Finset Nat) (hdisj : Disjoint R Q) :
    F (R ∪ Q) = observerIntegral R Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold F observerIntegral moment
  simp_rw [qProd_union_eq_observer_sum R Q hdisj]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  · intro A hA
    have hcont :
        Continuous fun u : ℝ =>
          (subsetSign A : ℝ) * (qProd R u * u ^ subsetWeight A) :=
      continuous_const.mul
        ((continuous_qProd R).mul (continuous_id.pow (subsetWeight A)))
    exact hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1

name: Real.abs_sin_sub_self_le
statement: theorem abs_sin_sub_self_le (x : ℝ) (_hx : |x| ≤ 1) : |sin x - x| ≤ |x| ^ 3 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt x 0 with hx_neg | hx_pos
  · 
    have hx' : 0 ≤ -x := neg_nonneg.mpr hx_neg
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx' with hx_zero | hx_pos'
    · 
      have : x = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp hx_zero.symm
      simp [this]
    · 
      have h1 : sin (-x) < -x := sin_lt hx_pos'
      have h2six : -x - (-x) ^ 3 / 6 < sin (-x) := sin_gt_sub_cube hx_pos'
      have h2 : -x - (-x) ^ 3 / 4 < sin (-x) := by
        have hcubed : 0 < (-x) ^ 3 := pow_pos hx_pos' _
        linarith
      
      
      
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hx_neg]
      have hsinx : sin x = -sin (-x) := by simp [sin_neg]
      rw [hsinx]
      have hsum_pos : 0 < -sin (-x) - x := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_pos hsum_pos]
      
      
      
      linarith
  · 
    have h1 : sin x < x := sin_lt hx_pos
    have h2six : x - x ^ 3 / 6 < sin x := sin_gt_sub_cube hx_pos
    have h2 : x - x ^ 3 / 4 < sin x := by
      have hcubed : 0 < x ^ 3 := pow_pos hx_pos _
      linarith
    rw [abs_of_pos hx_pos]
    have hsub_pos : 0 < x - sin x := by linarith
    rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith : sin x - x < 0)]
    linarith

name: Real.hasDerivAt_sinc_zero
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_sinc_zero : HasDerivAt sinc 0 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope]
  
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  use min 1 (ε * 4)
  constructor
  · positivity
  intro y hy_ne hy_dist
  simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, sinc_zero, smul_eq_mul, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] at *
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · exact absurd hy hy_ne
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy_dist ⊢
  rw [abs_mul, abs_inv]
  rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hy, div_sub_one hy, abs_div]
  
  
  have hy_le_1 : |y| ≤ 1 := (lt_min_iff.mp hy_dist).1.le
  have hy_abs_pos : 0 < |y| := abs_pos.mpr hy
  have hy_sq_pos : 0 < |y| ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hy_abs_pos
  
  have hbound : |sin y - y| ≤ |y| ^ 3 / 4 := abs_sin_sub_self_le y hy_le_1
  
  calc |y|⁻¹ * (|sin y - y| / |y|)
      = |sin y - y| / |y| ^ 2 := by rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_div, sq]
    _ ≤ (|y| ^ 3 / 4) / |y| ^ 2 := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound
        exact hy_sq_pos.le
    _ = |y| / 4 := by
        have hy_ne : |y| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy_abs_pos
        have hsq : y ^ 2 = |y| ^ 2 := (sq_abs y).symm
        field_simp [hy_ne]
    _ < ε := by
        have h_eps : |y| < ε * 4 := (lt_min_iff.mp hy_dist).2
        linarith

name: Real.differentiableAt_sinc_zero
statement: theorem differentiableAt_sinc_zero : DifferentiableAt ℝ sinc 0
proof:
:=
  hasDerivAt_sinc_zero.differentiableAt

name: Real.differentiableAt_sinc
statement: theorem differentiableAt_sinc (x : ℝ) : DifferentiableAt ℝ sinc x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · exact hx ▸ differentiableAt_sinc_zero
  · rw [sinc_eq_dslope, differentiableAt_dslope_of_ne hx]
    exact differentiable_sin.differentiableAt

name: Real.differentiable_sinc
statement: theorem differentiable_sinc : Differentiable ℝ sinc
proof: := fun x => differentiableAt_sinc x

name: Real.sinc_eq_integral_cos
statement:
theorem sinc_eq_integral_cos (x : ℝ) :
    sinc x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, cos (x * t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst hx
    simp [sinc_zero]
  · have hcomp :
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, cos (x * t) = x⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, cos u := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using
        (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right
          (f := fun u : ℝ => cos u) (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (c := x) hx)
    rw [hcomp, integral_cos, sin_zero, sub_zero, inv_mul_eq_div, sinc_of_ne_zero hx]

name: Real.hasDerivAt_sinc_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sinc_of_ne_zero (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt sinc ((x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2) x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt sin (cos x) x := hasDerivAt_sin x
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => y) 1 x := hasDerivAt_id x
  have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun y => sin y / y) ((cos x * x - sin x * 1) / x ^ 2) x :=
    h1.div h2 hx
  simp only [mul_one] at h3
  have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun y => sin y / y) ((x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2) x := by
    convert h3 using 1; ring
  
  have heq : sinc =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => sin y / y) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ne_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact sinc_of_ne_zero hy
  exact h4.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: Real.deriv_sinc
statement: theorem deriv_sinc : deriv sinc x = if x = 0 then 0 else (x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hx
  · exact hx ▸ hasDerivAt_sinc_zero.deriv
  · exact (hasDerivAt_sinc_of_ne_zero hx).deriv

name: Real.deriv_sinc_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deriv_sinc_zero : deriv sinc 0 = 0
proof: := hasDerivAt_sinc_zero.deriv

name: Real.abs_x_mul_cos_sub_sin_le_sq
statement: theorem abs_x_mul_cos_sub_sin_le_sq (x : ℝ) : |x * cos x - sin x| ≤ x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x ≥ 0, |x * cos x - sin x| ≤ x ^ 2 by
    obtain h | h := le_total 0 x
    · exact this x h
    · rw [← abs_neg, ← neg_sq x]
      convert this (-x) (neg_nonneg.mpr h) using 2
      ring_nf
      simp only [cos_neg, sin_neg]
      ring
  intro x hx
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · 
    
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t * cos t - sin t + t^2
    have hg_diff : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g (t * (2 - sin t)) t := fun t => by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * cos t) (1 * cos t + t * (-sin t)) t :=
        hasDerivAt_id t |>.mul (hasDerivAt_cos t)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * cos t - sin t) (1 * cos t + t * (-sin t) - cos t) t :=
        h1.sub (hasDerivAt_sin t)
      have hpow : HasDerivAt (fun t => t^2) (2 * t) t := by
        have := hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
        simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.add_one_sub_one, pow_one] at this
        exact this
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * cos t - sin t + t^2)
          (1 * cos t + t * (-sin t) - cos t + 2 * t) t :=
        h2.add hpow
      convert h3 using 1
      ring
    have hg_cont : Continuous g :=
      (continuous_id.mul continuous_cos).sub continuous_sin |>.add (continuous_pow 2)
    have hg_diffble : Differentiable ℝ g := fun t => (hg_diff t).differentiableAt
    have hg' : ∀ t, deriv g t = t * (2 - sin t) := fun t => (hg_diff t).deriv
    have hg_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ interior (Set.Ici (0:ℝ)), 0 ≤ deriv g t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ici] at ht
      rw [hg' t]
      apply mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Set.mem_Ioi.mp ht))
      linarith [sin_le_one t]
    have g_nonneg : 0 ≤ g x := by
      have hmono := monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici 0) hg_cont.continuousOn
        hg_diffble.differentiableOn hg_nonneg
      have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by simp [g]
      calc 0 = g 0 := hg0.symm
        _ ≤ g x := hmono (by simp : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici 0) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hx) hx
    linarith [g_nonneg]
  · 
    
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t^2 - (t * cos t - sin t)
    have hg_diff : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g (t * (2 + sin t)) t := fun t => by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * cos t) (1 * cos t + t * (-sin t)) t :=
        hasDerivAt_id t |>.mul (hasDerivAt_cos t)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * cos t - sin t) (1 * cos t + t * (-sin t) - cos t) t :=
        h1.sub (hasDerivAt_sin t)
      have hpow : HasDerivAt (fun t => t^2) (2 * t) t := by
        have := hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
        simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.add_one_sub_one, pow_one] at this
        exact this
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t^2 - (t * cos t - sin t))
          (2 * t - (1 * cos t + t * (-sin t) - cos t)) t :=
        hpow.sub h2
      convert h3 using 1
      ring
    have hg_cont : Continuous g :=
      (continuous_pow 2).sub ((continuous_id.mul continuous_cos).sub continuous_sin)
    have hg_diffble : Differentiable ℝ g := fun t => (hg_diff t).differentiableAt
    have hg' : ∀ t, deriv g t = t * (2 + sin t) := fun t => (hg_diff t).deriv
    have hg_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ interior (Set.Ici (0:ℝ)), 0 ≤ deriv g t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [interior_Ici] at ht
      rw [hg' t]
      apply mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Set.mem_Ioi.mp ht))
      linarith [neg_one_le_sin t]
    have g_nonneg : 0 ≤ g x := by
      have hmono := monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici 0) hg_cont.continuousOn
        hg_diffble.differentiableOn hg_nonneg
      have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by simp [g]
      calc 0 = g 0 := hg0.symm
        _ ≤ g x := hmono (by simp : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici 0) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hx) hx
    linarith [g_nonneg]

name: Real.abs_deriv_sinc_le_one
statement: theorem abs_deriv_sinc_le_one (x : ℝ) : |deriv sinc x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · rw [(hasDerivAt_sinc_of_ne_zero hx).deriv]
    rw [abs_div]
    have hx_sq : x ^ 2 > 0 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx
    have habs_sq : |x ^ 2| = x ^ 2 := abs_of_pos hx_sq
    rw [habs_sq, div_le_one hx_sq]
    exact abs_x_mul_cos_sub_sin_le_sq x

name: Real.deriv_sinc_mem_Icc
statement: theorem deriv_sinc_mem_Icc (x : ℝ) : deriv sinc x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.mem_Icc]
  have h := abs_deriv_sinc_le_one x
  rw [abs_le] at h
  exact h

name: Real.sinc_eq_integral
statement: theorem sinc_eq_integral (x : ℝ) : sinc x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, cos (t * x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · 
    simp only [sinc_zero, mul_zero, cos_zero]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · 
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t => cos (t * x)) := continuous_cos.comp (continuous_mul_const x)
    have hderiv : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun u => sin (u * x) / x) (cos (t * x)) t := by
      intro t
      have : HasDerivAt (fun u => sin (u * x)) (x * cos (t * x)) t := by
        have := Real.hasDerivAt_sin (t * x)
        convert! HasDerivAt.comp t this (hasDerivAt_mul_const x) using 1
        ring
      convert! this.div_const x using 1
      field_simp
    
    have hcont_anti : ContinuousOn (fun t => sin (t * x) / x) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
      (continuous_sin.comp (continuous_mul_const x)).continuousOn.div_const x
    
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => cos (t * x)) volume 0 1 :=
      hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
    rw [integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        hcont_anti (fun t _ => hderiv t) hint]
    simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, sin_zero, zero_div, sub_zero]
    rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hx]

name: Real.deriv_sinc_eq_dslope
statement: theorem deriv_sinc_eq_dslope : deriv sinc = dslope (cos - sinc) 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · 
    simp only [hx, dslope_same, deriv_sinc_zero]
    simp only [deriv_sub, differentiableAt_cos, differentiableAt_sinc_zero, deriv_cos, sin_zero,
      deriv_sinc_zero, sub_zero, neg_zero]
  · 
    rw [dslope_of_ne _ hx, slope, vsub_eq_sub]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, cos_zero, sinc_zero, sub_self, sub_zero]
    rw [(hasDerivAt_sinc_of_ne_zero hx).deriv]
    rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hx, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp

name: Real.contDiffAt_sinc_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem contDiffAt_sinc_of_ne_zero {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ sinc x
proof:
:= by
  have heq : sinc =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => sin y / y := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ne_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact sinc_of_ne_zero hy
  exact (contDiff_sin.contDiffAt.div contDiff_id.contDiffAt hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: Real.analyticAt_sinc_zero
statement: theorem analyticAt_sinc_zero : AnalyticAt ℝ sinc 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsin_an : AnalyticAt ℝ sin 0 := analyticAt_sin
  
  have horder_ne_zero : analyticOrderAt sin (0 : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    hsin_an.analyticOrderAt_ne_zero.mpr sin_zero
  
  have horder : (1 : ℕ) ≤ analyticOrderAt sin (0 : ℝ) := Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr horder_ne_zero
  rw [natCast_le_analyticOrderAt hsin_an] at horder
  simp only [pow_one, sub_zero] at horder
  obtain ⟨g, hg_an, hg_eq⟩ := horder
  
  have hg_eq_sinc : g =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] 0] sinc := by
    filter_upwards [hg_eq.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
                    self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hsin_eq hz
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hsin_eq
    have hz' : z ≠ 0 := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hz
    rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hz']
    field_simp [hz']
    linarith [hsin_eq]
  
  
  have hg_zero : g 0 = sinc 0 := by
    have hg_cont : ContinuousAt g 0 := hg_an.continuousAt
    have hsinc_cont : ContinuousAt sinc 0 := continuous_sinc.continuousAt
    
    
    have h : Tendsto g (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (sinc 0)) := by
      have := hsinc_cont.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := {0}ᶜ))
      exact this.congr' hg_eq_sinc.symm
    have h2 : Tendsto g (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (g 0)) :=
      hg_cont.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := {0}ᶜ))
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h2 h
  
  exact hg_an.congr (hg_eq.mono fun z hsin_eq => by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hsin_eq
    by_cases hz : z = 0
    · simp [hz, hg_zero]
    · rw [sinc_of_ne_zero hz]
      field_simp [hz]
      linarith [hsin_eq])

name: Real.analyticAt_sinc
statement: theorem analyticAt_sinc (x : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ sinc x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · exact hx ▸ analyticAt_sinc_zero
  · exact contDiffAt_sinc_of_ne_zero hx |>.analyticAt

name: Real.contDiff_sinc
statement: theorem contDiff_sinc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ sinc
proof:
:=
  AnalyticOnNhd.contDiff (fun x _ => analyticAt_sinc x)

name: Real.analyticOnNhd_sinc
statement: theorem analyticOnNhd_sinc : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ sinc Set.univ

name: LeanCert.Core.CertifiedCellDomain.refineLevel_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem refineLevel_zero (cell : Cell) :
    refineLevel (Point := Point) 0 cell = [cell]
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.CertifiedCellDomain.refineLevel_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem refineLevel_succ (depth : Nat) (cell : Cell) :
    refineLevel (Point := Point) (depth + 1) cell =
      (CertifiedCellDomain.children cell).flatMap (refineLevel depth)
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.CertifiedCellDomain.contains_of_mem_refineLevel
statement:
theorem contains_of_mem_refineLevel {depth : Nat} {root child : Cell} {x : Point}
    (hchild : child ∈ refineLevel (Point := Point) depth root)
    (hx : CertifiedCellDomain.contains child x) :
    CertifiedCellDomain.contains root x
proof:
:= by
  induction depth generalizing root with
  | zero =>
      simp only [refineLevel, List.mem_singleton] at hchild
      subst child
      exact hx
  | succ depth ih =>
      simp only [refineLevel, List.mem_flatMap] at hchild
      obtain ⟨parent, hparent, hchild⟩ := hchild
      exact CertifiedCellDomain.childSubset hparent (ih hchild)

name: LeanCert.Core.CertifiedCellDomain.exists_mem_refineLevel
statement:
theorem exists_mem_refineLevel {depth : Nat} {root : Cell} {x : Point}
    (hx : CertifiedCellDomain.contains root x) :
    ∃ child, child ∈ refineLevel (Point := Point) depth root ∧
      CertifiedCellDomain.contains child x
proof:
:= by
  induction depth generalizing root with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨root, by simp [refineLevel], hx⟩
  | succ depth ih =>
      obtain ⟨parent, hparent, hxParent⟩ :=
        CertifiedCellDomain.childrenCover hx
      obtain ⟨child, hchild, hxChild⟩ := ih hxParent
      refine ⟨child, ?_, hxChild⟩
      simp only [refineLevel, List.mem_flatMap]
      exact ⟨parent, hparent, hchild⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.DerivativeIntervals.sin_deriv_abs_le_one

name: LeanCert.Core.DerivativeIntervals.cosh_strictAntiOn_nonpos
statement: theorem cosh_strictAntiOn_nonpos : StrictAntiOn cosh (Iic 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [mem_Iic] at hx hy
  
  calc cosh y = cosh (-(-y)) := by ring_nf
    _ = cosh (-y) := by rw [Real.cosh_neg]
    _ < cosh (-x) := by
        apply Real.cosh_strictMonoOn
        · simp only [mem_Ici]; linarith
        · simp only [mem_Ici]; linarith
        · linarith
    _ = cosh x := by rw [Real.cosh_neg]

name: LeanCert.Core.OneSidedTaylor.monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}

    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo a b))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 ≤ deriv f x) :
    MonotoneOn f (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc a b) hf ?_ ?_
  · rw [interior_Icc]; exact hf'
  · intro x hx; rw [interior_Icc] at hx; exact hderiv x hx

proof:
:= by

  have h : Nat.shiftLeft 1 0 = 1 := rfl
  simp only [h, Nat.cast_one, Int.cast_one, mul_one]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.shiftRightInt_eq_div
statement:
private theorem shiftRightInt_eq_div (m : Int) (n : Nat) :
    shiftRightInt m n = m / (pow2Nat n : Int)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftRightInt, pow2Nat]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.shiftLeftInt_eq_mul
statement:
private theorem shiftLeftInt_eq_mul (m : Int) (n : Nat) :
    shiftLeftInt m n = m * (pow2Nat n : Int)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftLeftInt, pow2Nat]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.pow2Nat_pos
statement: private theorem pow2Nat_pos (n : Nat) : 0 < pow2Nat n
proof:
:= by
  unfold pow2Nat
  
  conv => lhs; rw [show (0 : ℕ) = 0 from rfl]
  conv => rhs; rw [show Nat.shiftLeft 1 n = 1 * 2^n from Nat.shiftLeft_eq 1 n]
  simp only [one_mul]
  exact Nat.one_le_two_pow

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.pow2Nat_int_pos
statement: private theorem pow2Nat_int_pos (n : Nat) : (0 : Int) < (pow2Nat n : Int)
proof:
:= by
  exact Int.natCast_pos.mpr (pow2Nat_pos n)

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_ediv_mul_le
statement:
private theorem int_ediv_mul_le (m : Int) (d : Int) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (m / d) * d ≤ m
proof: := Int.ediv_mul_le m (ne_of_gt hd)

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_ediv_add_one_mul_ge
statement:
private theorem int_ediv_add_one_mul_ge (m : Int) (d : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (_hrem : m % d ≠ 0) :
    m ≤ (m / d + 1) * d
proof:
:= by
  
  have h := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv m d
  
  have hlt := Int.emod_lt_of_pos m hd
  
  have heq : d + d * (m / d) = (m / d + 1) * d := by
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, mul_comm d (m / d), add_comm]
  
  have hcalc : m < (m / d + 1) * d :=
    calc m = m % d + d * (m / d) := h.symm
      _ < d + d * (m / d) := by gcongr 1
      _ = (m / d + 1) * d := heq
  exact le_of_lt hcalc

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_ediv_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem int_ediv_mul_eq (m : Int) (d : Int) (_hd : 0 < d) (hrem : m % d = 0) :
    (m / d) * d = m
proof:
:= by
  
  have h := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv m d
  
  simp only [hrem, zero_add] at h
  
  calc (m / d) * d = d * (m / d) := mul_comm _ _
    _ = m := h

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_neg
statement: theorem toRat_neg (d : Dyadic) : (neg d).toRat = -(d.toRat)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : d.exponent ≥ 0
  · simp [neg, toRat, h]
  · simp [neg, toRat, h]
    rw [neg_div]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.pow2Nat_eq_pow
statement: private theorem pow2Nat_eq_pow (n : Nat) : pow2Nat n = 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold pow2Nat
  rw [show Nat.shiftLeft 1 n = 1 * 2^n from Nat.shiftLeft_eq 1 n]
  simp only [one_mul]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_eq
statement: theorem toRat_eq (d : Dyadic) : d.toRat = d.mantissa * (2 : ℚ) ^ d.exponent
proof:
:= by
  unfold toRat
  split_ifs with h
  · 
    have he : d.exponent = (d.exponent.toNat : ℤ) := (Int.toNat_of_nonneg h).symm
    rw [he, zpow_natCast, pow2Nat_eq_pow]
    
    simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_ofNat,
               Int.toNat_natCast]
  · 
    push Not at h
    have hpos : 0 ≤ -d.exponent := Int.neg_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt h)
    
    set n := (-d.exponent).toNat with hn_def
    have hne : d.exponent = -(n : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hpos]; omega
    rw [hne, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, pow2Nat_eq_pow]
    
    simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_add
statement: theorem toRat_add (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : (add d₁ d₂).toRat = d₁.toRat + d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [toRat_eq d₁, toRat_eq d₂]
  unfold add
  split_ifs with h
  · 
    rw [toRat_eq]
    simp only [shiftLeftInt, pow2Nat_eq_pow]
    
    set shift := (d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent).toNat with hshift_def
    have hshift : (shift : ℤ) = d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent := by
      rw [hshift_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
    
    have hexp : (2 : ℚ) ^ shift * 2 ^ d₁.exponent = 2 ^ d₂.exponent := by
      have h2 : (2 : ℚ) ^ shift = (2 : ℚ) ^ (shift : ℤ) := by rw [zpow_natCast]
      rw [h2, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero), hshift]
      congr 1; omega
    
    have hcast : (↑(2 ^ shift : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ) ^ shift := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    
    simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, hcast, add_mul, mul_assoc, hexp]
  · 
    rw [toRat_eq]
    simp only [shiftLeftInt, pow2Nat_eq_pow]
    set shift := (d₁.exponent - d₂.exponent).toNat with hshift_def
    have hshift : (shift : ℤ) = d₁.exponent - d₂.exponent := by
      rw [hshift_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
    have hexp : (2 : ℚ) ^ shift * 2 ^ d₂.exponent = 2 ^ d₁.exponent := by
      have h2 : (2 : ℚ) ^ shift = (2 : ℚ) ^ (shift : ℤ) := by rw [zpow_natCast]
      rw [h2, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero), hshift]
      congr 1; omega
    have hcast : (↑(2 ^ shift : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ) ^ shift := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, hcast, add_mul, mul_assoc, hexp, add_comm]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_mul
statement: theorem toRat_mul (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : (mul d₁ d₂).toRat = d₁.toRat * d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [toRat_eq d₁, toRat_eq d₂, toRat_eq]
  unfold mul
  simp only [Int.cast_mul]
  
  
  rw [zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero)]
  
  
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_shiftDown_le
statement:
theorem toRat_shiftDown_le (d : Dyadic) (newExp : Int) :
    (shiftDown d newExp).toRat ≤ d.toRat
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftDown]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_refl _
  · 
    push Not at h
    set diff := (newExp - d.exponent).toNat with hdiff_def
    have hdiff : (diff : ℤ) = newExp - d.exponent := by
      rw [hdiff_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
    have hnewExp : newExp = d.exponent + diff := by omega
    rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
    simp only [shiftRightInt, pow2Nat_eq_pow]
    
    have hpow_int_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (2 ^ diff : ℕ) := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
    have hdiv : d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) * (2 ^ diff : ℕ) ≤ d.mantissa :=
      int_ediv_mul_le d.mantissa (2 ^ diff : ℕ) hpow_int_pos
    
    have hpow : (2 : ℚ) ^ newExp = 2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff := by
      rw [hnewExp, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero), zpow_natCast]
    rw [hpow]
    
    have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ d.exponent := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) _
    have hpow2_pos : (0 : ℚ) < (2 : ℚ) ^ diff := pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) _
    
    have hq : (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) : ℚ) * ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) ≤ d.mantissa := by
      have heq : ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) = ((2 ^ diff : ℕ) : ℚ) := by simp
      rw [heq]
      
      
      calc (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) : ℚ) * ↑(2 ^ diff : ℕ)
          = ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) * (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) := by simp only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
        _ ≤ ↑d.mantissa := Int.cast_le.mpr hdiv
    
    have hrearr : (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) : ℚ) * (2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff)
                = (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ))) * ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) * 2 ^ d.exponent := by
      rw [mul_comm (2 ^ d.exponent) ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff), mul_assoc]
    rw [hrearr]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq (le_of_lt hpos)

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_shiftUp_ge
statement:
theorem toRat_shiftUp_ge (d : Dyadic) (newExp : Int) :
    d.toRat ≤ (shiftUp d newExp).toRat
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftUp]
  split_ifs with h hlowbits
  · exact le_refl _
  · 
    push Not at h
    set diff := (newExp - d.exponent).toNat with hdiff_def
    have hdiff : (diff : ℤ) = newExp - d.exponent := by
      rw [hdiff_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
    have hnewExp : newExp = d.exponent + diff := by omega
    rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
    simp only [shiftRightInt, pow2Nat_eq_pow, hasLowBits] at hlowbits ⊢
    
    have hpow_int_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (2 ^ diff : ℕ) := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
    have hrem : d.mantissa % (2 ^ diff : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by simp only [ne_eq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hlowbits; exact hlowbits
    have hceil : d.mantissa ≤ (d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1) * (2 ^ diff : ℕ) :=
      int_ediv_add_one_mul_ge d.mantissa (2 ^ diff : ℕ) hpow_int_pos hrem
    
    have hpow : (2 : ℚ) ^ newExp = 2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff := by
      rw [hnewExp, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero), zpow_natCast]
    rw [hpow]
    have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ d.exponent := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) _
    
    have hq : (d.mantissa : ℚ) ≤ (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1)) * ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) := by
      have heq : ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) = ((2 ^ diff : ℕ) : ℚ) := by simp
      rw [heq]
      calc (d.mantissa : ℚ) ≤ ↑((d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1) * (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) := Int.cast_le.mpr hceil
        _ = ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1) * ↑(2 ^ diff : ℕ) := by simp only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
    
    have hrearr : (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1) : ℚ) * (2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff)
                = (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1)) * ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) * 2 ^ d.exponent := by
      rw [mul_comm (2 ^ d.exponent) ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff), mul_assoc]
    rw [hrearr]
    calc (d.mantissa : ℚ) * 2 ^ d.exponent
        ≤ (↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1) * ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff)) * 2 ^ d.exponent :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq (le_of_lt hpos)
      _ = ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ) + 1) * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff * 2 ^ d.exponent := by rfl
  · 
    push Not at h
    set diff := (newExp - d.exponent).toNat with hdiff_def
    have hdiff : (diff : ℤ) = newExp - d.exponent := by
      rw [hdiff_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
    have hnewExp : newExp = d.exponent + diff := by omega
    rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
    simp only [shiftRightInt, pow2Nat_eq_pow, hasLowBits] at hlowbits ⊢
    
    have hpow_int_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (2 ^ diff : ℕ) := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
    have hrem : d.mantissa % (2 ^ diff : ℕ) = 0 := by
      simp only [ne_eq, decide_eq_true_eq, not_not] at hlowbits; exact hlowbits
    have hexact : (d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * (2 ^ diff : ℕ) = d.mantissa :=
      int_ediv_mul_eq d.mantissa (2 ^ diff : ℕ) hpow_int_pos hrem
    
    have hpow : (2 : ℚ) ^ newExp = 2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff := by
      rw [hnewExp, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero), zpow_natCast]
    rw [hpow]
    
    
    have heq : ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) = ((2 ^ diff : ℕ) : ℚ) := by simp
    calc (d.mantissa : ℚ) * 2 ^ d.exponent
        = ↑((d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * 2 ^ d.exponent := by
            simp only [hexact]
      _ = ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * ↑(2 ^ diff : ℕ) * 2 ^ d.exponent := by
            simp only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
      _ = ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff * 2 ^ d.exponent) := by
            rw [← heq, mul_assoc]
      _ = ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * (2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff) := by
            rw [mul_comm ((2 : ℚ) ^ diff) (2 ^ d.exponent)]
      _ ≤ ↑(d.mantissa / (2 ^ diff : ℕ)) * (2 ^ d.exponent * (2 : ℚ) ^ diff) := le_refl _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_lt_iff_rat_mul_lt
statement:
private theorem int_lt_iff_rat_mul_lt (a b : ℤ) (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    a < b ↔ (a : ℚ) * c < (b : ℚ) * c
proof:
:=
    ⟨λ h ↦ mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Int.cast_lt.mpr h) hc, λ h ↦ Int.cast_lt.mp ((Rat.mul_lt_mul_right hc).mp h)⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_eq_iff_rat_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem int_eq_iff_rat_mul_eq (a b : ℤ) (c : ℚ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    a = b ↔ (a : ℚ) * c = (b : ℚ) * c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [h]
  · intro h
    have hcancel := (mul_eq_mul_right_iff (c := c)).mp h
    cases hcancel with
    | inl heq => exact Int.cast_inj.mp heq
    | inr hzero => exact absurd hzero hc

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_gt_iff_rat_mul_gt
statement:
private theorem int_gt_iff_rat_mul_gt (a b : ℤ) (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    a > b ↔ (a : ℚ) * c > (b : ℚ) * c
proof: := int_lt_iff_rat_mul_lt b a c hc

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.shiftLeftInt_toRat
statement:
private theorem shiftLeftInt_toRat (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (shiftLeftInt m n : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) * (2 : ℚ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftLeftInt, pow2Nat_eq_pow, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.ord_compare_int_lt
statement: private theorem ord_compare_int_lt (a b : ℤ) : Ord.compare a b = .lt ↔ a < b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra! hge
    have hcases := lt_or_eq_of_le hge
    cases hcases with
    | inl hgt =>
      simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hgt), ne_of_gt hgt, ↓reduceIte] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
    | inr heq =>
      simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, heq, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
  · intro h
    simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, h, ↓reduceIte]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.ord_compare_int_eq
statement: private theorem ord_compare_int_eq (a b : ℤ) : Ord.compare a b = .eq ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    have hcases := lt_or_gt_of_ne hne
    cases hcases with
    | inl hlt =>
      simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
    | inr hgt =>
      simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hgt), ne_of_gt hgt, ↓reduceIte] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
  · intro h
    simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, h, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.ord_compare_int_gt
statement: private theorem ord_compare_int_gt (a b : ℤ) : Ord.compare a b = .gt ↔ a > b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra! hle
    have hcases := lt_or_eq_of_le hle
    cases hcases with
    | inl hlt =>
      simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
    | inr heq =>
      simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, heq, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
  · intro h
    simp only [Ord.compare, compareOfLessAndEq, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt h), ne_of_gt h, ↓reduceIte]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.ord_compare_ne_gt_iff
statement: private theorem ord_compare_ne_gt_iff (a b : ℤ) : (Ord.compare a b != .gt) = true ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra! hgt
    have := ord_compare_int_gt a b |>.mpr hgt
    exact h this
  · intro hle hgt
    have := ord_compare_int_gt a b |>.mp hgt
    exact not_lt.mpr hle this

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.aligned_lt_iff_toRat_lt_case1
statement:
private theorem aligned_lt_iff_toRat_lt_case1 (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) (h : d₁.exponent ≤ d₂.exponent) :
    d₁.mantissa < shiftLeftInt d₂.mantissa (d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent).toNat ↔ d₁.toRat < d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  set shift := (d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent).toNat with hshift_def
  have hshift : (shift : ℤ) = d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent := by
    rw [hshift_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
  rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
  
  have hpow : (2 : ℚ) ^ d₂.exponent = (2 : ℚ) ^ (shift : ℤ) * 2 ^ d₁.exponent := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0), hshift]; congr 1; omega
  have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ d₁.exponent := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) _
  
  have hrhs : (d₂.mantissa : ℚ) * 2 ^ d₂.exponent = d₂.mantissa * (2 : ℚ) ^ shift * 2 ^ d₁.exponent := by
    rw [hpow, zpow_natCast, mul_assoc]
  rw [hrhs]
  
  rw [int_lt_iff_rat_mul_lt _ _ _ hpos, shiftLeftInt_toRat]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.aligned_eq_iff_toRat_eq_case1
statement:
private theorem aligned_eq_iff_toRat_eq_case1 (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) (h : d₁.exponent ≤ d₂.exponent) :
    d₁.mantissa = shiftLeftInt d₂.mantissa (d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent).toNat ↔ d₁.toRat = d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  set shift := (d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent).toNat with hshift_def
  have hshift : (shift : ℤ) = d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent := by
    rw [hshift_def, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]; omega
  rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
  have hpow : (2 : ℚ) ^ d₂.exponent = (2 : ℚ) ^ (shift : ℤ) * 2 ^ d₁.exponent := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0), hshift]; congr 1; omega
  have hne : (2 : ℚ) ^ d₁.exponent ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ (two_ne_zero)
  have hrhs : (d₂.mantissa : ℚ) * 2 ^ d₂.exponent = d₂.mantissa * (2 : ℚ) ^ shift * 2 ^ d₁.exponent := by
    rw [hpow, zpow_natCast, mul_assoc]
  rw [hrhs, int_eq_iff_rat_mul_eq _ _ _ hne, shiftLeftInt_toRat]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case1
statement:
private theorem aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case1 (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) (h : d₁.exponent ≤ d₂.exponent) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case2
statement:
