name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.le_iff_toRat_le
statement:
theorem le_iff_toRat_le (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) :
    le d₁ d₂ = true ↔ d₁.toRat ≤ d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold le compare
  split_ifs with h
  · 
    set shift := (d₂.exponent - d₁.exponent).toNat
    rw [ord_compare_ne_gt_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hle
      by_cases! hlt : d₁.mantissa < shiftLeftInt d₂.mantissa shift
      · exact le_of_lt ((aligned_lt_iff_toRat_lt_case1 d₁ d₂ h).mp hlt)
      · have heq_or_gt := lt_or_eq_of_le hlt
        cases heq_or_gt with
        | inl hgt =>
          exfalso; exact not_lt.mpr hle hgt
        | inr heq =>
          exact le_of_eq ((aligned_eq_iff_toRat_eq_case1 d₁ d₂ h).mp heq.symm)
    · intro hle
      by_contra! hgt
      have hgt' := (aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case1 d₁ d₂ h).mp hgt
      exact not_lt.mpr hle hgt'
  · 
    push Not at h
    set shift := (d₁.exponent - d₂.exponent).toNat
    rw [ord_compare_ne_gt_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hle
      by_cases! hlt : shiftLeftInt d₁.mantissa shift < d₂.mantissa
      · exact le_of_lt ((aligned_lt_iff_toRat_lt_case2 d₁ d₂ h).mp hlt)
      · have heq_or_gt := lt_or_eq_of_le hlt
        cases heq_or_gt with
        | inl hgt =>
          exfalso; exact not_lt.mpr hle hgt
        | inr heq =>
          exact le_of_eq ((aligned_eq_iff_toRat_eq_case2 d₁ d₂ h).mp heq.symm)
    · intro hle
      by_contra! hgt
      have hgt' := (aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case2 d₁ d₂ h).mp hgt
      exact not_lt.mpr hle hgt'

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.compare_lt_iff
statement:
theorem compare_lt_iff (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) :
    compare d₁ d₂ = .lt ↔ d₁.toRat < d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold compare
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [ord_compare_int_lt]; exact aligned_lt_iff_toRat_lt_case1 d₁ d₂ h
  · push Not at h; rw [ord_compare_int_lt]; exact aligned_lt_iff_toRat_lt_case2 d₁ d₂ h

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.compare_gt_iff
statement:
theorem compare_gt_iff (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) :
    compare d₁ d₂ = .gt ↔ d₁.toRat > d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold compare
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [ord_compare_int_gt]; exact aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case1 d₁ d₂ h
  · push Not at h; rw [ord_compare_int_gt]; exact aligned_gt_iff_toRat_gt_case2 d₁ d₂ h

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.compare_eq_iff
statement:
theorem compare_eq_iff (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) :
    compare d₁ d₂ = .eq ↔ d₁.toRat = d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold compare
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [ord_compare_int_eq]; exact aligned_eq_iff_toRat_eq_case1 d₁ d₂ h
  · push Not at h; rw [ord_compare_int_eq]; exact aligned_eq_iff_toRat_eq_case2 d₁ d₂ h

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.min_toRat_le_left
statement: theorem min_toRat_le_left (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : (min d₁ d₂).toRat ≤ d₁.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold min
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_refl _
  · exact le_of_not_ge (fun hle => h (le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂ |>.mpr hle))

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.min_toRat_le_right
statement: theorem min_toRat_le_right (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : (min d₁ d₂).toRat ≤ d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold min
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂ |>.mp h
  · exact le_refl _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.le_max_toRat_left
statement: theorem le_max_toRat_left (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : d₁.toRat ≤ (max d₁ d₂).toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold max
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂ |>.mp h
  · exact le_refl _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.le_max_toRat_right
statement: theorem le_max_toRat_right (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : d₂.toRat ≤ (max d₁ d₂).toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold max
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_refl _
  · exact le_of_not_ge (fun hle => h (le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂ |>.mpr hle))

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.min_toRat
statement: theorem min_toRat (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : (min d₁ d₂).toRat = Min.min d₁.toRat d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold min
  split_ifs with h
  · 
    have hle : d₁.toRat ≤ d₂.toRat := le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂ |>.mp h
    exact (min_eq_left hle).symm
  · 
    have hgt : d₂.toRat < d₁.toRat := by
      have := le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂
      exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hle => h (this.mpr hle))
    exact (min_eq_right (le_of_lt hgt)).symm

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.max_toRat
statement: theorem max_toRat (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) : (max d₁ d₂).toRat = Max.max d₁.toRat d₂.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold max
  split_ifs with h
  · 
    have hle : d₁.toRat ≤ d₂.toRat := le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂ |>.mp h
    exact (max_eq_right hle).symm
  · 
    have hgt : d₂.toRat < d₁.toRat := by
      have := le_iff_toRat_le d₁ d₂
      exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hle => h (this.mpr hle))
    exact (max_eq_left (le_of_lt hgt)).symm

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.min4_le_max4
statement: theorem min4_le_max4 (a b c d : Dyadic) : (min4 a b c d).toRat ≤ (max4 a b c d).toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold min4 max4
  calc (min (min a b) (min c d)).toRat
      ≤ (min a b).toRat := min_toRat_le_left _ _
    _ ≤ a.toRat := min_toRat_le_left _ _
    _ ≤ (max a b).toRat := le_max_toRat_left _ _
    _ ≤ (max (max a b) (max c d)).toRat := le_max_toRat_left _ _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_normalizeDown_le
statement:
theorem toRat_normalizeDown_le (d : Dyadic) (maxBits : Nat) :
    (d.normalizeDown maxBits).toRat ≤ d.toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizeDown normalize
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_refl _
  · exact toRat_shiftDown_le d _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_normalizeUp_ge
statement:
theorem toRat_normalizeUp_ge (d : Dyadic) (maxBits : Nat) :
    d.toRat ≤ (d.normalizeUp maxBits).toRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizeUp normalize
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_refl _
  · exact toRat_shiftUp_ge d _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_scale2
statement:
theorem toRat_scale2 (d : Dyadic) (n : Int) :
    (d.scale2 n).toRat = d.toRat * (2 : ℚ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold scale2
  rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
  simp only []
  rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0)]

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.toRat_scale2_le_scale2
statement:
theorem toRat_scale2_le_scale2 (d₁ d₂ : Dyadic) (n : Int) (h : d₁.toRat ≤ d₂.toRat) :
    (d₁.scale2 n).toRat ≤ (d₂.scale2 n).toRat
proof:
:= by
  rw [toRat_scale2, toRat_scale2]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2) n)

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.nat_sqrt_sq_le
statement: private theorem nat_sqrt_sq_le (n : Nat) : (Nat.sqrt n) ^ 2 ≤ n
proof: := Nat.sqrt_le' n

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.nat_lt_succ_sqrt_sq
statement: private theorem nat_lt_succ_sqrt_sq (n : Nat) : n < (Nat.sqrt n + 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt n
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at h
  rw [sq]
  exact h

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.intSqrt_sq_le
statement: theorem intSqrt_sq_le {n : Int} (hn : 0 ≤ n) : (intSqrt n) ^ 2 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intSqrt, not_lt.mpr hn, ↓reduceIte, intSqrtNat]
  have h := nat_sqrt_sq_le n.toNat
  calc ((Nat.sqrt n.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ)
      = ((Nat.sqrt n.toNat) ^ 2 : ℕ) := by norm_cast
    _ ≤ (n.toNat : ℤ) := Int.ofNat_le.mpr h
    _ = n := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.int_lt_succ_sqrt_sq
statement: theorem int_lt_succ_sqrt_sq {n : Int} (hn : 0 ≤ n) : n < (intSqrt n + 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intSqrt, not_lt.mpr hn, ↓reduceIte, intSqrtNat]
  have h := nat_lt_succ_sqrt_sq n.toNat
  calc n = (n.toNat : ℤ) := (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn).symm
    _ < ((Nat.sqrt n.toNat + 1) ^ 2 : ℕ) := Int.ofNat_lt.mpr h
    _ = ((Nat.sqrt n.toNat : ℤ) + 1) ^ 2 := by norm_cast

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.intSqrt_nonneg
statement: theorem intSqrt_nonneg {n : Int} (hn : 0 ≤ n) : 0 ≤ intSqrt n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intSqrt, not_lt.mpr hn, ↓reduceIte, intSqrtNat]
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.sqrt_scaled_shift_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_nonneg hm
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.sqrtDown_nonneg
statement:
theorem sqrtDown_nonneg (d : Dyadic) (prec : Int) (hd : 0 ≤ d.mantissa) :
    0 ≤ (sqrtDown d prec).mantissa
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sqrtDown, not_lt.mpr hd, ↓reduceIte]
  set shift := d.exponent - 2 * prec
  have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ (if shift ≥ 0 then
      d.mantissa * (pow2Nat shift.toNat : Int)
    else
      d.mantissa / (pow2Nat (-shift).toNat : Int)) := by
    by_cases! hsh : shift ≥ 0
    · simp only [hsh, ↓reduceIte]
      exact sqrt_scaled_shift_nonneg hd hsh
    · simp only [not_le.mpr hsh, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Int.ediv_nonneg hd (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  exact intSqrt_nonneg hm_nonneg

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.sqrtUp_nonneg
statement:
theorem sqrtUp_nonneg (d : Dyadic) (prec : Int) (hd : 0 ≤ d.mantissa) :
    0 ≤ (sqrtUp d prec).mantissa
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sqrtUp, not_lt.mpr hd, ↓reduceIte]
  set shift := d.exponent - 2 * prec
  have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ (if shift ≥ 0 then
      d.mantissa * (pow2Nat shift.toNat : Int)
    else
      d.mantissa / (pow2Nat (-shift).toNat : Int)) := by
    by_cases! hsh : shift ≥ 0
    · simp only [hsh, ↓reduceIte]
      exact sqrt_scaled_shift_nonneg hd hsh
    · simp only [not_le.mpr hsh, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Int.ediv_nonneg hd (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  set m := (if shift ≥ 0 then
      d.mantissa * (pow2Nat shift.toNat : Int)
    else
      d.mantissa / (pow2Nat (-shift).toNat : Int))
  set s := intSqrt m
  by_cases hperfect : s * s = m
  · simp only [hperfect, ↓reduceIte]
    exact intSqrt_nonneg hm_nonneg
  · simp only [hperfect, ↓reduceIte]
    calc 0 ≤ s := intSqrt_nonneg hm_nonneg
      _ ≤ s + 1 := by omega

name: LeanCert.Core.Dyadic.sqrtDown_le_sqrtUp
statement:
theorem sqrtDown_le_sqrtUp (d : Dyadic) (prec : Int) (hd : 0 ≤ d.mantissa) :
    (sqrtDown d prec).toRat ≤ (sqrtUp d prec).toRat
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sqrtDown, sqrtUp, not_lt.mpr hd, ↓reduceIte]
  set shift := d.exponent - 2 * prec
  have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ (if shift ≥ 0 then
      d.mantissa * (pow2Nat shift.toNat : Int)
    else
      d.mantissa / (pow2Nat (-shift).toNat : Int)) := by
    by_cases! hsh : shift ≥ 0
    · simp only [hsh, ↓reduceIte]
      exact sqrt_scaled_shift_nonneg hd hsh
    · simp only [not_le.mpr hsh, ↓reduceIte]
      exact Int.ediv_nonneg hd (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  set m := (if shift ≥ 0 then
      d.mantissa * (pow2Nat shift.toNat : Int)
    else
      d.mantissa / (pow2Nat (-shift).toNat : Int))
  set s := intSqrt m
  by_cases hperfect : s * s = m
  · 
    simp only [hperfect, ↓reduceIte]
    exact le_refl _
  · 
    simp only [hperfect, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [toRat_eq, toRat_eq]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt (zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) _))
    simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1)

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.ValueEq.refl
statement: @[refl] theorem refl (I : IntervalDyadic) : I.ValueEq I
proof: := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.ValueEq.symm
statement: theorem symm {I J : IntervalDyadic} (h : I.ValueEq J) : J.ValueEq I
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.ValueEq.trans
statement:
theorem trans {I J K : IntervalDyadic} (hIJ : I.ValueEq J) (hJK : J.ValueEq K) :
    I.ValueEq K
proof: := ⟨hIJ.1.trans hJK.1, hIJ.2.trans hJK.2⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.ValueEq.mem_iff
statement:
theorem mem_iff {I J : IntervalDyadic} (h : I.ValueEq J) (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IntervalDyadic.mem_def]
  have hlo : (I.lo.toRat : ℝ) = J.lo.toRat := by exact_mod_cast h.1
  have hhi : (I.hi.toRat : ℝ) = J.hi.toRat := by exact_mod_cast h.2
  rw [hlo, hhi]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicPath.index_lt_pow_length
statement: theorem index_lt_pow_length (path : DyadicPath) : path.index < 2 ^ path.length
proof:
:= by
  induction path with
  | nil => simp [index]
  | cons bit rest ih =>
      cases bit <;> simp [index, pow_succ] <;> omega

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicPath.index_append_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem index_append_false (path : DyadicPath) :
    (path ++ [false]).index = 2 * path.index
proof:
:= by
  induction path with
  | nil => simp [index]
  | cons bit rest ih =>
      cases bit <;> simp [index, ih, pow_succ]
      omega

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicPath.index_append_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem index_append_true (path : DyadicPath) :
    (path ++ [true]).index = 2 * path.index + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction path with
  | nil => simp [index]
  | cons bit rest ih =>
      cases bit <;> simp [index, ih, pow_succ]
      omega

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicPath.decodeByBisection_append_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeByBisection_append_false (root : IntervalDyadic) (path : DyadicPath) :
    decodeByBisection root (path ++ [false]) = (decodeByBisection root path).bisect.1
proof:
:= by
  induction path generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [decodeByBisection]
  | cons bit rest ih => cases bit <;> simp [decodeByBisection, ih]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicPath.decodeByBisection_append_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeByBisection_append_true (root : IntervalDyadic) (path : DyadicPath) :
    decodeByBisection root (path ++ [true]) = (decodeByBisection root path).bisect.2
proof:
:= by
  induction path generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [decodeByBisection]
  | cons bit rest ih => cases bit <;> simp [decodeByBisection, ih]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.ext'
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext' {a b : DyadicCell} (hdepth : a.depth = b.depth)
    (hindex : a.index.val = b.index.val) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | mk da ia =>
      cases b with
      | mk db ib =>
          simp only at hdepth hindex
          subst db
          congr
          exact Fin.ext hindex

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.childLeft_depth
statement:
@[simp] theorem childLeft_depth (cell : DyadicCell) :
    cell.childLeft.depth = cell.depth + 1
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.childRight_depth
statement:
@[simp] theorem childRight_depth (cell : DyadicCell) :
    cell.childRight.depth = cell.depth + 1
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.childLeft_index
statement:
@[simp] theorem childLeft_index (cell : DyadicCell) :
    cell.childLeft.index.val = 2 * cell.index.val
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.childRight_index
statement:
@[simp] theorem childRight_index (cell : DyadicCell) :
    cell.childRight.index.val = 2 * cell.index.val + 1
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.ofPath_depth
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofPath_depth (path : DyadicPath) :
    (ofPath path).depth = path.length
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.ofPath_index
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofPath_index (path : DyadicPath) :
    (ofPath path).index.val = path.index
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.ofPath_append_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofPath_append_false (path : DyadicPath) :
    ofPath (path ++ [false]) = (ofPath path).childLeft
proof:
:= by
  apply ext'
  · simp
  · simp

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.ofPath_append_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofPath_append_true (path : DyadicPath) :
    ofPath (path ++ [true]) = (ofPath path).childRight
proof:
:= by
  apply ext'
  · simp
  · simp

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.step_toRat
statement:
@[simp] theorem step_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.step root).toRat = root.width.toRat * (2 : ℚ) ^ (-(cell.depth : Int))
proof:
:= by
  simp [step, Dyadic.toRat_scale2]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.step_toRat_nonneg
statement:
theorem step_toRat_nonneg (root : IntervalDyadic) (depth : Nat) :
    0 ≤ (root.width.scale2 (-(depth : Int))).toRat
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dyadic.toRat_scale2, IntervalDyadic.width_toRat]
  exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr root.le) (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.PreparedDyadicLevel.intervalAt_lo_toRat
statement:
@[simp] theorem intervalAt_lo_toRat (level : PreparedDyadicLevel)
    (index : Fin level.cellCount) :
    (level.intervalAt index).lo.toRat =
      level.root.lo.toRat + level.step.toRat * index.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [intervalAt, Dyadic.toRat_add, Dyadic.toRat_mul, Dyadic.toRat_ofInt]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.PreparedDyadicLevel.intervalAt_hi_toRat
statement:
@[simp] theorem intervalAt_hi_toRat (level : PreparedDyadicLevel)
    (index : Fin level.cellCount) :
    (level.intervalAt index).hi.toRat =
      level.root.lo.toRat + level.step.toRat * (index.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [intervalAt, Dyadic.toRat_add, Dyadic.toRat_mul, Dyadic.toRat_ofInt]
  ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.PreparedDyadicLevel.intervalAt_valueEq_decodeDirect
statement:
theorem intervalAt_valueEq_decodeDirect (level : PreparedDyadicLevel)
    (index : Fin level.cellCount) :
    (level.intervalAt index).ValueEq
      ((DyadicCell.mk level.depth index).decodeDirect level.root)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change
      (level.root.lo.add (level.step.mul (Dyadic.ofInt index.val))).toRat =
        (level.root.lo.add
          ((level.root.width.scale2 (-(level.depth : Int))).mul
            (Dyadic.ofInt index.val))).toRat
    rw [level.step_eq]
  · change
      ((level.root.lo.add (level.step.mul (Dyadic.ofInt index.val))).add level.step).toRat =
        ((level.root.lo.add
          ((level.root.width.scale2 (-(level.depth : Int))).mul
            (Dyadic.ofInt index.val))).add
              (level.root.width.scale2 (-(level.depth : Int)))).toRat
    rw [level.step_eq]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.PreparedDyadicLevel.materializeFrom_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem materializeFrom_length (level : PreparedDyadicLevel) (count : Nat) (lo : Dyadic) :
    (materializeFrom level count lo).length = count
proof:
:= by
  induction count generalizing lo with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ count ih => simp [materializeFrom, ih]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.PreparedDyadicLevel.materialize_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem materialize_length (level : PreparedDyadicLevel) :
    level.materialize.length = level.cellCount
proof:
:= by
  simp [materialize]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeDirect_lo_toRat
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeDirect_lo_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.decodeDirect root).lo.toRat =
      root.lo.toRat + (cell.step root).toRat * cell.index.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [decodeDirect, Dyadic.toRat_add, Dyadic.toRat_mul, Dyadic.toRat_ofInt]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeDirect_hi_toRat
statement:
@[simp] theorem decodeDirect_hi_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.decodeDirect root).hi.toRat =
      root.lo.toRat + (cell.step root).toRat * (cell.index.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [decodeDirect, Dyadic.toRat_add, Dyadic.toRat_mul, Dyadic.toRat_ofInt]
  ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeDirect_width_toRat
statement:
theorem decodeDirect_width_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.decodeDirect root).width.toRat = (cell.step root).toRat
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntervalDyadic.width_toRat, decodeDirect_hi_toRat, decodeDirect_lo_toRat]
  ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.childLeft_step_toRat
statement:
theorem childLeft_step_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.childLeft.step root).toRat = (cell.step root).toRat / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_toRat, step_toRat]
  rw [childLeft_depth]
  have hexp : -((cell.depth + 1 : Nat) : Int) = -(cell.depth : Int) - 1 := by omega
  rw [hexp, zpow_sub_one₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0)]
  norm_num
  ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.childRight_step_toRat
statement:
theorem childRight_step_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.childRight.step root).toRat = (cell.step root).toRat / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_toRat, step_toRat]
  rw [childRight_depth]
  have hexp : -((cell.depth + 1 : Nat) : Int) = -(cell.depth : Int) - 1 := by omega
  rw [hexp, zpow_sub_one₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0)]
  norm_num
  ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeDirect_childLeft
statement:
theorem decodeDirect_childLeft (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.childLeft.decodeDirect root).ValueEq (cell.decodeDirect root).bisect.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change (cell.childLeft.decodeDirect root).lo.toRat =
        (cell.decodeDirect root).lo.toRat
    rw [decodeDirect_lo_toRat, decodeDirect_lo_toRat, childLeft_step_toRat,
      childLeft_index]
    push_cast
    ring
  · change (cell.childLeft.decodeDirect root).hi.toRat =
        (cell.decodeDirect root).midpoint.toRat
    rw [decodeDirect_hi_toRat, IntervalDyadic.midpoint_toRat,
      decodeDirect_lo_toRat, decodeDirect_hi_toRat, childLeft_step_toRat,
      childLeft_index]
    push_cast
    ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeDirect_childRight
statement:
theorem decodeDirect_childRight (root : IntervalDyadic) (cell : DyadicCell) :
    (cell.childRight.decodeDirect root).ValueEq (cell.decodeDirect root).bisect.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change (cell.childRight.decodeDirect root).lo.toRat =
        (cell.decodeDirect root).midpoint.toRat
    rw [decodeDirect_lo_toRat, IntervalDyadic.midpoint_toRat,
      decodeDirect_lo_toRat, decodeDirect_hi_toRat, childRight_step_toRat,
      childRight_index]
    push_cast
    ring
  · change (cell.childRight.decodeDirect root).hi.toRat =
        (cell.decodeDirect root).hi.toRat
    rw [decodeDirect_hi_toRat, decodeDirect_hi_toRat, childRight_step_toRat,
      childRight_index]
    push_cast
    ring

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.valueEq_bisect_left
statement:
theorem valueEq_bisect_left {I J : IntervalDyadic} (h : I.ValueEq J) :
    I.bisect.1.ValueEq J.bisect.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact h.1
  · change I.midpoint.toRat = J.midpoint.toRat
    rw [IntervalDyadic.midpoint_toRat, IntervalDyadic.midpoint_toRat, h.1, h.2]

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.valueEq_bisect_right
statement:
theorem valueEq_bisect_right {I J : IntervalDyadic} (h : I.ValueEq J) :
    I.bisect.2.ValueEq J.bisect.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change I.midpoint.toRat = J.midpoint.toRat
    rw [IntervalDyadic.midpoint_toRat, IntervalDyadic.midpoint_toRat, h.1, h.2]
  · exact h.2

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeDirect_root
statement:
theorem decodeDirect_root (root : IntervalDyadic) :
    (DyadicCell.root.decodeDirect root).ValueEq root
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [DyadicCell.root]
  · rw [decodeDirect_hi_toRat]
    simp only [DyadicCell.root, step, Dyadic.toRat_scale2, IntervalDyadic.width_toRat]
    norm_num

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.decodeByBisection_valueEq_decodeDirect
statement:
theorem decodeByBisection_valueEq_decodeDirect (root : IntervalDyadic) (path : DyadicPath) :
    (path.decodeByBisection root).ValueEq ((ofPath path).decodeDirect root)
proof:
:= by
  induction path using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => exact (decodeDirect_root root).symm
  | append_singleton path bit ih =>
      cases bit
      · rw [DyadicPath.decodeByBisection_append_false, ofPath_append_false]
        exact (valueEq_bisect_left ih).trans (decodeDirect_childLeft root (ofPath path)).symm
      · rw [DyadicPath.decodeByBisection_append_true, ofPath_append_true]
        exact (valueEq_bisect_right ih).trans (decodeDirect_childRight root (ofPath path)).symm

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.ownerSet_subset_closedCell
statement:
theorem ownerSet_subset_closedCell (root : IntervalDyadic) (depth : Nat)
    (index : Fin (2 ^ depth)) :
    ownerSet root depth index ⊆ (closedCell root depth index).toSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hx.1

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.ownerSet_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hji : j ≤ i := hxi.2 j hxj.1
  have hij : i ≤ j := hxj.2 i hxi.1
  exact hne (le_antisymm hij hji)

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.not_owns_of_mem_higher
statement:
theorem not_owns_of_mem_higher {root : IntervalDyadic} {depth : Nat}
    {i j : Fin (2 ^ depth)} {x : ℝ} (hij : i < j)
    (hj : x ∈ closedCell root depth j) :
    ¬ Owns root depth i x
proof:
:= by
  intro hi
  exact (not_le_of_gt hij) (hi.2 j hj)

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.last_owns_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  intro other _
  apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
  simp only [lastIndex]
  omega

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.exists_path_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction depth generalizing root with
  | zero => exact ⟨[], rfl, hx⟩
  | succ depth ih =>
      rcases IntervalDyadic.mem_bisect_or hx with hleft | hright
      · obtain ⟨path, hlen, hmem⟩ := ih (root := root.bisect.1) hleft
        exact ⟨false :: path, by simp [hlen], by simpa [DyadicPath.decodeByBisection] using hmem⟩
      · obtain ⟨path, hlen, hmem⟩ := ih (root := root.bisect.2) hright
        exact ⟨true :: path, by simp [hlen], by simpa [DyadicPath.decodeByBisection] using hmem⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.exists_mem_closedCell
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨path, hlen, hmem⟩ := exists_path_mem root depth hx
  subst depth
  let index : Fin (2 ^ path.length) := (ofPath path).index
  refine ⟨index, ?_⟩
  have hrecursive :
      (path.decodeByBisection root).ValueEq ((ofPath path).decodeDirect root) :=
    decodeByBisection_valueEq_decodeDirect root path
  have hprepared :
      ((PreparedDyadicLevel.prepare root path.length).intervalAt index).ValueEq
        ((ofPath path).decodeDirect root) := by
    apply PreparedDyadicLevel.intervalAt_valueEq_decodeDirect
  exact (hprepared.mem_iff x).mpr ((hrecursive.mem_iff x).mp hmem)

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.exists_unique_owner
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨someIndex, hsome⟩ := exists_mem_closedCell root depth hx
  let candidates := Finset.univ.filter fun index : Fin (2 ^ depth) =>
    x ∈ closedCell root depth index
  have hcandidates : candidates.Nonempty := by
    exact Finset.filter_nonempty_iff.mpr ⟨someIndex, Finset.mem_univ _, hsome⟩
  let owner := candidates.max' hcandidates
  have hownerMem : x ∈ closedCell root depth owner := by
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (candidates.max'_mem hcandidates)).2
  refine ⟨owner, ⟨hownerMem, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro other hother
    apply candidates.le_max'
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hother⟩
  · intro other hother
    exact le_antisymm ((by
      apply candidates.le_max'
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hother.1⟩) : other ≤ owner)
      (hother.2 owner hownerMem)

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicCell.Ownership.mem_ownerSet_of_mem_root
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨index, hindex, _⟩ := exists_unique_owner root depth hx
  exact ⟨index, hindex⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.certifiedCell_children
statement:
@[simp] theorem certifiedCell_children (I : IntervalDyadic) :
    CertifiedCellDomain.children I = [I.bisect.1, I.bisect.2]
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.certifiedCell_contains
statement:
@[simp] theorem certifiedCell_contains (I : IntervalDyadic) (x : ℝ) :
    CertifiedCellDomain.contains I x ↔ x ∈ I
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalDyadic.certifiedCell_diameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem certifiedCell_diameter (I : IntervalDyadic) :
    CertifiedCellDomain.diameter I = I.width.toRat
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicSubdivisionTree.paths_leaf
statement: @[simp] theorem paths_leaf : DyadicSubdivisionTree.leaf.paths = [[]]
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicSubdivisionTree.paths_split
statement:
@[simp] theorem paths_split (left right : DyadicSubdivisionTree) :
    (DyadicSubdivisionTree.split left right).paths =
      left.paths.map (false :: ·) ++ right.paths.map (true :: ·)
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicSubdivisionTree.exists_mem_decode
statement:
theorem exists_mem_decode (tree : DyadicSubdivisionTree) (root : IntervalDyadic)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ root) :
    ∃ path ∈ tree.paths, x ∈ path.decodeByBisection root
proof:
:= by
  induction tree generalizing root with
  | leaf => exact ⟨[], by simp, hx⟩
  | split left right ihLeft ihRight =>
      rcases IntervalDyadic.mem_bisect_or hx with hleft | hright
      · obtain ⟨path, hpath, hmem⟩ := ihLeft (root := root.bisect.1) hleft
        refine ⟨false :: path, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [hpath]
        · simpa [DyadicPath.decodeByBisection] using hmem
      · obtain ⟨path, hpath, hmem⟩ := ihRight (root := root.bisect.2) hright
        refine ⟨true :: path, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [hpath]
        · simpa [DyadicPath.decodeByBisection] using hmem

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicFrontier.check_eq_some_paths
statement:
theorem check_eq_some_paths {leaves : List DyadicPath} {tree : DyadicSubdivisionTree}
    (hcheck : check leaves = some tree) : tree.paths = leaves
proof:
:= by
  unfold check at hcheck
  split at hcheck <;> try contradiction
  next candidate hcandidate =>
    split at hcheck <;> simp_all

name: LeanCert.Core.DyadicFrontier.exists_mem_decode_of_check
statement:
theorem exists_mem_decode_of_check {leaves : List DyadicPath}
    {tree : DyadicSubdivisionTree} (hcheck : check leaves = some tree)
    (root : IntervalDyadic) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ root) :
    ∃ path ∈ leaves, x ∈ path.decodeByBisection root
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨path, hpath, hmem⟩ := tree.exists_mem_decode root hx
  exact ⟨path, by simpa [check_eq_some_paths hcheck] using hpath, hmem⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.finitePrefix_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem finitePrefix_zero (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) : bits.finitePrefix 0 = []
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.finitePrefix_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePrefix_succ (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) (depth : Nat) :
    bits.finitePrefix (depth + 1) = bits.finitePrefix depth ++ [bits depth]
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cell_zero (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) :
    bits.cell root 0 = root
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem cell_succ (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath)
    (depth : Nat) :
    bits.cell root (depth + 1) =
      if bits depth then (bits.cell root depth).bisect.2
      else (bits.cell root depth).bisect.1
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_eq_decode_finitePrefix
statement:
theorem cell_eq_decode_finitePrefix (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath)
    (depth : Nat) :
    bits.cell root depth = (bits.finitePrefix depth).decodeByBisection root
proof:
:= by
  induction depth with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ depth ih =>
      rw [cell_succ, finitePrefix_succ]
      cases hbit : bits depth
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
          DyadicPath.decodeByBisection_append_false, ih]
      · simp only [↓reduceIte, DyadicPath.decodeByBisection_append_true, ih]

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.mem_cell_of_mem_succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell_succ] at hx
  split at hx
  · exact IntervalDyadic.mem_of_mem_bisect_right hx
  · exact IntervalDyadic.mem_of_mem_bisect_left hx

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_width_toRat
statement:
theorem cell_width_toRat (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath)
    (depth : Nat) :
    (bits.cell root depth).width.toRat = root.width.toRat * (1 / 2 : ℚ) ^ depth
proof:
:= by
  induction depth with
  | zero => simp
  | succ depth ih =>
      rw [cell_succ]
      split
      · rw [IntervalDyadic.bisect_right_width_toRat, ih, pow_succ]
        ring
      · rw [IntervalDyadic.bisect_left_width_toRat, ih, pow_succ]
        ring

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_width_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem cell_width_tendsto_zero (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun depth => ((bits.cell root depth).width.toRat : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : Filter.Tendsto (fun depth : Nat => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ depth)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hmul : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun depth : Nat => (root.width.toRat : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ depth)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hpow.const_mul (root.width.toRat : ℝ)
  apply hmul.congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun depth => by
    change (root.width.toRat : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ depth =
      ((bits.cell root depth).width.toRat : ℝ)
    rw [cell_width_toRat]
    norm_num

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_real_width_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem cell_real_width_tendsto_zero (root : IntervalDyadic)
    (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun depth => (bits.cell root depth).hi.toReal -
        (bits.cell root depth).lo.toReal)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cell_width_tendsto_zero root bits).congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun depth => by
    change ((bits.cell root depth).width.toRat : ℝ) =
      (bits.cell root depth).hi.toReal - (bits.cell root depth).lo.toReal
    rw [IntervalDyadic.width_toRat]
    simp only [Dyadic.toReal, Rat.cast_sub]

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.cell_nonempty
statement:
theorem cell_nonempty (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath)
    (depth : Nat) : (bits.cell root depth).toSet.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntervalDyadic.toSet, Set.nonempty_Icc]
  change ((bits.cell root depth).lo.toRat : ℝ) ≤
    ((bits.cell root depth).hi.toRat : ℝ)
  exact_mod_cast (bits.cell root depth).le

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.intersection_nonempty
statement:
theorem intersection_nonempty (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) :
    (⋂ depth, (bits.cell root depth).toSet).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  apply IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_sequence_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed
  · intro depth x hx
    exact mem_cell_of_mem_succ hx
  · exact cell_nonempty root bits
  · simpa [IntervalDyadic.toSet] using
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (root.lo : ℝ) root.hi))
  · intro depth
    exact isClosed_Icc

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.intersection_subsingleton
statement:
theorem intersection_subsingleton (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) :
    (⋂ depth, (bits.cell root depth).toSet).Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  have hdist : ∀ depth,
      dist x y ≤ ((bits.cell root depth).width.toRat : ℝ) := by
    intro depth
    have hxCell := Set.mem_iInter.mp hx depth
    have hyCell := Set.mem_iInter.mp hy depth
    have h := Real.dist_le_of_mem_Icc hxCell hyCell
    simpa [IntervalDyadic.toSet, IntervalDyadic.width_toRat, Dyadic.toReal] using h
  have hzero : dist x y ≤ 0 :=
    ge_of_tendsto' (cell_width_tendsto_zero root bits) hdist
  exact dist_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hzero dist_nonneg)

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.exists_unique_limit
statement:
theorem exists_unique_limit (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath) :
    ∃! x : ℝ, ∀ depth, x ∈ bits.cell root depth
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := intersection_nonempty root bits
  refine ⟨x, Set.mem_iInter.mp hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact intersection_subsingleton root bits (Set.mem_iInter.mpr hy) hx

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.decode_mem_cell
statement:
theorem decode_mem_cell (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath)
    (depth : Nat) : bits.decode root ∈ bits.cell root depth
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_unique_limit root bits)).1 depth

name: LeanCert.Core.InfiniteDyadicPath.tendsto_decode_of_mem_cell
statement:
theorem tendsto_decode_of_mem_cell (root : IntervalDyadic) (bits : InfiniteDyadicPath)
    (points : Nat → ℝ) (hpoints : ∀ depth, points depth ∈ bits.cell root depth) :
    Filter.Tendsto points Filter.atTop (nhds (bits.decode root))
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
  apply squeeze_zero
  · exact fun _ => dist_nonneg
  · intro depth
    have h := Real.dist_le_of_mem_Icc (hpoints depth) (decode_mem_cell root bits depth)
    simpa [IntervalDyadic.toSet, Dyadic.toReal] using h
  · exact cell_real_width_tendsto_zero root bits

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_arg_pos
statement: theorem Real.atanh_arg_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) : 0 < (1 + x) / (1 - x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : -1 < x := by linarith [abs_lt.mp hx]
  have h2 : x < 1 := (abs_lt.mp hx).2
  have hnum : 0 < 1 + x := by linarith
  have hdenom : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  exact div_pos hnum hdenom

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.atanh_zero : Real.atanh 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Real.atanh, add_zero, sub_zero, div_one, Real.log_one, mul_zero]

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_neg
statement: theorem Real.atanh_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) : Real.atanh (-x) = -Real.atanh x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Real.atanh]
  have hlo : -1 < x := (abs_lt.mp hx).1
  have hhi : x < 1 := (abs_lt.mp hx).2
  have hpos1 : 0 < 1 + x := by linarith
  have hpos2 : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  have h1 : 1 + -x = 1 - x := by ring
  have h2 : 1 - -x = 1 + x := by ring
  rw [h1, h2]
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hpos2) (ne_of_gt hpos1)]
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hpos1) (ne_of_gt hpos2)]
  ring

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_strictMonoOn
statement: theorem Real.atanh_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn Real.atanh (Set.Ioo (-1) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Real.atanh]
  have hx1 : 0 < 1 + x := by linarith [hx.1]
  have hx2 : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith [hx.2]
  have hy1 : 0 < 1 + y := by linarith [hy.1]
  have hy2 : 0 < 1 - y := by linarith [hy.2]
  have hargx : 0 < (1 + x) / (1 - x) := div_pos hx1 hx2
  have hargy : 0 < (1 + y) / (1 - y) := div_pos hy1 hy2
  gcongr 1
  rw [Real.log_lt_log_iff hargx hargy]
  
  rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hx2 hy2]
  ring_nf
  linarith

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_mono
statement:
theorem Real.atanh_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) (hy : |y| < 1) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    Real.atanh x ≤ Real.atanh y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hxy.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · have hx' : x ∈ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨(abs_lt.mp hx).1, (abs_lt.mp hx).2⟩
    have hy' : y ∈ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨(abs_lt.mp hy).1, (abs_lt.mp hy).2⟩
    exact le_of_lt (Real.atanh_strictMonoOn hx' hy' hlt)
  · rw [heq]

name: LeanCert.Core.exp_neg_sq_pos
statement: private theorem exp_neg_sq_pos (t : ℝ) : 0 < Real.exp (-(t^2))
proof:
:=
  Real.exp_pos _

name: LeanCert.Core.intervalIntegrable_exp_neg_sq
statement:
private theorem intervalIntegrable_exp_neg_sq (a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => Real.exp (-(t^2))) MeasureTheory.volume a b
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
  exact Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_neg.comp (continuous_pow 2))

name: LeanCert.Core.integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2)) ≤ Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hgauss : ∫ t in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-(1:ℝ) * t^2) = Real.sqrt (Real.pi / 1) / 2 :=
    integral_gaussian_Ioi 1
  simp only [div_one] at hgauss
  
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx]
  
  
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => Real.exp (-(1:ℝ) * t^2)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)
  have hint_Ioi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => Real.exp (-(t^2))) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0)) := by
    have heq : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(t^2))) = (fun t => Real.exp (-(1:ℝ) * t^2)) := by
      funext t; ring_nf
    rw [heq]
    exact hint.restrict
  calc ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 x, Real.exp (-(t^2))
      ≤ ∫ t in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-(t^2)) := by
        apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hint_Ioi
        · 
          filter_upwards with t using le_of_lt (exp_neg_sq_pos t)
        · 
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht => Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self ht)
      _ = Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2 := by
        have heq : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(t^2))) = (fun t => Real.exp (-(1:ℝ) * t^2)) := by
          funext t; ring_nf
        rw [heq, hgauss]

name: LeanCert.Core.integral_exp_neg_sq_nonneg
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_neg_sq_nonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx]
  apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioc
  intro t _
  exact le_of_lt (exp_neg_sq_pos t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.erf_le_one
statement: theorem Real.erf_le_one (x : ℝ) : Real.erf x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold Real.erf
  by_cases! hx : 0 ≤ x
  · 
    have h1 : Real.sqrt Real.pi > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos
    have h2 : ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2)) ≤ Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2 :=
      integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian x hx
    calc (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2))
        ≤ (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2
          exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt h1)
        _ = 1 := by field_simp
  · 
    have h1 : Real.sqrt Real.pi > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos
    have hxle : x ≤ 0 := le_of_lt hx
    
    have h2 : ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2)) ≤ 0 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
      apply neg_nonpos.mpr
      
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hxle]
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioc
      intro t _
      exact le_of_lt (exp_neg_sq_pos t)
    calc (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2))
        ≤ (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * 0 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2
          exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt h1)
        _ = 0 := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 := by norm_num

name: LeanCert.Core.integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian'
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian' (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≤ 0) :
    ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-(t^2)) ≤ Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2
proof:
:= by
  
  have heq : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(t^2)) = Real.exp (-((-t)^2)) := fun t => by ring_nf
  have hsub : ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-(t^2)) = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..(-x), Real.exp (-(t^2)) := by
    calc ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-(t^2))
        = ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-((-t)^2)) := by simp only [neg_sq]
      _ = ∫ t in (-0:ℝ)..(-x), Real.exp (-(t^2)) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (fun t => Real.exp (-(t^2)))]
      _ = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..(-x), Real.exp (-(t^2)) := by simp only [neg_zero]
  rw [hsub]
  exact integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian (-x) (by linarith)

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.neg_one_le_erf
statement: theorem Real.neg_one_le_erf (x : ℝ) : -1 ≤ Real.erf x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Real.erf
  by_cases! hx : 0 ≤ x
  · 
    have h1 : Real.sqrt Real.pi > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2)) := integral_exp_neg_sq_nonneg x hx
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, Real.exp (-(t^2)) := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      · exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt h1)
      · exact h2
    linarith
  · 
    have h1 : Real.sqrt Real.pi > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos
    have hxle : x ≤ 0 := le_of_lt hx
    
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
    have h2 : ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-(t^2)) ≤ Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2 :=
      integral_exp_neg_sq_le_half_gaussian' x hxle
    
    
    
    
    have h3 : (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-(t^2)) ≤ 1 := by
      calc (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * ∫ t in x..(0:ℝ), Real.exp (-(t^2))
          ≤ (2 / Real.sqrt Real.pi) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2
            exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt h1)
          _ = 1 := by field_simp
    linarith

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.erf_mem_Icc
statement: theorem Real.erf_mem_Icc (x : ℝ) : Real.erf x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨Real.neg_one_le_erf x, Real.erf_le_one x⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.sinc_mem_Icc

proof:

  ⟨Real.neg_one_le_sinc x, Real.sinc_le_one x⟩

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_tanh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_tanh (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (tanh e) = Real.tanh (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sqrt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sqrt (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (sqrt e) = Real.sqrt (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_namedConst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_namedConst (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (c : MathConst) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_eulerMascheroni

theorem eval_eulerMascheroni (ρ : Nat → ℝ) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sub (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e₁ e₂ : Expr) :
    eval ρ (sub e₁ e₂) = eval ρ e₁ - eval ρ e₂
proof: := by simp [sub, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_div (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e₁ e₂ : Expr) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_pow (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (n : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pow]
  | succ n ih => simp only [pow, eval_mul, ih, pow_succ']

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_abs
statement:
theorem eval_abs (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) :

proof:
:= by
  simp only [abs, eval_sqrt, eval_mul, ← sq, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs
statement:
theorem eval_sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) :

proof: := eval_abs ρ e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs
statement: theorem sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs (x : ℝ) : Real.sqrt (x * x) = |x|
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs x

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sqrt_sq_of_pos
statement:
theorem eval_sqrt_sq_of_pos (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (hpos : 0 < eval ρ e) :

proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_sqrt, eval_mul, ← sq, Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt hpos)]

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_abs_of_pos
statement:
theorem eval_abs_of_pos (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (hpos : 0 < eval ρ e) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_abs_of_neg
statement:
theorem eval_abs_of_neg (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (hneg : eval ρ e < 0) :

:= by

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_eq
statement:
theorem evalAlong_eq (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) (t : ℝ) :
    evalAlong e ρ idx t = eval (ρ[idx ↦ t]) e
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_at_ρ
statement:
theorem evalAlong_at_ρ (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong e ρ idx (ρ idx) = eval ρ e
proof:
:= by

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_const'
statement:
theorem evalAlong_const' (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) (q : ℚ) :
    evalAlong (const q) ρ idx = fun _ => (q : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_var_active
statement:
theorem evalAlong_var_active (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (var idx) ρ idx = id
proof:
:= by
  funext t

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_var_passive
statement:
theorem evalAlong_var_passive (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx i : Nat) (h : i ≠ idx) :

proof:
:= by
  funext t
  simp only [evalAlong, eval_var, updateVar_other _ _ _ _ h]

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_add
statement:
theorem evalAlong_add (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (add e₁ e₂) ρ idx = fun t => evalAlong e₁ ρ idx t + evalAlong e₂ ρ idx t
proof:

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_add_pi
statement:
theorem evalAlong_add_pi (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_mul
statement:
theorem evalAlong_mul (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (mul e₁ e₂) ρ idx = fun t => evalAlong e₁ ρ idx t * evalAlong e₂ ρ idx t
proof:

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_mul_pi
statement:
theorem evalAlong_mul_pi (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

proof: := rfl

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_neg
statement:
theorem evalAlong_neg (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_neg_pi
statement:
theorem evalAlong_neg_pi (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_sin
statement:
theorem evalAlong_sin (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_cos
statement:
theorem evalAlong_cos (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_exp
statement:
theorem evalAlong_exp (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_inv
statement:
theorem evalAlong_inv (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_log
statement:
theorem evalAlong_log (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_atan
statement:
theorem evalAlong_atan (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_arsinh
statement:
theorem evalAlong_arsinh (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_atanh
statement:
theorem evalAlong_atanh (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
