    (I : IntervalRat) (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : ξ ∈ I) :
    deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0
proof:
:=
  derivInterval_correct_single e hsupp hvar0 I ξ hξ

name: LeanCert.Engine.mvt_for_eval
statement:
theorem mvt_for_eval (e : Expr) (hsupp : ADSupported e)
    (I : IntervalRat) (c x : ℝ) (_hcI : c ∈ I) (_hxI : x ∈ I) (hcx : c ≠ x) :
    ∃ ξ, (min c x < ξ ∧ ξ < max c x) ∧
      evalFunc1 e x - evalFunc1 e c = deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ * (x - c)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff := evalFunc1_differentiable e hsupp
  
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (evalFunc1 e) (Set.Icc (min c x) (max c x)) :=
    hdiff.continuous.continuousOn
  have hdiffOn : DifferentiableOn ℝ (evalFunc1 e) (Set.Ioo (min c x) (max c x)) :=
    hdiff.differentiableOn
  have hlt : min c x < max c x := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy c x with hlt | heq | hgt
    · simp [min_eq_left hlt.le, max_eq_right hlt.le, hlt]
    · exact absurd heq hcx
    · simp [min_eq_right hgt.le, max_eq_left hgt.le, hgt]
  
  rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope (evalFunc1 e) hlt hcont hdiffOn with ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_eq⟩
  use ξ
  constructor
  · exact hξ_mem
  · 
    
    rcases le_or_gt c x with hcx_le | hcx_gt
    · 
      have hmin : min c x = c := min_eq_left hcx_le
      have hmax : max c x = x := max_eq_right hcx_le
      rw [hmin, hmax] at hξ_eq
      
      have hxc_ne : x - c ≠ 0 := by
        intro heq
        have : x = c := by linarith
        exact hcx this.symm
      field_simp [hxc_ne] at hξ_eq
      linarith
    · 
      have hmin : min c x = x := min_eq_right hcx_gt.le
      have hmax : max c x = c := max_eq_left hcx_gt.le
      rw [hmin, hmax] at hξ_eq
      
      have hcx_ne : c - x ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp [hcx_ne] at hξ_eq
      
      
      linarith

name: LeanCert.Engine.between_mem_interval
statement:
theorem between_mem_interval (I : IntervalRat) (c x ξ : ℝ)
    (hcI : c ∈ I) (hxI : x ∈ I) (hξ_between : min c x < ξ ∧ ξ < max c x) :
    ξ ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hcI hxI ⊢
  constructor
  · have h1 : (I.lo : ℝ) ≤ min c x := le_min hcI.1 hxI.1
    linarith [hξ_between.1]
  · have h2 : max c x ≤ (I.hi : ℝ) := max_le hcI.2 hxI.2
    linarith [hξ_between.2]

name: LeanCert.Engine.newton_operator_preserves_root
statement:
theorem newton_operator_preserves_root (e : Expr) (hsupp : ADSupported e) (_hvar0 : UsesOnlyVar0 e)
    (I : IntervalRat) (c : ℚ) (fc dI : IntervalRat)
    (hc_in_I : (c : ℝ) ∈ I)
    (hfc : evalFunc1 e c ∈ fc)
    (hdI : ∀ ξ ∈ I, deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ dI)
    (hdI_nonzero : ¬IntervalRat.containsZero dI)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I) (hroot : evalFunc1 e x = 0) :
    
    let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero
proof:
:=
      { lo := dI.lo, hi := dI.hi, le := dI.le, nonzero := hdI_nonzero }
    let dInv := IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero
    let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc dInv
    let Newton : IntervalRat := { lo := c - Q.hi, hi := c - Q.lo, le := by linarith [Q.le] }
    x ∈ Newton := by
  intro dNonzero dInv Q Newton
  
  by_cases hxc : x = c
  · 
    subst hxc
    
    
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
    
    have hfc_zero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ fc := by simp only [hroot] at hfc; exact hfc
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hfc_zero
    
    have hQ_zero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Q := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) = 0 * (dInv.lo : ℝ) := by ring
      rw [this]
      apply IntervalRat.mem_mul
      · simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
        exact ⟨hfc_zero.1, hfc_zero.2⟩
      · simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
        constructor
        · exact le_refl _
        · exact_mod_cast dInv.le
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hQ_zero
    
    
    
    
    
    simp only [Newton]  
    simp only [Rat.cast_sub]  
    constructor
    · 
      linarith [hQ_zero.2]
    · 
      linarith [hQ_zero.1]
  · 
    
    have hmvt := mvt_for_eval e hsupp I c x hc_in_I hx (Ne.symm hxc)
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_between, hξ_eq⟩ := hmvt
    
    have hξ_in_I : ξ ∈ I := between_mem_interval I c x ξ hc_in_I hx hξ_between
    
    have hderiv_in_dI : deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ dI := hdI ξ hξ_in_I
    
    
    have hfc_val : evalFunc1 e c = deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ * (c - x) := by
      have : evalFunc1 e x - evalFunc1 e c = deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ * (x - c) := hξ_eq
      simp only [hroot, zero_sub] at this
      linarith
    
    have hderiv_ne : deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hcontra
      have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ dI := by rw [← hcontra]; exact hderiv_in_dI
      simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hmem
      have hcz := hdI_nonzero
      simp only [IntervalRat.containsZero, not_and, not_le] at hcz
      rcases le_or_gt dI.lo 0 with hlo | hlo
      · have hhi := hcz hlo
        have hhi_cast : (dI.hi : ℝ) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hhi
        linarith
      · have hlo_cast : (dI.lo : ℝ) > 0 := by exact_mod_cast hlo
        linarith
    
    have hx_eq : x = c - evalFunc1 e c / deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ := by
      field_simp [hderiv_ne] at hfc_val ⊢
      linarith
    
    
    
    
    
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
    rw [hx_eq]
    
    
    have hquot_in_Q : evalFunc1 e c / deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ Q := by
      have hinv : (deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ)⁻¹ ∈ dInv := by
        apply IntervalRat.mem_invNonzero
        · exact hderiv_in_dI
        · exact hderiv_ne
      have : evalFunc1 e c / deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ = evalFunc1 e c * (deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp
      rw [this]
      exact IntervalRat.mem_mul hfc hinv
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hquot_in_Q
    
    
    
    
    simp only [Newton]  
    simp only [Rat.cast_sub]  
    constructor
    · 
      linarith [hquot_in_Q.2]
    · 
      linarith [hquot_in_Q.1]

name: LeanCert.Engine.newton_preserves_root
statement:
theorem newton_preserves_root (e : Expr) (hsupp : ADSupported e) (hvar0 : UsesOnlyVar0 e)
    (I N : IntervalRat)
    (hN : newtonStepTM e I 0 1 = some N ∨ newtonStepSimple e I 0 = some N)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I) (hroot : Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e = 0) :
    x ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hroot' : evalFunc1 e x = 0 := hroot
  rcases hN with hTM | hSimple
  · 
    
    
    simp only [newtonStepTM] at hTM
    
    cases htm : TaylorModel.fromExpr? e I 1 with
    | none =>
      
      simp only [htm, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_none, reduceCtorEq] at hTM
    | some tm =>
      simp only [htm] at hTM
      
      set dI := derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0 with hdI_def
      
      have hzero : ¬IntervalRat.containsZero dI := by
        intro hcontra
        by_cases h : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
        · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_fun_none,
          reduceCtorEq] at hTM
        · exact h hcontra
      
      let c : ℚ := tm.center
      let fc := TaylorModel.valueAtCenterInterval tm
      let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero :=
        { lo := dI.lo, hi := dI.hi, le := dI.le, nonzero := hzero }
      let dInv := IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero
      let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc dInv
      let Newton : IntervalRat := { lo := c - Q.hi, hi := c - Q.lo, le := by linarith [Q.le] }
      
      have hTM' : IntervalRat.intersect I Newton = some N := by
        by_cases h : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
        · exact absurd h hzero
        · simp only [h] at hTM
          convert! hTM using 2
      
      have hc_eq : c = I.midpoint := fromExpr?_center e I 1 tm htm
      
      have hc_in_I : (c : ℝ) ∈ I := by
        rw [hc_eq]
        exact IntervalRat.midpoint_mem I
      
      have hfc_correct : evalFunc1 e c ∈ fc := by
        simp only [fc, evalFunc1]
        
        have hEvalSet := fromExpr_evalSet_correct e I 1 tm htm
        have hDomain := fromExpr?_domain e I 1 tm htm
        have hc_in_domain : (c : ℝ) ∈ tm.domain := by
          rw [hDomain]
          rw [hc_eq]
          exact IntervalRat.midpoint_mem I
        exact TaylorModel.valueAtCenter_correct tm (fun y => Expr.eval (fun _ => y) e)
          (hDomain.symm ▸ hEvalSet) hc_in_domain
      have hdI_correct : ∀ ξ ∈ I, deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ dI := by
        intro ξ hξ
        simp only [hdI_def]
        exact deriv_in_derivInterval e hsupp hvar0 I ξ hξ
      
      have hx_in_Newton : x ∈ Newton := by
        have := newton_operator_preserves_root e hsupp hvar0 I c fc dI hc_in_I hfc_correct hdI_correct hzero x hx hroot'
        simp only [Newton, Q, dInv, dNonzero]
        convert this using 2
      
      have hx_in_intersect := IntervalRat.mem_intersect hx hx_in_Newton
      obtain ⟨K, hK_eq, hx_in_K⟩ := hx_in_intersect
      
      have hN_eq_K : N = K := by
        rw [hTM'] at hK_eq
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hK_eq
        exact hK_eq
      rw [hN_eq_K]
      exact hx_in_K
  · 
    
    
    
    set c : ℚ := I.midpoint with hc_def
    set fc := LeanCert.Internal.Rational.evalUnchecked1 e (IntervalRat.singleton c) with hfc_def
    set dI := derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0 with hdI_def
    have hzero : ¬IntervalRat.containsZero dI := by
      intro hcontra
      
      simp only [newtonStepSimple] at hSimple
      
      by_cases h : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
      · 
        simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, reduceCtorEq] at hSimple
      · 
        
        exact h hcontra
    
    let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero :=
      { lo := dI.lo, hi := dI.hi, le := dI.le, nonzero := hzero }
    let dInv := IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero
    let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc dInv
    let Newton : IntervalRat := { lo := c - Q.hi, hi := c - Q.lo, le := by linarith [Q.le] }
    
    have hSimple' : IntervalRat.intersect I Newton = some N := by
      simp only [newtonStepSimple] at hSimple
      
      by_cases h : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
      · 
        exact absurd h hzero
      · 
        simp only [h] at hSimple
        
        
        convert! hSimple using 2
    
    have hc_in_I : (c : ℝ) ∈ I := IntervalRat.midpoint_mem I
    have hfc_correct : evalFunc1 e c ∈ fc := by
      simp only [hfc_def, evalFunc1]
      exact evalInterval1_correct e hsupp c (IntervalRat.singleton c) (IntervalRat.mem_singleton c)
    have hdI_correct : ∀ ξ ∈ I, deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ dI := by
      intro ξ hξ
      simp only [hdI_def]
      exact deriv_in_derivInterval e hsupp hvar0 I ξ hξ
    
    have hx_in_Newton : x ∈ Newton := by
      have := newton_operator_preserves_root e hsupp hvar0 I c fc dI hc_in_I hfc_correct hdI_correct hzero x hx hroot'
      simp only [Newton, Q, dInv, dNonzero]
      convert this using 2
    
    have hx_in_intersect := IntervalRat.mem_intersect hx hx_in_Newton
    obtain ⟨K, hK_eq, hx_in_K⟩ := hx_in_intersect
    
    have hN_eq_K : N = K := by
      rw [hSimple'] at hK_eq
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hK_eq
      exact hK_eq
    rw [hN_eq_K]
    exact hx_in_K

name: LeanCert.Engine.newton_step_at_most_one_root
statement:
theorem newton_step_at_most_one_root (e : Expr) (hsupp : ADSupported e) (hvar0 : UsesOnlyVar0 e)
    (I : IntervalRat)
    (hN : (∃ N, newtonStepTM e I 0 1 = some N) ∨ (∃ N, newtonStepSimple e I 0 = some N))
    (hCont : ContinuousOn (fun x => Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e) (Set.Icc I.lo I.hi))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I) (hy : y ∈ I)
    (hx_root : Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e = 0) (hy_root : Expr.eval (fun _ => y) e = 0) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  
  have hzero : ¬IntervalRat.containsZero (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0) := by
    rcases hN with ⟨N, hTM⟩ | ⟨N, hSimple⟩
    · simp only [newtonStepTM] at hTM
      cases htm : TaylorModel.fromExpr? e I 1 with
      | none => simp only [htm, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_none, reduceCtorEq] at hTM;
      | some tm =>
        simp only [htm] at hTM
        by_cases h : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
        · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_fun_none,
          reduceCtorEq] at hTM
        · exact h
    · simp only [newtonStepSimple] at hSimple
      by_cases h : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
      · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, reduceCtorEq] at hSimple
      · exact h
  
  have hmvt := deriv_in_derivInterval e hsupp hvar0 I
  simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hx hy
  
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
  · 
    have hIcc_sub : Set.Icc x y ⊆ Set.Icc (I.lo : ℝ) I.hi := by
      intro z ⟨hzlo, hzhi⟩
      constructor
      · linarith [hx.1]
      · linarith [hy.2]
    have hCont' : ContinuousOn (evalFunc1 e) (Set.Icc x y) := hCont.mono hIcc_sub
    have hf_eq : evalFunc1 e x = evalFunc1 e y := by
      simp only [evalFunc1]
      rw [hx_root, hy_root]
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_deriv⟩ := @exists_deriv_eq_zero (evalFunc1 e) x y hlt hCont' hf_eq
    have hξ_in_I : ξ ∈ I := by
      simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
      constructor
      · linarith [hx.1, hξ_mem.1]
      · linarith [hy.2, hξ_mem.2]
    have hderiv_in := hmvt ξ hξ_in_I
    rw [hξ_deriv] at hderiv_in
    simp only [IntervalRat.containsZero] at hzero
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hderiv_in
    simp only [not_and_or, not_le] at hzero
    rcases hzero with hlo_pos | hhi_neg
    · have hcast : (0 : ℝ) < (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).lo := by exact_mod_cast hlo_pos
      linarith [hderiv_in.1, hcast]
    · have hcast : ((derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).hi : ℝ) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hhi_neg
      linarith [hderiv_in.2, hcast]
  · 
    have hIcc_sub : Set.Icc y x ⊆ Set.Icc (I.lo : ℝ) I.hi := by
      intro z ⟨hzlo, hzhi⟩
      constructor
      · linarith [hy.1]
      · linarith [hx.2]
    have hCont' : ContinuousOn (evalFunc1 e) (Set.Icc y x) := hCont.mono hIcc_sub
    have hf_eq : evalFunc1 e y = evalFunc1 e x := by
      simp only [evalFunc1]
      rw [hy_root, hx_root]
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_deriv⟩ := @exists_deriv_eq_zero (evalFunc1 e) y x hlt hCont' hf_eq
    have hξ_in_I : ξ ∈ I := by
      simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
      constructor
      · linarith [hy.1, hξ_mem.1]
      · linarith [hx.2, hξ_mem.2]
    have hderiv_in := hmvt ξ hξ_in_I
    rw [hξ_deriv] at hderiv_in
    simp only [IntervalRat.containsZero] at hzero
    simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hderiv_in
    simp only [not_and_or, not_le] at hzero
    rcases hzero with hlo_pos | hhi_neg
    · have hcast : (0 : ℝ) < (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).lo := by exact_mod_cast hlo_pos
      linarith [hderiv_in.1, hcast]
    · have hcast : ((derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).hi : ℝ) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hhi_neg
      linarith [hderiv_in.2, hcast]

name: LeanCert.Engine.contraction_newton_bounds
statement:
lemma contraction_newton_bounds {I N : IntervalRat} {c : ℚ} {Q : IntervalRat}
    (hContract : N.lo > I.lo ∧ N.hi < I.hi)
    (hN_lo : N.lo = max I.lo (c - Q.hi))
    (hN_hi : N.hi = min I.hi (c - Q.lo)) :
    N.lo = c - Q.hi ∧ N.hi = c - Q.lo
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    
    
    
    by_cases! h : I.lo ≤ c - Q.hi
    · simp only [max_eq_right h, hN_lo]
    · have hmax_eq : max I.lo (c - Q.hi) = I.lo := max_eq_left (le_of_lt h)
      rw [hN_lo, hmax_eq] at hContract
      exact absurd hContract.1 (lt_irrefl I.lo)
  · 
    
    
    
    by_cases! h : c - Q.lo ≤ I.hi
    · 
      simp only [min_eq_right h, hN_hi]
    · have hmin_eq : min I.hi (c - Q.lo) = I.hi := min_eq_left (le_of_lt h)
      rw [hN_hi, hmin_eq] at hContract
      exact absurd hContract.2 (lt_irrefl I.hi)

name: LeanCert.Engine.newtonStepSimple_extract
statement:
lemma newtonStepSimple_extract (e : Expr) (I N : IntervalRat)
    (hSimple : newtonStepSimple e I 0 = some N) :
    let c
proof:
:= I.midpoint
    let fc := LeanCert.Internal.Rational.evalUnchecked1 e (IntervalRat.singleton c)
    let dI := derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0
    ∃ (hdI_nonzero : ¬dI.containsZero),
      let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero := ⟨dI, hdI_nonzero⟩
      let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc (IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero)
      N.lo = max I.lo (c - Q.hi) ∧ N.hi = min I.hi (c - Q.lo) := by
  
  unfold newtonStepSimple at hSimple
  
  by_cases hzero : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
  · 
    simp only [hzero, ↓reduceDIte, reduceCtorEq] at hSimple
  · 
    simp only [hzero, dite_false] at hSimple
    use hzero
    
    
    
    simp only [IntervalRat.intersect] at hSimple
    
    
    split at hSimple
    · 
      rename_i hintersect
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hSimple
      constructor
      · 
        exact congrArg IntervalRat.lo hSimple.symm
      · 
        exact congrArg IntervalRat.hi hSimple.symm
    · 
      simp only [reduceCtorEq] at hSimple

name: LeanCert.Engine.newtonStepTM_structure
statement:
lemma newtonStepTM_structure (e : Expr) (I N : IntervalRat)
    (hTM : newtonStepTM e I 0 1 = some N) :
    ∃ (tm : TaylorModel) (hdI_nonzero : ¬(derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero),
      TaylorModel.fromExpr? e I 1 = some tm ∧
      tm.center = I.midpoint ∧
      let c
proof:
:= I.midpoint
      let fc := TaylorModel.valueAtCenterInterval tm
      let dI := derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0
      let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero := ⟨dI, hdI_nonzero⟩
      let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc (IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero)
      N.lo = max I.lo (c - Q.hi) ∧ N.hi = min I.hi (c - Q.lo) := by
  
  unfold newtonStepTM at hTM
  
  match hFrom : TaylorModel.fromExpr? e I 1 with
  | none =>
      
      simp only [bind, Option.bind, hFrom, reduceCtorEq] at hTM
  | some tm =>
      
      simp only [hFrom, bind, Option.bind] at hTM
      
      by_cases hzero : (derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0).containsZero
      · 
        simp only [dite_eq_left hzero, reduceCtorEq] at hTM
      · 
        simp only [dite_eq_right hzero] at hTM
        
        have hcenter := fromExpr?_center e I 1 tm hFrom
        refine ⟨tm, hzero, rfl, hcenter, ?_⟩
        
        
        
        simp only [IntervalRat.intersect] at hTM
        split at hTM
        · 
          rename_i hintersect
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hTM
          
          have hN_lo := congrArg IntervalRat.lo hTM.symm
          have hN_hi := congrArg IntervalRat.hi hTM.symm
          simp only at hN_lo hN_hi
          
          rw [hcenter] at hN_lo hN_hi
          exact ⟨hN_lo, hN_hi⟩
        · 
          simp only [reduceCtorEq] at hTM

name: LeanCert.Engine.newtonStepTM_fc_correct
statement:
lemma newtonStepTM_fc_correct (e : Expr) (I : IntervalRat)
    (tm : TaylorModel) (htmeq : TaylorModel.fromExpr? e I 1 = some tm) :
    let c
proof:
:= I.midpoint
    let fc := TaylorModel.valueAtCenterInterval tm
    evalFunc1 e c ∈ fc := by
  simp only
  
  have hdomain := fromExpr?_domain e I 1 tm htmeq
  
  have heval : ∀ x ∈ I, Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e ∈ tm.evalSet x :=
    fromExpr_evalSet_correct e I 1 tm htmeq
  
  have heval' : ∀ x ∈ tm.domain, Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e ∈ tm.evalSet x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hdomain] at hx
    exact heval x hx
  
  have hc_eq := fromExpr?_center e I 1 tm htmeq
  
  have hc_in_domain : (tm.center : ℝ) ∈ tm.domain := by
    rw [hdomain]
    rw [hc_eq]
    exact IntervalRat.midpoint_mem I
  
  have hfc_correct := TaylorModel.valueAtCenter_correct tm (fun x => Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e) heval' hc_in_domain
  simp only [evalFunc1]
  
  rw [hc_eq] at hfc_correct
  exact hfc_correct

name: LeanCert.Engine.TableCert.row_checked_of_list_all
proof:
:= by
  exact (List.all_eq_true.mp hall) row hmem

name: LeanCert.Engine.TableCert.verify
statement:
theorem verify
    {Claim : Row → Prop} {checker : Row → Bool} (T : TableCert Row)
    (hsound : ∀ row, checker row = true → Claim row)
    (hall : T.checkAll checker = true) :
    ∀ row, row ∈ T.rows.toList → Claim row
proof:
:= by
  intro row hmem
  exact hsound row (row_checked_of_list_all hall hmem)

name: LeanCert.Engine.adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacentList
statement:
theorem adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacentList
    {Rel : Row → Row → Prop} {rel : Row → Row → Bool}
    (hsound : ∀ a b, rel a b = true → Rel a b) :
    ∀ {rows : List Row},
      checkAdjacentList rel rows = true → AdjacentAll Rel rows
  | [], _ => AdjacentAll.nil
  | [_], _ => AdjacentAll.singleton _
  | a :: b :: rest, hcheck => by
      simp only [checkAdjacentList] at hcheck
      have hab : rel a b = true
proof:
:= by
        cases h : rel a b <;> simp [h] at hcheck ⊢
      have htail : checkAdjacentList rel (b :: rest) = true := by
        cases h : rel a b <;> simp [h] at hcheck
        exact hcheck
      exact AdjacentAll.cons (hsound a b hab)
        (adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacentList hsound htail)

name: LeanCert.Engine.adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacent
statement:
theorem adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacent
    {Rel : Row → Row → Prop} {rel : Row → Row → Bool} {rows : Array Row}
    (hsound : ∀ a b, rel a b = true → Rel a b)
    (hcheck : checkAdjacent rows rel = true) :
    AdjacentAll Rel rows.toList
proof:
:=
  adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacentList hsound hcheck

name: LeanCert.Engine.linkedRows_of_checkLinkedRows
statement:
theorem linkedRows_of_checkLinkedRows
    {rows : Array Row} {key nextKey : Row → Key} {eqKey : Key → Key → Bool}
    (heq : ∀ a b, eqKey a b = true → a = b)
    (hcheck : checkLinkedRows rows key nextKey eqKey = true) :
    AdjacentAll (fun current following => nextKey current = key following) rows.toList
proof:
:= by
  exact adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacent
    (fun current following h =>
      heq (nextKey current) (key following) h)
    hcheck

name: LeanCert.Engine.adjacentIncreasing_of_checkStrictlyIncreasingBy
statement:
theorem adjacentIncreasing_of_checkStrictlyIncreasingBy
    [LT Key] [DecidableRel (fun a b : Key => a < b)]
    {rows : Array Row} {key : Row → Key}
    (hcheck : checkStrictlyIncreasingBy rows key = true) :
    AdjacentAll (fun current following => key current < key following) rows.toList
proof:
:= by
  exact adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacent
    (fun current following h => of_decide_eq_true h)
    hcheck

name: LeanCert.Engine.boundPolyAbs_nonneg
statement:
theorem boundPolyAbs_nonneg (p : Polynomial ℚ) (domain : IntervalRat) (c : ℚ) :
    0 ≤ boundPolyAbs p domain c
proof:
:= by
  unfold boundPolyAbs
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  apply mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)
  apply pow_nonneg
  exact le_max_of_le_left (abs_nonneg _)

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_foldl_le
statement:
theorem listMinMax_foldl_le (l : List ℚ) (p : ℚ × ℚ) (hp : p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    (l.foldl (fun (lo, hi) x => (min lo x, max hi x)) p).1 ≤
    (l.foldl (fun (lo, hi) x => (min lo x, max hi x)) p).2
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p with
  | nil => exact hp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    calc min p.1 x ≤ p.1 := min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ p.2 := hp
      _ ≤ max p.2 x := le_max_left _ _

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_le
statement: theorem listMinMax_le (l : List ℚ) (d : ℚ) : (listMinMax l d).1 ≤ (listMinMax l d).2
proof:
:= by
  unfold listMinMax
  exact listMinMax_foldl_le l (d, d) (le_refl d)

name: LeanCert.Engine.transformPolyCoeffs_zero
statement:
private theorem transformPolyCoeffs_zero (α β : ℚ) :
    transformPolyCoeffs 0 α β = [0]
proof:
:= by
  unfold transformPolyCoeffs
  simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_zero, Polynomial.coeff_zero, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero]
  rfl

name: LeanCert.Engine.boundPolyBernstein_zero_poly
statement:
theorem boundPolyBernstein_zero_poly (domain : IntervalRat) (c : ℚ) :
    (boundPolyBernstein 0 domain c).lo ≤ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (boundPolyBernstein 0 domain c).hi
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeffs : bernsteinCoeffsForDomain 0 domain.lo domain.hi c = [0] := by
    simp only [bernsteinCoeffsForDomain, transformPolyCoeffs_zero]
    
    simp only [monomialToBernstein, List.length_cons, List.length_nil,
      Nat.add_one_sub_one, Nat.not_lt_zero, ite_false]
    simp only [binomialRat]
    norm_num
  simp only [boundPolyBernstein, hcoeffs]
  simp only [listMinMax, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, min_self, max_self]
  exact ⟨le_refl 0, le_refl 0⟩

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_init
statement:
private theorem listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_init (l : List ℚ) (p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    (l.foldl (fun (lo, hi) x => (min lo x, max hi x)) p).1 ≤ p.1
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p with
  | nil => exact le_refl _
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    calc (as.foldl _ (min p.1 a, max p.2 a)).1 ≤ min p.1 a := ih _
      _ ≤ p.1 := min_le_left _ _

name: LeanCert.Engine.init_le_listMinMax_foldl_hi
statement:
private theorem init_le_listMinMax_foldl_hi (l : List ℚ) (p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    p.2 ≤ (l.foldl (fun (lo, hi) x => (min lo x, max hi x)) p).2
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p with
  | nil => exact le_refl _
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    calc p.2 ≤ max p.2 a := le_max_left _ _
      _ ≤ (as.foldl _ (min p.1 a, max p.2 a)).2 := ih _

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_elem
statement:
private theorem listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_elem (l : List ℚ) (p : ℚ × ℚ) (x : ℚ) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    (l.foldl (fun (lo, hi) y => (min lo y, max hi y)) p).1 ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with heq | hmem
    · rw [heq]
      exact le_trans (listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_init as _) (min_le_right p.1 a)
    · exact ih _ hmem

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_foldl_elem_le_hi
statement:
private theorem listMinMax_foldl_elem_le_hi (l : List ℚ) (p : ℚ × ℚ) (x : ℚ) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    x ≤ (l.foldl (fun (lo, hi) y => (min lo y, max hi y)) p).2
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing p with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with heq | hmem
    · rw [heq]
      exact le_trans (le_max_right p.2 a) (init_le_listMinMax_foldl_hi as _)
    · exact ih _ hmem

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_bounds_elem
statement:
theorem listMinMax_bounds_elem (l : List ℚ) (d : ℚ) (x : ℚ) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    (listMinMax l d).1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ (listMinMax l d).2
proof:
:= by
  unfold listMinMax
  exact ⟨listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_elem l (d, d) x hx,
         listMinMax_foldl_elem_le_hi l (d, d) x hx⟩

name: LeanCert.Engine.listMinMax_bounds_default
statement:
theorem listMinMax_bounds_default (l : List ℚ) (d : ℚ) :
    (listMinMax l d).1 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ (listMinMax l d).2
proof:
:= by
  unfold listMinMax
  constructor
  · exact le_trans (listMinMax_foldl_lo_le_init l _) (le_refl d)
  · exact le_trans (le_refl d) (init_le_listMinMax_foldl_hi l _)

name: LeanCert.Engine.weighted_sum_le_sup
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_le_sup {n : ℕ} (a w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hw_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hw_sum : Finset.univ.sum w = 1)
    (ha_le : ∀ k, a k ≤ M) :
    Finset.univ.sum (fun k => a k * w k) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  calc Finset.univ.sum (fun k => a k * w k)
      ≤ Finset.univ.sum (fun k => M * w k) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro k _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ha_le k) (hw_nn k)
    _ = M * Finset.univ.sum w := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = M := by rw [hw_sum, mul_one]

name: LeanCert.Engine.inf_le_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem inf_le_weighted_sum {n : ℕ} (a w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hw_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hw_sum : Finset.univ.sum w = 1)
    (hm_le : ∀ k, m ≤ a k) :
    m ≤ Finset.univ.sum (fun k => a k * w k)
proof:
:= by
  calc m = m * 1 := (mul_one m).symm
    _ = m * Finset.univ.sum w := by rw [hw_sum]
    _ = Finset.univ.sum (fun k => m * w k) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ Finset.univ.sum (fun k => a k * w k) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro k _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hm_le k) (hw_nn k)

name: LeanCert.Engine.choose_mul_choose_eq
statement:
theorem choose_mul_choose_eq {n k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Nat.choose k j * Nat.choose n k = Nat.choose n j * Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j)
proof:
:= by
  have hjn : j ≤ n := le_trans hj hk
  have hkj : k - j ≤ n - j := Nat.sub_le_sub_right hk j
  have hnk : n - j - (k - j) = n - k := by omega
  have lhs1 := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hj
  have lhs2 := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hk
  have rhs1 := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hjn
  have rhs2 := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hkj
  rw [hnk] at rhs2
  
  have hfact_pos : 0 < Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (k - j) *
      Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k) := by positivity
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hfact_pos
  
  have hlhs : Nat.choose k j * Nat.choose n k *
      (Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (k - j) * Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k)) =
      Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial n := by
    calc Nat.choose k j * Nat.choose n k *
        (Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (k - j) * Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k))
        = (Nat.choose k j * Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (k - j)) *
          (Nat.choose n k * Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k)) := by ring
      _ = Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial n := by rw [lhs1, lhs2]
  
  
  have hrhs : Nat.choose n j * Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) *
      (Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (k - j) * Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k)) =
      Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial n := by
    calc Nat.choose n j * Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) *
        (Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (k - j) * Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k))
        = (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) * Nat.factorial (k - j) * Nat.factorial (n - k)) *
          (Nat.choose n j * Nat.factorial j) * Nat.factorial k := by ring
      _ = Nat.factorial (n - j) * (Nat.choose n j * Nat.factorial j) * Nat.factorial k := by
          rw [rhs2]
      _ = (Nat.choose n j * Nat.factorial j * Nat.factorial (n - j)) * Nat.factorial k := by ring
      _ = Nat.factorial n * Nat.factorial k := by rw [rhs1]
      _ = Nat.factorial k * Nat.factorial n := by ring
  linarith

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernstein_partition_of_unity
statement:
theorem bernstein_partition_of_unity (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_pow t (1 - t) n
  have h1 : t + (1 - t) = (1 : ℝ) := by ring
  rw [h1, one_pow] at h
  
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 2; ext k
    rw [show (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k) =
        t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k) * (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) from by ring]
  linarith

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernstein_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernstein_nonneg (n k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (Nat.choose n k)
    · exact pow_nonneg ht0 k
  · exact pow_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - t) (n - k)

name: LeanCert.Engine.monomial_bernstein_expansion
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : t + (1 - t) = (1 : ℝ) := by ring
  have hstart : t ^ j = t ^ j * (t + (1 - t)) ^ (n - j) := by
    rw [h1, one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [hstart]
  
  rw [add_pow t (1 - t) (n - j)]
  
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  
  
  
  
  have hsplit : (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
      else 0) =
    (Finset.range (n - j + 1)).sum (fun m =>
      (Nat.choose (n - j) m : ℝ) * t ^ (m + j) * (1 - t) ^ (n - j - m)) := by
    
    rw [show n + 1 = j + (n + 1 - j) from by omega]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
    
    have hfirst : (Finset.range j).sum (fun k =>
        if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
        else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      simp only [show ¬(j ≤ k) from by omega, ite_false]
    rw [hfirst, zero_add]
    
    
    
    rw [show n + 1 - j = n - j + 1 from by omega]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
    have hjle : j ≤ j + m := Nat.le_add_right j m
    rw [ite_eq_left hjle]
    have h1 : j + m - j = m := by omega
    have h2 : n - (j + m) = n - j - m := by omega
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
  
  
  rw [pow_add t m j]
  ring

name: LeanCert.Engine.poly_aeval_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

name: LeanCert.Engine.monomialToBernstein_length
statement:
theorem monomialToBernstein_length (qs : List ℚ) (hn : 0 < qs.length) :
    (monomialToBernstein qs).length = qs.length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomialToBernstein]
  have : ¬ (qs.length - 1 < 0) := by omega
  simp only [this, ite_false, List.length_ofFn]
  omega

name: LeanCert.Engine.monomialToBernstein_getElem
statement:
theorem monomialToBernstein_getElem (qs : List ℚ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < qs.length)
    (hn : 0 < qs.length) :
    (monomialToBernstein qs)[k]'(by rw [monomialToBernstein_length qs hn]; exact hk) =
    (Finset.range (k + 1)).sum (fun j =>
      if hj : j < qs.length then
        if (Nat.choose (qs.length - 1) j) = 0 then 0
        else binomialRat k j / binomialRat (qs.length - 1) j * qs[j]
      else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomialToBernstein]
  have : ¬ (qs.length - 1 < 0) := by omega
  simp only [this, ite_false]
  rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
  rfl

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernstein_representation
statement:
theorem bernstein_representation (qs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (hn : qs.length = n + 1)
    (t : ℝ) (_ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (_ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    let bs
proof:
:= monomialToBernstein qs
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) =
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      (bs.getD k 0 : ℝ) *
      ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k))) := by
  intro bs
  
  have hexpand : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j =
      (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) *
      (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
        if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
        else 0) := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    congr 1
    exact monomial_bernstein_expansion n j (by omega) t
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hexpand]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
  
  have factor_lhs : (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j =>
      (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) *
      (if j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
       else 0)) =
    ((Finset.range (k + 1)).sum (fun j =>
      (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ))) *
    (t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)) := by
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [show n + 1 = (k + 1) + (n - k) from by omega]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
    have hzero : (Finset.range (n - k)).sum (fun j =>
        (qs.getD (j + (k + 1)) 0 : ℝ) *
        (if j + (k + 1) ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - (j + (k + 1))) (k - (j + (k + 1))) : ℝ) *
          t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
        else 0)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _
      simp only [show ¬(j + (k + 1) ≤ k) from by omega, ite_false, mul_zero]
    have hzero2 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n - k),
        (qs.getD (k + 1 + j) 0 : ℝ) *
        (if k + 1 + j ≤ k then (Nat.choose (n - (k + 1 + j)) (k - (k + 1 + j)) : ℝ) *
          t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)
        else 0) = 0 := by
      intro j _; simp only [show ¬(k + 1 + j ≤ k) from by omega, ite_false, mul_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero hzero2, add_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    rw [ite_eq_left (show j ≤ k from by omega)]
    ring
  rw [factor_lhs]
  
  
  
  have hbs_len : bs.length = qs.length := monomialToBernstein_length qs (by omega)
  have hk_lt : k < bs.length := by rw [hbs_len]; omega
  suffices h : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℝ)) =
    (bs.getD k 0 : ℝ) * (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) by
    calc (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * ↑((n - j).choose (k - j))) *
          (t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k))
        = ((bs.getD k 0 : ℝ) * ↑(n.choose k)) * (t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)) := by rw [h]
      _ = (bs.getD k 0 : ℝ) * (↑(n.choose k) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)) := by ring
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem bs 0 hk_lt]
  rw [monomialToBernstein_getElem qs k (by omega) (by omega)]
  push_cast [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
  have hj_lt : j < qs.length := by omega
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem qs 0 hj_lt]
  simp only [dite_true, hn, show n + 1 - 1 = n from by omega,
    show j < n + 1 from by omega]
  by_cases hcnj : Nat.choose n j = 0
  · exfalso
    have := Nat.choose_eq_zero_iff.mp hcnj
    omega
  · simp only [hcnj, ite_false, binomialRat]
    have hident := choose_mul_choose_eq (show j ≤ k from by omega) (show k ≤ n from by omega)
    have hcnj_ne : (Nat.choose n j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcnj
    have hid : (Nat.choose k j : ℚ) * (Nat.choose n k : ℚ) =
           (Nat.choose n j : ℚ) * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hident
    
    
    
    
    have hq : qs[j] * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℚ) =
        ((Nat.choose k j : ℚ) / (Nat.choose n j : ℚ) * qs[j]) * (Nat.choose n k : ℚ) := by
      
      have lhs_eq : qs[j] * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℚ) * (Nat.choose n j : ℚ) =
          qs[j] * ((Nat.choose n j : ℚ) * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℚ)) := by ring
      have rhs_eq : ((Nat.choose k j : ℚ) / (Nat.choose n j : ℚ) * qs[j]) * (Nat.choose n k : ℚ) *
          (Nat.choose n j : ℚ) =
          qs[j] * ((Nat.choose k j : ℚ) * (Nat.choose n k : ℚ)) := by
        field_simp
      have hmul : qs[j] * ((Nat.choose n j : ℚ) * (Nat.choose (n - j) (k - j) : ℚ)) =
          qs[j] * ((Nat.choose k j : ℚ) * (Nat.choose n k : ℚ)) := by
        congr 1; linarith
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ hcnj_ne (by linarith [lhs_eq, rhs_eq, hmul])
    exact_mod_cast hq

name: LeanCert.Engine.transformPolyCoeffs_length
statement:
private theorem transformPolyCoeffs_length (p : Polynomial ℚ) (α β : ℚ) :
    (transformPolyCoeffs p α β).length = p.natDegree + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [transformPolyCoeffs, List.length_ofFn]

name: LeanCert.Engine.transformPolyCoeffs_getElem
statement:
private theorem transformPolyCoeffs_getElem (p : Polynomial ℚ) (α β : ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < p.natDegree + 1) :
    (transformPolyCoeffs p α β)[j]'(by rw [transformPolyCoeffs_length]; exact hj) =
    (Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1 - j)).sum (fun k =>
      let i := j + k
      p.coeff i * binomialRat i j * α ^ (i - j) * (β - α) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [transformPolyCoeffs]
  rw [List.getElem_ofFn]

name: LeanCert.Engine.transformPolyCoeffs_correct
statement:
private theorem transformPolyCoeffs_correct (p : Polynomial ℚ) (α β : ℚ) (t : ℝ) :
    let qs
proof:
:= transformPolyCoeffs p α β
    Polynomial.aeval ((α : ℝ) + t * ((β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ))) p =
    (Finset.range qs.length).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) := by
  intro qs
  let n := p.natDegree
  let w := (β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ)
  
  rw [poly_aeval_eq_sum]
  
  
  have hexpand : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (p.coeff i : ℝ) * ((α : ℝ) + t * ((β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ))) ^ i =
      (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j =>
        (p.coeff i : ℝ) * ((t * w) ^ j * (α : ℝ) ^ (i - j) * (Nat.choose i j : ℝ))) := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [show (α : ℝ) + t * ((β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ)) = t * ((β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ)) + (α : ℝ) from by ring]
    rw [add_pow (t * ((β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ))) (α : ℝ) i]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
    intro j hj1 hj2
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj1 hj2
    push Not at hj2
    have : Nat.choose i j = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
    simp [this]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hexpand]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  
  
  
  
  rw [transformPolyCoeffs_length]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
  
  
  have hqs_len : qs.length = n + 1 := transformPolyCoeffs_length p α β
  have hj_lt : j < qs.length := by omega
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem qs 0 hj_lt, transformPolyCoeffs_getElem p α β j (by omega)]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  
  rw [show n + 1 = j + (n + 1 - j) from by omega]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hzero : (Finset.range j).sum (fun i =>
      (p.coeff i : ℝ) * ((t * w) ^ j * (α : ℝ) ^ (i - j) * (Nat.choose i j : ℝ))) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    have : Nat.choose i j = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
    simp [this]
  rw [hzero, zero_add]
  
  
  
  push_cast [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [show j + (n + 1 - j) - j = n + 1 - j from by omega]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
  simp only [show (j + k) - j = k from by omega, binomialRat, mul_pow,
    show w = (β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ) from rfl]
  push_cast
  ring

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernstein_enclosure_01
statement:
theorem bernstein_enclosure_01 (qs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (hn : qs.length = n + 1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    let bs
proof:
:= monomialToBernstein qs
    let bounds := listMinMax bs (bs[0]'(by rw [monomialToBernstein_length qs (by omega)]; omega))
    (bounds.1 : ℝ) ≤
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) ∧
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) ≤
    (bounds.2 : ℝ) := by
  
  rw [bernstein_representation qs n hn t ht0 ht1]
  
  
  have hbs_len := monomialToBernstein_length qs (by omega)
  
  
  have hbs := monomialToBernstein qs
  set bs := monomialToBernstein qs with hbs_def
  constructor
  · 
    
    
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    apply inf_le_weighted_sum
    · intro ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact bernstein_nonneg n k t ht0 ht1
    · have := bernstein_partition_of_unity n t
      rwa [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range] at this
    · intro ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hk_lt : k < bs.length := by rw [hbs_def, hbs_len]; omega
      have hgetD : bs.getD k 0 = bs[k]'hk_lt := List.getD_eq_getElem bs 0 hk_lt
      rw [hgetD]
      exact_mod_cast (listMinMax_bounds_elem bs
        (bs[0]'(by rw [hbs_def, hbs_len]; omega))
        (bs[k]'hk_lt)
        (List.getElem_mem hk_lt)).1
  · 
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    apply weighted_sum_le_sup
    · intro ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact bernstein_nonneg n k t ht0 ht1
    · have := bernstein_partition_of_unity n t
      rwa [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range] at this
    · intro ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hk_lt : k < bs.length := by rw [hbs_def, hbs_len]; omega
      have hgetD : bs.getD k 0 = bs[k]'hk_lt := List.getD_eq_getElem bs 0 hk_lt
      rw [hgetD]
      exact_mod_cast (listMinMax_bounds_elem bs
        (bs[0]'(by rw [hbs_def, hbs_len]; omega))
        (bs[k]'hk_lt)
        (List.getElem_mem hk_lt)).2

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernsteinCoeffsForDomain_ne_nil
statement:
private theorem bernsteinCoeffsForDomain_ne_nil (p : Polynomial ℚ) (lo hi c : ℚ) :
    bernsteinCoeffsForDomain p lo hi c ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bernsteinCoeffsForDomain]
  have htlen : (transformPolyCoeffs p (lo - c) (hi - c)).length = p.natDegree + 1 :=
    transformPolyCoeffs_length p (lo - c) (hi - c)
  have hpos : 0 < (transformPolyCoeffs p (lo - c) (hi - c)).length := by omega
  have hlen : (monomialToBernstein (transformPolyCoeffs p (lo - c) (hi - c))).length =
    (transformPolyCoeffs p (lo - c) (hi - c)).length :=
    monomialToBernstein_length _ hpos
  intro h
  rw [h] at hlen
  simp at hlen
  omega

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernsteinCoeffsForDomain_length
statement:
private theorem bernsteinCoeffsForDomain_length (p : Polynomial ℚ) (lo hi c : ℚ) :
    (bernsteinCoeffsForDomain p lo hi c).length = p.natDegree + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bernsteinCoeffsForDomain]
  rw [monomialToBernstein_length _ (by rw [transformPolyCoeffs_length]; omega)]
  exact transformPolyCoeffs_length p (lo - c) (hi - c)

name: LeanCert.Engine.poly_eval_mem_boundPolyBernstein
statement:
theorem poly_eval_mem_boundPolyBernstein (p : Polynomial ℚ) (domain : IntervalRat) (c : ℚ)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ domain) :
    Polynomial.aeval (x - c) p ∈ boundPolyBernstein p domain c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hx
  
  unfold boundPolyBernstein
  set coeffs := bernsteinCoeffsForDomain p domain.lo domain.hi c with hcoeffs_def
  
  have hne := bernsteinCoeffsForDomain_ne_nil p domain.lo domain.hi c
  obtain ⟨c0, cs, hcoeffs_eq⟩ : ∃ c0 cs, coeffs = c0 :: cs := by
    match h : coeffs with
    | [] => exact absurd h hne
    | c0 :: cs => exact ⟨c0, cs, rfl⟩
  simp only [hcoeffs_eq]
  simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def]
  
  
  
  
  
  set α := domain.lo - c
  set β := domain.hi - c
  set qs := transformPolyCoeffs p α β
  
  have hcoeffs_mb : coeffs = monomialToBernstein qs := by
    simp only [hcoeffs_def, bernsteinCoeffsForDomain]; rfl
  have hqs_len : qs.length = p.natDegree + 1 := transformPolyCoeffs_length p α β
  
  
  
  by_cases hdom : domain.lo = domain.hi
  · 
    have hxeq : x = ↑domain.lo := by
      have h1 := hx.1; have h2 := hx.2
      have : (domain.lo : ℝ) = (domain.hi : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdom
      linarith
    
    
    have htrans := transformPolyCoeffs_correct p α β 0
    have halpha : (α : ℝ) = x - (c : ℝ) := by
      simp only [α, hxeq]; push_cast; rfl
    have henc := bernstein_enclosure_01 qs p.natDegree hqs_len 0 le_rfl zero_le_one
    rw [hcoeffs_mb] at hcoeffs_eq
    simp only [hcoeffs_eq, List.getElem_cons_zero] at henc
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at htrans
    rw [halpha] at htrans
    rw [htrans]
    rw [show (transformPolyCoeffs p α β).length = p.natDegree + 1 from
      transformPolyCoeffs_length p α β]
    exact henc
  · 
    have hlt : domain.lo < domain.hi := lt_of_le_of_ne domain.le (fun h => hdom h)
    set t := (x - ↑domain.lo) / (↑domain.hi - ↑domain.lo)
    have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := by
      apply div_nonneg; linarith [hx.1]; linarith [show (domain.lo : ℝ) < domain.hi from by exact_mod_cast hlt]
    have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := by
      apply div_le_one_of_le₀; linarith [hx.2]
      linarith [show (domain.lo : ℝ) < domain.hi from by exact_mod_cast hlt]
    
    have hxt : (x : ℝ) - (c : ℝ) = (α : ℝ) + t * ((β : ℝ) - (α : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [α, β, t]
      push_cast
      have hne : (domain.hi : ℝ) - domain.lo ≠ 0 := by
        linarith [show (domain.lo : ℝ) < domain.hi from by exact_mod_cast hlt]
      field_simp
      ring
    
    have htrans := transformPolyCoeffs_correct p α β t
    rw [← hxt] at htrans
    
    have henc := bernstein_enclosure_01 qs p.natDegree hqs_len t ht0 ht1
    
    
    
    rw [htrans]
    rw [hcoeffs_mb] at hcoeffs_eq
    
    simp only [hcoeffs_eq, List.getElem_cons_zero] at henc
    have hqs_eq : qs = transformPolyCoeffs p α β := rfl
    simp only [← hqs_eq, hqs_len]
    exact_mod_cast henc

name: LeanCert.Engine.TaylorModel.valueAtCenter_correct
statement:
theorem valueAtCenter_correct (tm : TaylorModel) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ tm.domain, f x ∈ tm.evalSet x)
    (hc : (tm.center : ℝ) ∈ tm.domain) :
    f tm.center ∈ valueAtCenterInterval tm
proof:
:= by
  have heval := hf tm.center hc
  simp only [evalSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at heval
  obtain ⟨r, hr_mem, hr_eq⟩ := heval
  simp only [valueAtCenterInterval, IntervalRat.mem_def, IntervalRat.add,
    IntervalRat.singleton, Rat.cast_add]
  have hpoly : Polynomial.aeval ((tm.center : ℝ) - tm.center) tm.poly = (tm.poly.coeff 0 : ℝ) := by
    simp only [sub_self]
    simp only [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero]
    rfl
  rw [hr_eq, hpoly]
  simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hr_mem
  constructor <;> linarith [hr_mem.1, hr_mem.2]

name: LeanCert.Engine.abs_sub_le_radius
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IntervalRat.mem_def] at hx
  by_cases! hxc : (c : ℝ) ≤ x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x - c)]
    have hxhi : x - c ≤ (domain.hi : ℝ) - c := by linarith
    calc x - c ≤ (domain.hi : ℝ) - c := hxhi
      _ ≤ |(domain.hi : ℝ) - c| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ max |(domain.hi : ℝ) - c| |(domain.lo : ℝ) - c| := le_max_left _ _
  · have h_neg : x - (c : ℝ) < 0 := by linarith
    rw [abs_of_neg h_neg]
    have hxlo : -(x - (c : ℝ)) ≤ (c : ℝ) - domain.lo := by linarith
    calc -(x - (c : ℝ)) ≤ (c : ℝ) - domain.lo := hxlo
      _ ≤ |c - (domain.lo : ℝ)| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |(domain.lo : ℝ) - c| := abs_sub_comm _ _
      _ ≤ max |(domain.hi : ℝ) - c| |(domain.lo : ℝ) - c| := le_max_right _ _

name: LeanCert.Engine.aeval_abs_le_sum
statement:
private theorem aeval_abs_le_sum (p : Polynomial ℚ) (y : ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : |y| ≤ r) :
    |Polynomial.aeval y p| ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), |(p.coeff i : ℝ)| * r ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have haeval : Polynomial.aeval y p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1),
      (p.coeff i : ℝ) * y ^ i := by
    simp only [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
    rfl
  rw [haeval]
  calc |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), (p.coeff i : ℝ) * y ^ i|
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), |(p.coeff i : ℝ) * y ^ i| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), |(p.coeff i : ℝ)| * |y| ^ i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [abs_mul, abs_pow]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), |(p.coeff i : ℝ)| * r ^ i := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr i
        · exact abs_nonneg _

name: LeanCert.Engine.evalPoly_mem_polyBoundInterval
statement:
theorem evalPoly_mem_polyBoundInterval
    (tm : TaylorModel) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ tm.domain) :
    tm.evalPoly x ∈ tm.polyBoundInterval
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TaylorModel.evalPoly, TaylorModel.polyBoundInterval, IntervalRat.mem_def]
  set B := boundPolyAbs tm.poly tm.domain tm.center with hB_def
  suffices h : |Polynomial.aeval (x - tm.center) tm.poly| ≤ B by
    constructor
    · simp only [Rat.cast_neg]
      have := neg_abs_le (Polynomial.aeval (x - ↑tm.center) tm.poly)
      linarith
    · exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h
  unfold boundPolyAbs at hB_def
  simp only at hB_def
  set r : ℚ := max (|tm.domain.hi - tm.center|) (|tm.domain.lo - tm.center|) with hr_def
  have hr_real : (r : ℝ) = max (|(tm.domain.hi : ℝ) - tm.center|) (|(tm.domain.lo : ℝ) - tm.center|) := by
    simp only [hr_def, Rat.cast_max, Rat.cast_abs, Rat.cast_sub]
  have habs_le_r : |x - tm.center| ≤ r := by
    rw [hr_real]
    exact abs_sub_le_radius x tm.center tm.domain hx
  have hr_nn : 0 ≤ (r : ℝ) := by
    rw [hr_real]
    exact le_max_of_le_left (abs_nonneg _)
  have h := aeval_abs_le_sum tm.poly (x - tm.center) r habs_le_r
  have hcoeff_abs : ∀ i, (|tm.poly.coeff i| : ℝ) = |(tm.poly.coeff i : ℝ)| := fun i => rfl
  calc |Polynomial.aeval (x - ↑tm.center) tm.poly|
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (tm.poly.natDegree + 1), |(tm.poly.coeff i : ℝ)| * (r : ℝ) ^ i := h
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (tm.poly.natDegree + 1), (|tm.poly.coeff i| : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) ^ i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [← hcoeff_abs]
    _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (tm.poly.natDegree + 1), |tm.poly.coeff i| * r ^ i : ℚ) := by
        simp only [Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_abs, Rat.cast_pow]
    _ = (B : ℝ) := by rw [hB_def]

name: LeanCert.Engine.taylorModel_correct
statement:
theorem taylorModel_correct (tm : TaylorModel) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ tm.domain, f x ∈ tm.evalSet x) :
    ∀ x ∈ tm.domain, f x ∈ tm.bound
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hfx := hf x hx
  simp only [TaylorModel.evalSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hfx
  obtain ⟨r, hr_mem, hr_eq⟩ := hfx
  
  have hpoly : tm.evalPoly x ∈ tm.polyBoundIntervalBernstein := by
    simp only [TaylorModel.evalPoly, TaylorModel.polyBoundIntervalBernstein]
    exact poly_eval_mem_boundPolyBernstein tm.poly tm.domain tm.center x hx
  have hr : r ∈ tm.remainder := hr_mem
  have hsum : tm.evalPoly x + r ∈ IntervalRat.add tm.polyBoundIntervalBernstein tm.remainder :=
    IntervalRat.mem_add hpoly hr
  simp only [TaylorModel.bound]
  rw [hr_eq]
  exact hsum

name: LeanCert.Engine.TaylorModel.neg_evalSet_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TaylorModel.evalSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, TaylorModel.neg, TaylorModel.evalPoly]

  · exact IntervalRat.mem_neg hr
