  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [Real.exp_pos (-x)]

name: LeanCert.ML.IntervalVector.Real.sigmoid_lt_one
statement: theorem Real.sigmoid_lt_one (x : ℝ) : Real.sigmoid x < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold Real.sigmoid
  rw [div_lt_one (by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-x)] : 0 < 1 + Real.exp (-x))]
  linarith [Real.exp_pos (-x)]

name: LeanCert.ML.IntervalVector.mem_sigmoid
statement:
theorem mem_sigmoid {x : ℝ} {I : IntervalDyadic} (_hx : x ∈ I) :
    Real.sigmoid x ∈ sigmoid I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IntervalDyadic.mem_def, sigmoid]
  simp only [Dyadic.toRat_ofInt, Int.cast_zero, Int.cast_one, Rat.cast_zero, Rat.cast_one]
  exact ⟨le_of_lt (Real.sigmoid_pos x), le_of_lt (Real.sigmoid_lt_one x)⟩

name: LeanCert.ML.Transformer.mem_forwardAffine
statement:
theorem mem_forwardAffine {xs : List ℝ} {Is : IntervalVector}
    (params : LayerNormParams)
    (eps : AffineForm.NoiseAssignment)
    (hvalid : AffineForm.validNoise eps)
    (hmem : AffineVector.mem xs (AffineVector.ofIntervals (Is.map IntervalDyadic.toIntervalRat)) eps)
    (hne : ¬(AffineVector.ofIntervals (Is.map IntervalDyadic.toIntervalRat)).isEmpty)
    (hlen_eps :
      eps.length =
        (AffineVector.variance (AffineVector.ofIntervals (Is.map IntervalDyadic.toIntervalRat))
          |>.add (AffineForm.const params.epsilon)).coeffs.length)
    (hlen_sqrt :
      eps.length =
        ((AffineVector.variance (AffineVector.ofIntervals (Is.map IntervalDyadic.toIntervalRat))
          |>.add (AffineForm.const params.epsilon)) |> AffineForm.sqrt).coeffs.length)
    (hsqrt_pos :
      0 <
        ((AffineVector.variance (AffineVector.ofIntervals (Is.map IntervalDyadic.toIntervalRat))
          |>.add (AffineForm.const params.epsilon)) |> AffineForm.sqrt).toInterval.lo) :
    let ys
proof:
:= layerNormReal xs params.gamma params.beta params.epsilon
    AffineVector.mem ys (params.forwardAffine Is) eps := by
  simpa [LayerNormParams.forwardAffine] using!
    (AffineVector.mem_layerNorm (v_real := xs)
      (v := AffineVector.ofIntervals (Is.map IntervalDyadic.toIntervalRat))
      (gamma := params.gamma) (beta := params.beta) (epsilon := params.epsilon)
      params.epsilon_pos hvalid hmem hne hlen_eps hlen_sqrt hsqrt_pos)

name: LeanCert.ML.Layer.forwardReal_length
statement:
theorem forwardReal_length (l : Layer) (x : List ℝ) :
    (forwardReal l x).length = min l.outputDim l.bias.length
proof:
:= by
  simp [forwardReal, realMatVecMul, realAddBias, outputDim, List.length_map, List.length_zipWith]

name: LeanCert.ML.Layer.forwardInterval_length
statement:
theorem forwardInterval_length (l : Layer) (x : IntervalVector) (prec : Int) :
    (forwardInterval l x prec).length = min l.outputDim l.bias.length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forwardInterval, matVecMul, addBias, reluVector, List.length_map, List.length_zipWith]
  rfl

name: LeanCert.ML.Layer.mem_forwardInterval
statement:
theorem mem_forwardInterval {l : Layer} {xs : List ℝ} {Is : IntervalVector}
    (hwf : l.WellFormed)
    (hdim : l.inputDim = Is.length)
    (hxlen : xs.length = Is.length)
    (hmem : ∀ i, (hi : i < Is.length) → xs[i]'(by omega) ∈ Is[i]'hi)
    (prec : Int) (hprec : prec ≤ 0 := by norm_num) :
    ∀ i, (hi : i < min l.outputDim l.bias.length) →
      (forwardReal l xs)[i]'(by rw [forwardReal_length]; exact hi) ∈
      (forwardInterval l Is prec)[i]'(by rw [forwardInterval_length]; exact hi)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp only [forwardReal, forwardInterval, reluVector]
  
  have hWcols : ∀ row ∈ l.weights, row.length = Is.length := by
    intro row hrow
    have h := hwf.1 row hrow
    omega
  
  have hlinear := mem_matVecMul hWcols hxlen hmem prec hprec
  
  have hlinear_len : (realMatVecMul l.weights xs).length = l.outputDim := by
    simp [realMatVecMul, outputDim]
  have hlinearI_len : (matVecMul l.weights Is prec).length = l.outputDim := by
    simp [matVecMul, outputDim]
  
  have hlen_eq : (realMatVecMul l.weights xs).length = (matVecMul l.weights Is prec).length := by
    simp [realMatVecMul, matVecMul]
  have hblen_eq : l.bias.length = (matVecMul l.weights Is prec).length := by
    simp [matVecMul]; exact hwf.2
  have hbias := mem_addBias hlen_eq hblen_eq (fun j hj => by
    have hj' : j < l.weights.length := by simp [matVecMul] at hj; exact hj
    exact hlinear j hj') prec hprec
  
  simp only [List.getElem_map]
  have hi_out : i < l.outputDim := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.min_le_left _ _)
  have hi_int : i < (matVecMul l.weights Is prec).length := by simp [matVecMul]; exact hi_out
  exact mem_relu (hbias i hi_int)

name: LeanCert.ML.TwoLayerNet.mem_forwardInterval
statement:
theorem mem_forwardInterval {net : TwoLayerNet} {xs : List ℝ} {Is : IntervalVector}
    (hwf : net.WellFormed)
    (hdim : net.layer1.inputDim = Is.length)
    (hxlen : xs.length = Is.length)
    (hmem : ∀ i, (hi : i < Is.length) → xs[i]'(by omega) ∈ Is[i]'hi)
    (prec : Int) (hprec : prec ≤ 0 := by norm_num) :
    ∀ i, (hi : i < min net.layer2.outputDim net.layer2.bias.length) →
      (forwardReal net xs)[i]'(by
        simp only [forwardReal, Layer.forwardReal_length]; omega) ∈
      (forwardInterval net Is prec)[i]'(by
        simp only [forwardInterval, Layer.forwardInterval_length]; omega)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp only [forwardReal, forwardInterval]
  
  have hmem1 := Layer.mem_forwardInterval hwf.1 hdim hxlen hmem prec hprec
  
  have hlen1_real : (Layer.forwardReal net.layer1 xs).length =
      min net.layer1.outputDim net.layer1.bias.length := Layer.forwardReal_length _ _
  have hlen1_int : (Layer.forwardInterval net.layer1 Is prec).length =
      min net.layer1.outputDim net.layer1.bias.length := Layer.forwardInterval_length _ _ _
  
  have hdim2 : net.layer2.inputDim = (Layer.forwardInterval net.layer1 Is prec).length := by
    rw [hlen1_int]; exact hwf.2.2
  have hmem1' : ∀ j, (hj : j < (Layer.forwardInterval net.layer1 Is prec).length) →
      (Layer.forwardReal net.layer1 xs)[j]'(by
        simp only [Layer.forwardReal_length, Layer.forwardInterval_length] at hlen1_real hj ⊢; omega) ∈
      (Layer.forwardInterval net.layer1 Is prec)[j]'hj := by
    intro j hj
    have hj' : j < min net.layer1.outputDim net.layer1.bias.length := by
      simp only [Layer.forwardInterval_length] at hj; exact hj
    exact hmem1 j hj'
  have hlen_eq : (Layer.forwardReal net.layer1 xs).length =
      (Layer.forwardInterval net.layer1 Is prec).length := by
    simp only [Layer.forwardReal_length, Layer.forwardInterval_length]
  exact Layer.mem_forwardInterval hwf.2.1 hdim2 hlen_eq hmem1' prec hprec i hi

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntervalArray.mem_add
proof:
:= by
  show IntervalArray.mem (add a b) (fun i => x i + y i)
  unfold mem
  intro i
  simp only [add, getLo, getHi, Array.getElem_ofFn, Core.Dyadic.toRat_add, Rat.cast_add]
  have hx' : IntervalArray.mem a x := hx
  have hy' : IntervalArray.mem b y := hy
  have hxlo := (hx' i).1
  have hylo := (hy' i).1
  have hxhi := (hx' i).2
  have hyhi := (hy' i).2
  simp only [getLo, getHi] at hxlo hylo hxhi hyhi
  constructor <;> linarith

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntervalArray.mem_neg
statement:
theorem mem_neg {x : Fin n → ℝ} {a : IntervalArray n} (hx : x ∈ a) :
    (fun i => -x i) ∈ neg a
proof:
:= by
  show IntervalArray.mem (neg a) (fun i => -x i)
  unfold mem
  intro i
  simp only [neg, getLo, getHi, Array.getElem_ofFn, Core.Dyadic.toRat_neg, Rat.cast_neg]
  have hx' : IntervalArray.mem a x := hx
  have ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hx' i
  simp only [getLo, getHi] at hlo hhi
  constructor <;> linarith

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntervalArray.mem_sub
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub, sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact mem_add hx (mem_neg hy)

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntervalArray.mem_relu
statement:
theorem mem_relu {x : Fin n → ℝ} {a : IntervalArray n} (hx : x ∈ a) :
    (fun i => max 0 (x i)) ∈ relu a
proof:
:= by
  show IntervalArray.mem (relu a) (fun i => max 0 (x i))
  unfold mem
  intro i
  simp only [relu, getLo, getHi, Array.getElem_ofFn,
             Dyadic.max_toRat, Dyadic.toRat_ofInt, Int.cast_zero]
  have hx' : IntervalArray.mem a x := hx
  have ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hx' i
  simp only [getLo, getHi] at hlo hhi
  
  simp only [Rat.cast_max, Rat.cast_zero, max_comm (0 : ℝ) _]
  constructor
  · 
    apply max_le_max _ (le_refl 0)
    exact_mod_cast hlo
  · 
    apply max_le_max _ (le_refl 0)
    exact_mod_cast hhi

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntMatrix.row_major_lt_of_lt_mul_of_lt
statement:
private theorem row_major_lt_of_lt_mul_of_lt {r c i j : Nat}
    (hi : i < r) (hj : j < c) : i * c + j < r * c
proof:
:= by
  calc i * c + j < i * c + c := Nat.add_lt_add_left hj _
    _ = (i + 1) * c := by ring
    _ ≤ r * c := Nat.mul_le_mul_right c (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntMatrix.lt_mul_comm
statement: private theorem lt_mul_comm {k r c : Nat} (h : k < r * c) : k < c * r
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Nat.mul_comm]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.IntMatrix.ofFn_get
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofFn_get {r c : Nat} (f : Fin r → Fin c → Int) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) :
    (ofFn f).get i j i.isLt j.isLt = f i j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofFn, get]
  split_ifs with hc
  · 
    exact absurd (Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos (by simp [hc] : ¬ 0 < c)) (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt j.isLt)
  · 
    simp only [Array.getElem_ofFn, flatToElem]
    have hc_pos := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc
    
    have h_div : (↑i * c + ↑j) / c = ↑i := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hc_pos]
      rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt j.isLt, Nat.zero_add]
    have h_mod : (↑i * c + ↑j) % c = ↑j := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt
    simp only [h_div, h_mod]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.intVal_mul
statement:
theorem intVal_mul (x y : Int) (e : Int) :
    intVal x e * intVal y e = intVal (x * y) (e + e)
proof:
:= by
  unfold intVal
  simp only [Int.cast_mul]
  calc (x : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ e * (↑y * (2 : ℝ) ^ e)
      = (x : ℝ) * y * ((2 : ℝ) ^ e * (2 : ℝ) ^ e) := by ring
    _ = (x : ℝ) * y * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e + e) := by rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.intVal_add
statement:
theorem intVal_add (x y : Int) (e : Int) :
    intVal x e + intVal y e = intVal (x + y) e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal, Int.cast_add]
  ring

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.foldl_add_f_eq_foldl_map
statement:
private theorem foldl_add_f_eq_foldl_map {α β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : β → α) (l : List β) (init : α) :
    l.foldl (fun acc b => acc + f b) init = init + (l.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [ih]
    abel

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.finRange_foldl_add_eq_sum
statement:
theorem finRange_foldl_add_eq_sum {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] {m : Nat} (f : Fin m → α) :
    (List.finRange m).foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) 0 = Finset.univ.sum f
proof:
:= by
  rw [foldl_add_f_eq_foldl_map, zero_add, Fin.sum_univ_def]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.Int_cast_foldl_add_gen
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [ih (init + f x)]
    simp only [Int.cast_add]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.Int_cast_foldl_add
statement:
theorem Int_cast_foldl_add {β : Type*} (l : List β) (f : β → Int) :
    ((l.foldl (fun acc b => acc + f b) 0 : Int) : ℝ) =
    l.foldl (fun acc b => acc + (f b : ℝ)) (0 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Int_cast_foldl_add_gen l f 0
  simp only [Int.cast_zero] at h
  exact h

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.sum_interval_le
statement:
private theorem sum_interval_le {m : Nat}
    (f_lo f f_hi : Fin m → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ j, f_lo j ≤ f j ∧ f j ≤ f_hi j) :
    Finset.univ.sum f_lo ≤ Finset.univ.sum f ∧
    Finset.univ.sum f ≤ Finset.univ.sum f_hi
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => (h j).1)
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => (h j).2)

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mul_mem_endpoints_left
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hy : 0 ≤ y
  · have h1 : a₁ * y ≤ x * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha.1 hy
    have h2 : x * y ≤ a₂ * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha.2 hy
    exact ⟨le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h1, le_trans h2 (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  · have hy' := le_of_lt hy
    have h1 : a₂ * y ≤ x * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right ha.2 hy'
    have h2 : x * y ≤ a₁ * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right ha.1 hy'
    exact ⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) h1, le_trans h2 (le_max_left _ _)⟩

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mul_mem_endpoints_right
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have h1 : x * b₁ ≤ x * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb.1 hx
    have h2 : x * y ≤ x * b₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb.2 hx
    exact ⟨le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h1, le_trans h2 (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  · have hx' := le_of_lt hx
    have h1 : x * b₂ ≤ x * y := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hb.2 hx'
    have h2 : x * y ≤ x * b₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hb.1 hx'
    exact ⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) h1, le_trans h2 (le_max_left _ _)⟩

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mul_lower_bound
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (mul_mem_endpoints_left (y := y) ha).1
  by_cases! hcmp : a₁ * y ≤ a₂ * y
  · rw [min_eq_left hcmp] at h1
    have h2 := (mul_mem_endpoints_right hb (x := a₁)).1
    calc min (min (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂)) (min (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂))
        ≤ min (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂) := min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ a₁ * y := h2
      _ ≤ x * y := h1
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt hcmp)] at h1
    have h2 := (mul_mem_endpoints_right hb (x := a₂)).1
    calc min (min (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂)) (min (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂))
        ≤ min (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂) := min_le_right _ _
      _ ≤ a₂ * y := h2
      _ ≤ x * y := h1

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mul_upper_bound
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (mul_mem_endpoints_left (y := y) ha).2
  by_cases! hcmp : a₁ * y ≤ a₂ * y
  · rw [max_eq_right hcmp] at h1
    have h2 := (mul_mem_endpoints_right hb (x := a₂)).2
    calc x * y
        ≤ a₂ * y := h1
      _ ≤ max (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂) := h2
      _ ≤ max (max (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂)) (max (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂)) := le_max_right _ _
  · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hcmp)] at h1
    have h2 := (mul_mem_endpoints_right hb (x := a₁)).2
    calc x * y
        ≤ a₁ * y := h1
      _ ≤ max (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂) := h2
      _ ≤ max (max (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂)) (max (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂)) := le_max_left _ _

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mul_mem_corners
statement:
private theorem mul_mem_corners {x y a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ}
    (ha : a₁ ≤ x ∧ x ≤ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≤ y ∧ y ≤ b₂) :
    min (min (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂)) (min (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂)) ≤ x * y ∧
    x * y ≤ max (max (a₁ * b₁) (a₁ * b₂)) (max (a₂ * b₁) (a₂ * b₂))
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_lower_bound ha hb, mul_upper_bound ha hb⟩

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.intervalMul_sound
statement:
theorem intervalMul_sound (l1 h1 l2 h2 : Int) (x y : ℝ)
    (hx_lo : (l1 : ℝ) ≤ x) (hx_hi : x ≤ h1)
    (hy_lo : (l2 : ℝ) ≤ y) (hy_hi : y ≤ h2) :
    let (lo, hi)
proof:
:= IntervalMatrix.intervalMul l1 h1 l2 h2
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ x * y ∧ x * y ≤ hi := by
  simp only [IntervalMatrix.intervalMul]
  
  have hcorners := mul_mem_corners ⟨hx_lo, hx_hi⟩ ⟨hy_lo, hy_hi⟩
  
  have p1_eq : ((l1 * l2 : Int) : ℝ) = (l1 : ℝ) * l2 := Int.cast_mul l1 l2
  have p2_eq : ((l1 * h2 : Int) : ℝ) = (l1 : ℝ) * h2 := Int.cast_mul l1 h2
  have p3_eq : ((h1 * l2 : Int) : ℝ) = (h1 : ℝ) * l2 := Int.cast_mul h1 l2
  have p4_eq : ((h1 * h2 : Int) : ℝ) = (h1 : ℝ) * h2 := Int.cast_mul h1 h2
  
  simp only [Int.cast_min, Int.cast_max, p1_eq, p2_eq, p3_eq, p4_eq]
  exact hcorners

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.intervalMul_sound_scaled
statement:
theorem intervalMul_sound_scaled (l1 h1 l2 h2 : Int) (x y : ℝ) (exp : Int)
    (hx_lo : intVal l1 exp ≤ x) (hx_hi : x ≤ intVal h1 exp)
    (hy_lo : intVal l2 exp ≤ y) (hy_hi : y ≤ intVal h2 exp) :
    let (lo, hi)
proof:
:= IntervalMatrix.intervalMul l1 h1 l2 h2
    intVal lo (exp + exp) ≤ x * y ∧ x * y ≤ intVal hi (exp + exp) := by
  
  unfold intVal at hx_lo hx_hi hy_lo hy_hi

  
  have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ exp := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) exp
  have hpow_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ exp ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpow_pos

  
  set scale := (2 : ℝ) ^ exp
  set x' := x / scale
  set y' := y / scale

  
  
  
  have hx'_lo : (l1 : ℝ) ≤ x' := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpow_pos]
    exact hx_lo
  have hx'_hi : x' ≤ h1 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpow_pos]
    exact hx_hi
  have hy'_lo : (l2 : ℝ) ≤ y' := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpow_pos]
    exact hy_lo
  have hy'_hi : y' ≤ h2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpow_pos]
    exact hy_hi

  
  have hsound := intervalMul_sound l1 h1 l2 h2 x' y' hx'_lo hx'_hi hy'_lo hy'_hi

  
  have heq : x * y = x' * y' * (scale * scale) := by
    have h1 : x' * scale = x := div_mul_cancel₀ x hpow_ne
    have h2 : y' * scale = y := div_mul_cancel₀ y hpow_ne
    calc x * y = (x' * scale) * (y' * scale) := by rw [h1, h2]
      _ = x' * y' * (scale * scale) := by ring
  have hscale_sq : scale * scale = (2 : ℝ) ^ (exp + exp) := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]

  
  set result := IntervalMatrix.intervalMul l1 h1 l2 h2
  have hlo : (result.1 : ℝ) ≤ x' * y' := hsound.1
  have hhi : x' * y' ≤ result.2 := hsound.2

  constructor
  · 
    rw [intVal, heq, hscale_sq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
  · 
    rw [intVal, heq, hscale_sq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhi (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mem_transpose
statement:
theorem mem_transpose {r c : Nat}
    (M : IntervalMatrix r c) (exp : Int)
    (A_real : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) ℝ)
    (hM : M.mem exp A_real) :
    M.transpose.mem exp A_real.transpose
proof:
:= by
  intro j i
  
  simp only [IntervalMatrix.transpose, IntMatrix.valAt, IntMatrix.transpose,
             IntMatrix.ofFn_get, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  exact hM i j

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mem_matmul
statement:
theorem mem_matmul {n m p : Nat}
    (A : IntervalMatrix n m) (B : IntervalMatrix m p)
    (Ar : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (Br : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ)
    (exp : Int)
    (hA : A.mem exp Ar) (hB : B.mem exp Br) :
    (A.matmul B).mem (exp + exp) (Ar * Br)
proof:
:= by
  intro i k
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]

  
  let prod_lo (j : Fin m) : Int :=
    (IntervalMatrix.intervalMul
      (A.lo.get i j i.isLt j.isLt) (A.hi.get i j i.isLt j.isLt)
      (B.lo.get j k j.isLt k.isLt) (B.hi.get j k j.isLt k.isLt)).1
  let prod_hi (j : Fin m) : Int :=
    (IntervalMatrix.intervalMul
      (A.lo.get i j i.isLt j.isLt) (A.hi.get i j i.isLt j.isLt)
      (B.lo.get j k j.isLt k.isLt) (B.hi.get j k j.isLt k.isLt)).2

  
  have h_term : ∀ j : Fin m,
      intVal (prod_lo j) (exp + exp) ≤ Ar i j * Br j k ∧
      Ar i j * Br j k ≤ intVal (prod_hi j) (exp + exp) := fun j => by
    have hAj := hA i j
    have hBj := hB j k
    exact intervalMul_sound_scaled
      (A.lo.get i j i.isLt j.isLt) (A.hi.get i j i.isLt j.isLt)
      (B.lo.get j k j.isLt k.isLt) (B.hi.get j k j.isLt k.isLt)
      (Ar i j) (Br j k) exp
      hAj.1 hAj.2 hBj.1 hBj.2

  
  have h_sum := sum_interval_le
    (fun j => intVal (prod_lo j) (exp + exp))
    (fun j => Ar i j * Br j k)
    (fun j => intVal (prod_hi j) (exp + exp))
    h_term

  
  
  

  
  have h_lo_foldl : (A.matmul B).lo.get i k i.isLt k.isLt =
      (List.finRange m).foldl (fun sum j => sum + prod_lo j) 0 := by
    simp only [IntervalMatrix.matmul, IntMatrix.ofFn_get]
    rfl
  have h_hi_foldl : (A.matmul B).hi.get i k i.isLt k.isLt =
      (List.finRange m).foldl (fun sum j => sum + prod_hi j) 0 := by
    simp only [IntervalMatrix.matmul, IntMatrix.ofFn_get]
    rfl

  
  have h_lo_sum : (List.finRange m).foldl (fun sum j => sum + prod_lo j) 0 =
      Finset.univ.sum prod_lo := finRange_foldl_add_eq_sum prod_lo
  have h_hi_sum : (List.finRange m).foldl (fun sum j => sum + prod_hi j) 0 =
      Finset.univ.sum prod_hi := finRange_foldl_add_eq_sum prod_hi

  
  have h_intVal_sum_lo : intVal (Finset.univ.sum prod_lo) (exp + exp) =
      Finset.univ.sum (fun j => intVal (prod_lo j) (exp + exp)) := by
    simp only [intVal, Int.cast_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  have h_intVal_sum_hi : intVal (Finset.univ.sum prod_hi) (exp + exp) =
      Finset.univ.sum (fun j => intVal (prod_hi j) (exp + exp)) := by
    simp only [intVal, Int.cast_sum, Finset.sum_mul]

  
  simp only [IntMatrix.valAt, h_lo_foldl, h_hi_foldl, h_lo_sum, h_hi_sum,
             h_intVal_sum_lo, h_intVal_sum_hi]
  exact h_sum

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mem_batchLinear
statement:
theorem mem_batchLinear {outDim inDim batchSize : Nat}
    (W : IntervalMatrix outDim inDim)
    (X : InputBatch inDim batchSize)
    (W_real : Matrix (Fin outDim) (Fin inDim) ℝ)
    (X_real : Matrix (Fin inDim) (Fin batchSize) ℝ)
    (exp : Int)
    (hW : W.mem exp W_real)
    (hX : X.mem exp X_real) :
    (batchLinear W X).mem (exp + exp) (W_real * X_real)
proof:
:=
  mem_matmul W X W_real X_real exp hW hX

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.mem_attentionScores
statement:
theorem mem_attentionScores {seqLen dK : Nat}
    (Q K : IntervalMatrix seqLen dK)
    (Q_real K_real : Matrix (Fin seqLen) (Fin dK) ℝ)
    (exp : Int)
    (hQ : Q.mem exp Q_real)
    (hK : K.mem exp K_real) :
    (attentionScores Q K).mem (exp + exp) (Q_real * K_real.transpose)
proof:
:= by
  unfold attentionScores
  
  have hKT := mem_transpose K exp K_real hK
  
  exact mem_matmul Q K.transpose Q_real K_real.transpose exp hQ hKT

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.List.foldl_le_foldl
statement:
private theorem List.foldl_le_foldl {α β : Type*} [Preorder α]
    (l : List β)
    {f g : α → β → α}
    (h_point : ∀ acc, ∀ b, b ∈ l → f acc b ≤ g acc b)
    (h_f_mono : ∀ b, Monotone (fun a => f a b))
    (init : α) :
    l.foldl f init ≤ l.foldl g init
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => exact le_refl init
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    
    have hmem : x ∈ x :: xs := List.mem_cons_self
    have h1 : f init x ≤ g init x := h_point init x hmem
    
    have h2 : xs.foldl f (f init x) ≤ xs.foldl f (g init x) := by
      apply List.foldl_monotone h_f_mono
      exact h1
    
    have h3 : xs.foldl f (g init x) ≤ xs.foldl g (g init x) := by
      apply ih
      intro acc b hb
      exact h_point acc b (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hb)
    exact le_trans h2 h3

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.dotProductInt_mono_nonneg
statement:
theorem dotProductInt_mono_nonneg
    (w lo hi : Array Int)
    (h_w_nonneg : ∀ i, i < min w.size lo.size → i < min w.size hi.size → 0 ≤ w[i]!)
    (h_lo_le_hi : ∀ i, i < min w.size lo.size → i < min w.size hi.size → lo[i]! ≤ hi[i]!)
    (h_size_eq : min w.size lo.size = min w.size hi.size) :
    dotProductInt w lo ≤ dotProductInt w hi
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotProductInt
  rw [h_size_eq]
  
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_range]
  
  apply List.foldl_le_foldl (List.range (min w.size hi.size))
  · 
    intro acc i hi_mem

    have hi_bound : i < min w.size hi.size := List.mem_range.mp hi_mem
    have hi_lo : i < min w.size lo.size := by rw [h_size_eq]; exact hi_bound
    gcongr
    exact h_w_nonneg i hi_lo hi_bound
    exact h_lo_le_hi i hi_lo hi_bound
  · 
    intro i a b hab
    simp only [add_le_add_iff_right, hab]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.Array.getD_eq_getElem
statement:
private theorem Array.getD_eq_getElem {α : Type*} [Inhabited α] (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (hi : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i default = a[i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
  rfl

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.reluInt_getElem
statement:
theorem reluInt_getElem (a : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hi : i < a.size) :
    (reluInt a)[i]'(by simp [reluInt]; exact hi) = max 0 a[i]
proof:
:= by
  simp [reluInt]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.reluInt_getElem!
statement:
theorem reluInt_getElem! (a : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hi : i < a.size) :
    (reluInt a)[i]! = max 0 a[i]!
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : i < (reluInt a).size := by simp [reluInt, hi]
  simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h1, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi,
             reluInt_getElem a i hi]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.addIntArrays_getElem!
statement:
theorem addIntArrays_getElem! (a b : Array Int) (i : Nat) (ha : i < a.size) (hb : i < b.size) :
    (addIntArrays a b)[i]! = a[i]! + b[i]!
proof:
:= by
  have hz : i < (addIntArrays a b).size := by simp [addIntArrays, ha, hb]
  rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getElem!_eq_getD]
  rw [Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hz, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ ha, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hb]
  simp only [addIntArrays, Array.getElem_zipWith]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.subIntArrays_getElem!
statement:
theorem subIntArrays_getElem! (a b : Array Int) (i : Nat) (ha : i < a.size) (hb : i < b.size) :
    (subIntArrays a b)[i]! = a[i]! - b[i]!
proof:
:= by
  have hz : i < (subIntArrays a b).size := by simp [subIntArrays, ha, hb]
  rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getElem!_eq_getD]
  rw [Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hz, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ ha, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hb]
  simp only [subIntArrays, Array.getElem_zipWith]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.matVecMulInt_getElem!
statement:
theorem matVecMulInt_getElem! (M : Array (Array Int)) (v : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hi : i < M.size) :
    (matVecMulInt M v)[i]! = dotProductInt M[i]! v
proof:
:= by
  have hm : i < (matVecMulInt M v).size := by simp [matVecMulInt, hi]
  rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getElem!_eq_getD]
  rw [Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hm, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi]
  simp only [matVecMulInt, Array.getElem_map]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_add
statement: theorem intVal_add (a b : Int) (e : Int) : intVal (a + b) e = intVal a e + intVal b e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal, Int.cast_add, add_mul]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_sub
statement: theorem intVal_sub (a b : Int) (e : Int) : intVal (a - b) e = intVal a e - intVal b e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal, Int.cast_sub, sub_mul]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_mul
statement:
theorem intVal_mul (a b : Int) (ea eb : Int) :
    intVal a ea * intVal b eb = intVal (a * b) (ea + eb)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal, Int.cast_mul]
  calc (a : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ea * (↑b * (2 : ℝ) ^ eb)
      = ↑a * ↑b * ((2 : ℝ) ^ ea * (2 : ℝ) ^ eb) := by ring
    _ = ↑a * ↑b * (2 : ℝ) ^ (ea + eb) := by rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero (α := ℝ)) ea eb]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_zero
statement: theorem intVal_zero (e : Int) : intVal 0 e = 0
proof: := by simp [intVal]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_nonneg
statement: theorem intVal_nonneg {n : Int} (hn : 0 ≤ n) (e : Int) : 0 ≤ intVal n e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal]
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Int.cast_nonneg hn
  · exact zpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) e

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.nonneg_mul_bounds
statement:
theorem nonneg_mul_bounds {p l u x : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hl : l ≤ x) (hu : x ≤ u) :
    p * l ≤ p * x ∧ p * x ≤ p * u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hp
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hp

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.dotProduct_bounds_nonneg
statement:
theorem dotProduct_bounds_nonneg
    {n : Nat} (p l u x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≤ x i)
    (hu : ∀ i, x i ≤ u i) :
    (∑ i, p i * l i) ≤ (∑ i, p i * x i) ∧
    (∑ i, p i * x i) ≤ (∑ i, p i * u i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact (nonneg_mul_bounds (hp i) (hl i) (hu i)).1
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact (nonneg_mul_bounds (hp i) (hl i) (hu i)).2

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.split_sign_bounds
statement:
theorem split_sign_bounds
    {n : Nat} (pos neg l u x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ pos i)
    (hneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ neg i)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≤ x i)
    (hu : ∀ i, x i ≤ u i) :
    let w
proof:
:= fun i => pos i - neg i
    let y := ∑ i, w i * x i
    (∑ i, pos i * l i) - (∑ i, neg i * u i) ≤ y ∧
    y ≤ (∑ i, pos i * u i) - (∑ i, neg i * l i) := by
  
  have h_expand : (∑ i, (pos i - neg i) * x i) =
      (∑ i, pos i * x i) - (∑ i, neg i * x i) := by
    simp only [sub_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only at h_expand ⊢
  rw [h_expand]

  
  have hpos_bounds := dotProduct_bounds_nonneg pos l u x hpos hl hu
  have hneg_bounds := dotProduct_bounds_nonneg neg l u x hneg hl hu

  constructor
  · 
    
    linarith [hpos_bounds.1, hneg_bounds.2]
  · 
    
    linarith [hpos_bounds.2, hneg_bounds.1]

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.relu_preserves_bounds
statement:
theorem relu_preserves_bounds {lo x hi : ℝ} (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) :
    max 0 lo ≤ max 0 x ∧ max 0 x ≤ max 0 hi
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact max_le_max_left 0 hlo
  · exact max_le_max_left 0 hhi

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_max_le
statement:
theorem intVal_max_le {a b : Int} (h : a ≤ b) (e : Int) :
    intVal (max 0 a) e ≤ intVal (max 0 b) e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
  · exact Int.cast_le.mpr (max_le_max_left 0 h)
  · exact zpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) e

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_mono
statement: theorem intVal_mono {a b : Int} (h : a ≤ b) (e : Int) : intVal a e ≤ intVal b e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
  · exact Int.cast_le.mpr h
  · exact zpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) e

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.intVal_strictMono
statement: theorem intVal_strictMono {a b : Int} (h : a < b) (e : Int) : intVal a e < intVal b e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intVal]
  apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
  · exact Int.cast_lt.mpr h
  · exact zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) e

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.forwardQuantized_sound
statement:
theorem forwardQuantized_sound
    (l_quant : QuantizedLayer)
    (input : AlignedInput)
    
    (h_lo_dim : input.lo.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_hi_dim : input.hi.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wpos_dim : l_quant.weightsPos.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wneg_dim : l_quant.weightsNeg.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_bias_dim : l_quant.bias.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wpos_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsPos[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wneg_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsNeg[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    
    (h_pos_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsPos[r]!)[c]!)
    (h_neg_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsNeg[r]!)[c]!)
    
    (h_bounds_valid : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → input.lo[k]! ≤ input.hi[k]!)
    
    (h_aligned : input.exp = l_quant.commonExp) :
    
    ∀ idx (_hidx : idx < l_quant.outDim),
      (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).lo[idx]! ≤ (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).hi[idx]!
proof:
:= by

  intro idx hidx
  simp only [forwardQuantized]

  
  have h_shift_zero : input.exp - l_quant.commonExp = 0 := by omega
  simp only [h_shift_zero]

  
  have h_shift_0 : ∀ v : Int, shiftInt v 0 = v := by
    intro v
    simp only [shiftInt]
    split_ifs <;> simp

  
  have h_l_eq : input.lo.map (shiftInt · 0) = input.lo := by
    ext k
    · simp only [Array.size_map]
    · simp only [Array.getElem_map, h_shift_0]
  have h_u_eq : input.hi.map (shiftInt · 0) = input.hi := by
    ext k
    · simp only [Array.size_map]
    · simp only [Array.getElem_map, h_shift_0]

  simp only [h_l_eq, h_u_eq]

  
  
  

  
  let wpos := l_quant.weightsPos
  let wneg := l_quant.weightsNeg
  let lo := input.lo
  let hi := input.hi
  let bias := l_quant.bias

  
  have h_wpos_size : idx < wpos.size := h_wpos_dim ▸ hidx
  have h_wneg_size : idx < wneg.size := h_wneg_dim ▸ hidx
  have h_bias_size : idx < bias.size := h_bias_dim ▸ hidx
  
  

  have h_matmul_wpos_lo : idx < (matVecMulInt wpos lo).size := by simp [matVecMulInt, h_wpos_size]
  have h_matmul_wneg_hi : idx < (matVecMulInt wneg hi).size := by simp [matVecMulInt, h_wneg_size]
  have h_matmul_wpos_hi : idx < (matVecMulInt wpos hi).size := by simp [matVecMulInt, h_wpos_size]
  have h_matmul_wneg_lo : idx < (matVecMulInt wneg lo).size := by simp [matVecMulInt, h_wneg_size]

  have h_sub_lo : idx < (subIntArrays (matVecMulInt wpos lo) (matVecMulInt wneg hi)).size := by
    simp [subIntArrays, h_matmul_wpos_lo, h_matmul_wneg_hi]
  have h_sub_hi : idx < (subIntArrays (matVecMulInt wpos hi) (matVecMulInt wneg lo)).size := by
    simp [subIntArrays, h_matmul_wpos_hi, h_matmul_wneg_lo]

  have h_add_lo : idx < (addIntArrays (subIntArrays (matVecMulInt wpos lo) (matVecMulInt wneg hi)) bias).size := by
    simp [addIntArrays, h_sub_lo, h_bias_size]
  have h_add_hi : idx < (addIntArrays (subIntArrays (matVecMulInt wpos hi) (matVecMulInt wneg lo)) bias).size := by
    simp [addIntArrays, h_sub_hi, h_bias_size]

  
  rw [reluInt_getElem! _ _ h_add_lo, reluInt_getElem! _ _ h_add_hi]
  rw [addIntArrays_getElem! _ _ _ h_sub_lo h_bias_size, addIntArrays_getElem! _ _ _ h_sub_hi h_bias_size]
  rw [subIntArrays_getElem! _ _ _ h_matmul_wpos_lo h_matmul_wneg_hi]
  rw [subIntArrays_getElem! _ _ _ h_matmul_wpos_hi h_matmul_wneg_lo]
  rw [matVecMulInt_getElem! _ _ _ h_wpos_size, matVecMulInt_getElem! _ _ _ h_wneg_size]
  rw [matVecMulInt_getElem! _ _ _ h_wpos_size, matVecMulInt_getElem! _ _ _ h_wneg_size]

  
  

  
  have h_wpos_idx_size : wpos[idx]!.size = l_quant.inDim := by
    rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h_wpos_size]
    exact h_wpos_cols idx hidx
  have h_wneg_idx_size : wneg[idx]!.size = l_quant.inDim := by
    rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h_wneg_size]
    exact h_wneg_cols idx hidx

  
  have h_lo_hi_size : lo.size = hi.size := by rw [h_lo_dim, h_hi_dim]

  
  have h_wpos_mono : dotProductInt wpos[idx]! lo ≤ dotProductInt wpos[idx]! hi := by
    apply dotProductInt_mono_nonneg
    · intro i hlo _
      have hi_bound : i < l_quant.inDim := by
        simp only [h_wpos_idx_size] at hlo; omega
      exact h_pos_nonneg idx i hidx hi_bound
    · intro i hlo _
      have hi_bound : i < l_quant.inDim := by
        simp only [h_wpos_idx_size] at hlo; omega
      exact h_bounds_valid i hi_bound
    · simp only [h_lo_hi_size]

  have h_wneg_mono : dotProductInt wneg[idx]! lo ≤ dotProductInt wneg[idx]! hi := by
    apply dotProductInt_mono_nonneg
    · intro i hlo _
      have hi_bound : i < l_quant.inDim := by
        simp only [h_wneg_idx_size] at hlo; omega
      exact h_neg_nonneg idx i hidx hi_bound
    · intro i hlo _
      have hi_bound : i < l_quant.inDim := by
        simp only [h_wneg_idx_size] at hlo; omega
      exact h_bounds_valid i hi_bound
    · simp only [h_lo_hi_size]

  
  
  
  have h_ineq : dotProductInt wpos[idx]! lo - dotProductInt wneg[idx]! hi ≤
                dotProductInt wpos[idx]! hi - dotProductInt wneg[idx]! lo := by omega

  
  have h_ineq_bias : dotProductInt wpos[idx]! lo - dotProductInt wneg[idx]! hi + bias[idx]! ≤
                     dotProductInt wpos[idx]! hi - dotProductInt wneg[idx]! lo + bias[idx]! := by omega

  
  exact max_le_max_left 0 h_ineq_bias

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.forwardQuantized_nonempty
statement:
theorem forwardQuantized_nonempty
    (l_quant : QuantizedLayer)
    (input : AlignedInput)
    (x : List ℝ)
    
    (_h_input_dim : x.length = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_lo_dim : input.lo.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_hi_dim : input.hi.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wpos_dim : l_quant.weightsPos.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wneg_dim : l_quant.weightsNeg.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_bias_dim : l_quant.bias.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wpos_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsPos[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wneg_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsNeg[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    
    (h_pos_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsPos[r]!)[c]!)
    (h_neg_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsNeg[r]!)[c]!)
    
    (h_aligned : input.exp = l_quant.commonExp)
    (hx_lo : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → intVal input.lo[k]! input.exp ≤ x[k]!)
    (hx_hi : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → x[k]! ≤ intVal input.hi[k]! input.exp) :
    
    ∀ i (_hi : i < l_quant.outDim),
      intVal (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).lo[i]! (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).exp ≤
      intVal (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).hi[i]! (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).exp
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  
  have h_bounds_valid : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → input.lo[k]! ≤ input.hi[k]! := by
    intro k hk
    have hlo := hx_lo k hk
    have hhi := hx_hi k hk
    by_contra! h_neg
    have h_strict := intVal_strictMono h_neg input.exp
    linarith
  have h_lo_le_hi := forwardQuantized_sound l_quant input h_lo_dim h_hi_dim h_wpos_dim h_wneg_dim
    h_bias_dim h_wpos_cols h_wneg_cols h_pos_nonneg h_neg_nonneg h_bounds_valid h_aligned i hi
  exact intVal_mono h_lo_le_hi _

name: LeanCert.ML.Softmax.mem_foldl_add
statement:
theorem mem_foldl_add {xs_real : List ℝ} {xs_interval : List IntervalDyadic}
    {acc_real : ℝ} {acc_interval : IntervalDyadic}
    (_hlen : xs_real.length = xs_interval.length)
    (hacc : acc_real ∈ acc_interval)
    (_hmem : ∀ i (hi : i < xs_real.length),
      xs_real[i] ∈ xs_interval[i]'(_hlen ▸ hi)) :
    xs_real.foldl (· + ·) acc_real ∈
    xs_interval.foldl IntervalDyadic.add acc_interval
proof:
:= by
  
  
  induction xs_real generalizing xs_interval acc_real acc_interval with
  | nil =>
    cases xs_interval with
    | nil => simp only [List.foldl_nil]; exact hacc
    | cons _ _ => simp at _hlen
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases xs_interval with
    | nil => simp at _hlen
    | cons I Is =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at _hlen
      
      have hacc' : acc_real + x ∈ IntervalDyadic.add acc_interval I :=
        IntervalDyadic.mem_add hacc (_hmem 0 (by simp))
      
      have hmem' : ∀ i (hi : i < xs.length), xs[i] ∈ Is[i]'(_hlen ▸ hi) := fun i hi =>
        _hmem (i + 1) (by simp; omega)
      exact ih _hlen hacc' hmem'

name: LeanCert.ML.Softmax.softmax_algebraic_identity
statement:
theorem softmax_algebraic_identity (x : List ℝ) (k : Nat) (hk : k < x.length)
    (hsum : (x.map Real.exp).sum ≠ 0) :
    Real.softmax x k = 1 / ((x.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - x[k]!))).sum)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Real.softmax
  
  have hexp_pos : Real.exp (x[k]!) > 0 := Real.exp_pos _
  have hexp_ne : Real.exp (x[k]!) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hexp_pos
  
  have hsum_shift_pos : (x.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - x[k]!))).sum > 0 := by
    apply List.sum_pos
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨xj, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
      exact Real.exp_pos _
    · intro hempty
      have hnil := List.map_eq_nil_iff.mp hempty
      simp [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr hnil] at hk
  have hsum_shift_ne : (x.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - x[k]!))).sum ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt hsum_shift_pos
  
  
  have key : (x.map Real.exp).sum / Real.exp (x[k]!) =
             (x.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - x[k]!))).sum := by
    rw [div_eq_iff hexp_ne]
    rw [← List.sum_map_mul_right]
    congr 1
    simp_rw [Real.exp_sub, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hexp_ne]
  calc Real.exp x[k]! / (x.map Real.exp).sum
      = 1 / ((x.map Real.exp).sum / Real.exp x[k]!) := by field_simp
    _ = 1 / (x.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - x[k]!))).sum := by rw [key]

name: LeanCert.ML.Softmax.mem_softmax
statement:
theorem mem_softmax {v : List ℝ} {I : IntervalVector}
    (hdim : v.length = I.length)
    (hmem : ∀ i (hi : i < I.length), v[i]'(hdim ▸ hi) ∈ I[i]'hi)
    (prec : Int) (_hprec : prec ≤ 0) :
    ∀ k (hk : k < I.length),
      Real.softmax v k ∈ (softmax I prec)[k]'(by simp [softmax]; exact hk)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  simp only [softmax, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range]

  
  have hsum : (v.map Real.exp).sum ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    apply List.sum_pos
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
      exact Real.exp_pos _
    · intro h
      have hnil := List.map_eq_nil_iff.mp h
      have hlen : v.length = 0 := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr hnil
      rw [hlen] at hdim
      exact Nat.not_lt_zero k (hdim ▸ hk)
  rw [softmax_algebraic_identity v k (hdim ▸ hk) hsum]

  
  
  unfold softmaxComponent
  simp only [hk, ↓reduceDIte]

  
  let I_k := I[k]'hk
  let diffs := I.map (fun I_j => IntervalDyadic.sub I_j I_k)
  let exps := expVector diffs prec
  let zeroInterval := IntervalDyadic.singleton (Core.Dyadic.ofInt 0)
  let sum_exps := exps.foldl (fun acc I => IntervalDyadic.add acc I) zeroInterval

  
  have h_diff : ∀ j (hj : j < I.length),
      v[j]'(hdim ▸ hj) - v[k]'(hdim ▸ hk) ∈ diffs[j]'(by simp [diffs]; exact hj) := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [diffs, List.getElem_map]
    exact IntervalDyadic.mem_sub (hmem j hj) (hmem k hk)

  
  have h_exp : ∀ j (hj : j < I.length),
      Real.exp (v[j]'(hdim ▸ hj) - v[k]'(hdim ▸ hk)) ∈
        exps[j]'(by simp only [exps, expVector, diffs, List.length_map]; exact hj) := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [exps, expVector, diffs, List.getElem_map]
    
    have hdiff_mem : v[j]'(hdim ▸ hj) - v[k]'(hdim ▸ hk) ∈ IntervalDyadic.sub (I[j]'hj) I_k :=
      IntervalDyadic.mem_sub (hmem j hj) (hmem k hk)
    
    have hdiff_rat : v[j]'(hdim ▸ hj) - v[k]'(hdim ▸ hk) ∈ (IntervalDyadic.sub (I[j]'hj) I_k).toIntervalRat :=
      IntervalDyadic.mem_toIntervalRat.mpr hdiff_mem
    have hexp_rat := IntervalRat.mem_expComputable hdiff_rat 10
    exact IntervalDyadic.mem_ofIntervalRat hexp_rat prec _hprec

  
  have h_sum : (v.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - v[k]!))).sum ∈ sum_exps := by
    
    have hk_bound : k < v.length := hdim ▸ hk
    have hgetelem_eq : v[k]! = v[k]'hk_bound := getElem!_pos v k hk_bound
    
    simp only [hgetelem_eq]
    
    
    have hlen_eq : (v.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - v[k]))).length = exps.length := by
      simp [exps, expVector, diffs, hdim]
    
    have h_zero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ zeroInterval := by
      simp only [zeroInterval, IntervalDyadic.mem_def, Core.Dyadic.toRat_ofInt,
                 IntervalDyadic.singleton]
      constructor <;> norm_num
    
    
    rw [List.sum_eq_foldl]
    apply mem_foldl_add hlen_eq h_zero
    intro i hi
    
    have hi' : i < I.length := by
      simp only [List.length_map] at hi
      omega
    simp only [List.getElem_map]
    exact h_exp i hi'

  
  
  have h_sum_pos : (v.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - v[k]!))).sum > 0 := by
    apply List.sum_pos
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨xj, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
      exact Real.exp_pos _
    · intro hempty
      have hnil := List.map_eq_nil_iff.mp hempty
      simp [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr hnil] at hdim
      exact Nat.not_lt_zero k (hdim ▸ hk)

  
  
  split
  · 
    rename_i h_pos
    
    have h_sum_rat : (v.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - v[k]!))).sum ∈ sum_exps.toIntervalRat :=
      IntervalDyadic.mem_toIntervalRat.mpr h_sum
    have h_sum_ne : (v.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - v[k]!))).sum ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_sum_pos
    
    let sum_nz : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero :=
      ⟨sum_exps.toIntervalRat, fun hcz => not_lt.mpr hcz.1 h_pos⟩
    have h_inv := IntervalRat.mem_invNonzero (I := sum_nz) h_sum_rat h_sum_ne
    
    rw [one_div]
    exact IntervalDyadic.mem_ofIntervalRat h_inv prec _hprec
  · 
    
    
    
    simp only [IntervalDyadic.mem_def, Dyadic.toRat_ofInt]
    constructor
    · 
      norm_cast
      exact le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr h_sum_pos)
    · 
      norm_cast
      rw [div_le_one h_sum_pos]
      
      
      have hk_bound : k < v.length := hdim ▸ hk
      have hgetelem_eq : v[k]! = v[k]'hk_bound := getElem!_pos v k hk_bound
      
      have h_one_in_sum : Real.exp (v[k]'hk_bound - v[k]'hk_bound) ≤
          (v.map (fun xj => Real.exp (xj - v[k]!))).sum := by
        simp only [sub_self, Real.exp_zero, hgetelem_eq]
        apply List.single_le_sum
        · intro y hy
          obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
          exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
        · apply List.mem_map.mpr
          exact ⟨v[k]'hk_bound, List.getElem_mem hk_bound, by simp⟩
      simp only [sub_self, Real.exp_zero] at h_one_in_sum
      exact h_one_in_sum

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.crossingUpperBound_eval
statement:
theorem crossingUpperBound_eval (l u : ℚ) (x : ℝ) (h_ne : u - l ≠ 0) :
    (crossingUpperBound l u).eval x = (u : ℝ) / ((u : ℝ) - l) * (x - l)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [crossingUpperBound, LinearBound.eval]
  have h_ne' : (u : ℝ) - l ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h_ne
  push_cast
  rw [mul_sub_left_distrib]
  field_simp
  ring_nf

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.upper_bound_valid
statement:
theorem upper_bound_valid (l u : ℚ) (x : ℝ)
    (hl : l < 0) (hu : 0 < u) (hx_mem : (l : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ u) :
    max 0 x ≤ (crossingUpperBound l u).eval x
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_diff_pos : (0 : ℚ) < u - l := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hl hu)
  have h_diff_ne : u - l ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_diff_pos
  have h_diff_pos' : (0 : ℝ) < (u : ℝ) - l := by exact_mod_cast h_diff_pos
  have h_slope_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (u : ℝ) / ((u : ℝ) - l) := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hu) h_diff_pos'

  rw [crossingUpperBound_eval l u x h_diff_ne]

  
  rcases le_or_gt x 0 with hx_neg | hx_pos

  · 
    rw [max_eq_left hx_neg]
    
    
    apply mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h_slope_pos)
    linarith [hx_mem.1]

  · 
    rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt hx_pos)]
    
    
    
    
    
    
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ h_diff_pos']
    have hl' : (l : ℝ) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hl
    have hu' : (0 : ℝ) < u := by exact_mod_cast hu
    
    have key : x * ((u : ℝ) - l) - (u : ℝ) * (x - l) = (l : ℝ) * ((u : ℝ) - x) := by ring
    have h_factor_nonpos : (l : ℝ) * ((u : ℝ) - x) ≤ 0 := by
      apply mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hl')
      linarith [hx_mem.2]
    linarith

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.lower_bound_crossing
statement: theorem lower_bound_crossing (x : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max 0 x
proof:
:=
  le_max_left 0 x

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.relu_relaxation_sound
statement:
theorem relu_relaxation_sound (l u : ℚ) (x : ℝ) (h : (l : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ u) :
    let sb
proof:
:= getReLURelaxation l u
    sb.lower.eval x ≤ max 0 x ∧ max 0 x ≤ sb.upper.eval x := by
  unfold getReLURelaxation
  split_ifs with h_active h_inactive

  · 
    
    simp only [LinearBound.eval]
    have hx_nonneg : 0 ≤ x := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h_active) h.1
    rw [max_eq_right hx_nonneg]
    simp

  · 
    
    simp only [LinearBound.eval]
    have hx_nonpos : x ≤ 0 := le_trans h.2 (by exact_mod_cast h_inactive)
    rw [max_eq_left hx_nonpos]
    simp

  · 
    push Not at h_active h_inactive
    simp only
    constructor
    · 
      simp only [LinearBound.eval]
      have : ((0 : ℚ) : ℝ) * x + ((0 : ℚ) : ℝ) = (0 : ℝ) := by simp
      rw [this]
      exact lower_bound_crossing x
    · 
      exact upper_bound_valid l u x h_active h_inactive h

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.crossingUpperBound_at_u
statement:
theorem crossingUpperBound_at_u (l u : ℚ) (hl : l < 0) (hu : 0 < u) :
    (crossingUpperBound l u).eval (u : ℝ) = u
proof:
:= by
  have h_diff_ne : u - l ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hl hu))
  rw [crossingUpperBound_eval l u u h_diff_ne]
  have h_diff_ne' : (u : ℝ) - l ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h_diff_ne
  field_simp

statement:
theorem crossingUpperBound_at_l (l u : ℚ) (hl : l < 0) (hu : 0 < u) :

proof:
:= by
  have h_diff_ne : u - l ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hl hu))
  rw [crossingUpperBound_eval l u l h_diff_ne]
  simp

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_pos

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_mem_Ioo
statement: theorem sigmoid_mem_Ioo (x : ℝ) : sigmoid x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨sigmoid_pos x, sigmoid_lt_one x⟩

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_nonneg
statement: theorem sigmoid_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ sigmoid x
proof: := le_of_lt (sigmoid_pos x)

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_le_one
statement: theorem sigmoid_le_one (x : ℝ) : sigmoid x ≤ 1
proof: := le_of_lt (sigmoid_lt_one x)

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_zero
statement: theorem sigmoid_zero : sigmoid 0 = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmoid
  simp only [neg_zero, exp_zero]
  norm_num

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.one_sub_sigmoid
statement: theorem one_sub_sigmoid (x : ℝ) : 1 - sigmoid x = sigmoid (-x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmoid
  have h1 : 1 + exp (-x) ≠ 0 := by linarith [exp_pos (-x)]
  have h2 : 1 + exp x ≠ 0 := by linarith [exp_pos x]
  have hexp : exp (-x) * exp x = 1 := by rw [← exp_add]; simp
  field_simp
  linarith [hexp]

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_denom_pos
statement: theorem sigmoid_denom_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < 1 + exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  linarith [exp_pos (-x)]

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_strictMono
statement: theorem sigmoid_strictMono : StrictMono sigmoid
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold sigmoid
  have ha : 0 < 1 + exp (-a) := sigmoid_denom_pos a
  have hb : 0 < 1 + exp (-b) := sigmoid_denom_pos b
  rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ ha hb]
  simp only [one_mul]
  
  
  
  have h : -b < -a := neg_lt_neg hab
  linarith [exp_strictMono h]

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_mono
statement: theorem sigmoid_mono : Monotone sigmoid
proof: := sigmoid_strictMono.monotone

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_le_of_le
statement: theorem sigmoid_le_of_le {a b : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) : sigmoid a ≤ sigmoid b
proof:
:=
  sigmoid_mono h

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_lower_bound_valid
statement:
theorem sigmoid_lower_bound_valid (l u x : ℝ) (h : l ≤ x ∧ x ≤ u) :
    sigmoid l ≤ sigmoid x
proof:
:=
  sigmoid_le_of_le h.1

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_upper_bound_valid
statement:
theorem sigmoid_upper_bound_valid (l u x : ℝ) (h : l ≤ x ∧ x ≤ u) :
    sigmoid x ≤ sigmoid u
proof:
:=
  sigmoid_le_of_le h.2

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_relaxation_sound
statement:
theorem sigmoid_relaxation_sound (l u x : ℝ) (h : l ≤ x ∧ x ≤ u) :
    let sb
proof:
:= getSigmoidRelaxation l u
    sb.lower.eval x ≤ sigmoid x ∧ sigmoid x ≤ sb.upper.eval x := by
  simp only [getSigmoidRelaxation, RealLinearBound.eval, zero_mul, zero_add]
  exact ⟨sigmoid_lower_bound_valid l u x h, sigmoid_upper_bound_valid l u x h⟩

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoidSecant_at_l
statement: theorem sigmoidSecant_at_l (l u : ℝ) : sigmoidSecantEval l u l = sigmoid l
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmoidSecantEval
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoidSecant_at_u
statement:
theorem sigmoidSecant_at_u (l u : ℝ) (h : l < u) :
    sigmoidSecantEval l u u = sigmoid u
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmoidSecantEval
  simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
  have hne : u - l ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt h)
  field_simp
  ring

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_deriv
statement:
theorem sigmoid_deriv (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt sigmoid (sigmoid x * (1 - sigmoid x)) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmoid
  have h_denom_pos : 0 < 1 + exp (-x) := sigmoid_denom_pos x
  have h_denom_ne : 1 + exp (-x) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_denom_pos
  
  have hexp_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun y => exp (-y)) (-exp (-x)) x := by
    have h1 := Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-x)
    have h2 := hasDerivAt_neg x
    have hcomp := HasDerivAt.comp x h1 h2
    convert! hcomp using 1
    ring
  have hdenom_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 + exp (-y)) (-exp (-x)) x := by
    have hconst : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) 0 x := hasDerivAt_const x 1
    convert! hconst.add hexp_deriv using 1
    ring
  have hmain : HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 / (1 + exp (-y)))
      (exp (-x) / (1 + exp (-x))^2) x := by
    have h := hdenom_deriv.inv h_denom_ne
    simp only [one_div] at h ⊢
    convert! h using 1
    ring
  convert! hmain using 1
  
  have h1 : 1 / (1 + exp (-x)) * (1 - 1 / (1 + exp (-x))) =
      exp (-x) / (1 + exp (-x))^2 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  linarith [h1]

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_deriv_pos
statement: theorem sigmoid_deriv_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < sigmoid x * (1 - sigmoid x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := sigmoid_pos x
  have h2 := sigmoid_lt_one x
  exact mul_pos h1 (by linarith)

name: LeanCert.ML.Symbolic.sigmoid_deriv_max
statement: theorem sigmoid_deriv_max : sigmoid 0 * (1 - sigmoid 0) = 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmoid_zero]
  norm_num

name: LeanCert.ML.Transformer.sqrt_two_div_pi_mem_interval
statement:
theorem sqrt_two_div_pi_mem_interval :
    Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) ∈
      (⟨gelu_c1_lo, gelu_c1_lo + 1/1000000, by norm_num⟩ : IntervalRat)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IntervalRat.mem_def]
  simp only [gelu_c1_lo]
  have hpi_lo : (3.141592 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_d6
  have hpi_hi : Real.pi < (3.141593 : ℝ) := Real.pi_lt_d6
  have hpi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  constructor
  · 
    
    rw [Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
    
    
    
    have h_div_bound : (2 : ℝ) / 3.141593 < 2 / Real.pi :=
      div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by norm_num) hpi_pos hpi_hi
    have h_sq_bound : ((797884 / 1000000 : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 < (2 : ℝ) / 3.141593 := by norm_num
    linarith
  · 
    have hsum : ((797884 / 1000000 : ℚ) + 1 / 1000000) = (797885 / 1000000 : ℚ) := by norm_num
    rw [hsum, Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)]
    
    
    
    have h_div_bound : (2 : ℝ) / Real.pi < 2 / 3.141592 :=
      div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hpi_lo
    have h_sq_bound : (2 : ℝ) / 3.141592 < ((797885 / 1000000 : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by norm_num
    linarith

name: LeanCert.ML.Transformer.mem_geluIntervalRat
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Real.gelu, geluIntervalRat, gelu_c1_lo, gelu_c2]
  
  have hc2_eq : (0.044715 : ℝ) = ((44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have h_half_eq : (0.5 : ℝ) = ((1 / 2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have h_xxx : x * x * x = x ^ 3 := by ring
  have h_one : (1 : ℝ) = ((1 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
  
  have h_x3 : x ^ 3 ∈ IntervalRat.pow I 3 := IntervalRat.mem_pow hx 3
  
  have h_c2_x3 : (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3 ∈ IntervalRat.scale (44715/1000000) (IntervalRat.pow I 3) :=
    IntervalRat.mem_scale (44715/1000000) h_x3
  
  have h_inner : x + (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3 ∈
      IntervalRat.add I (IntervalRat.scale (44715/1000000) (IntervalRat.pow I 3)) :=
    IntervalRat.mem_add hx h_c2_x3
  
  have h_c1_mem : Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) ∈
      (⟨797884 / 1000000, 797884 / 1000000 + 1/1000000, by norm_num⟩ : IntervalRat) :=
    sqrt_two_div_pi_mem_interval
  
  have h_arg : Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3) ∈
      IntervalRat.mul ⟨797884/1000000, 797884/1000000 + 1/1000000, by norm_num⟩
        (IntervalRat.add I (IntervalRat.scale (44715/1000000) (IntervalRat.pow I 3))) :=
    IntervalRat.mem_mul h_c1_mem h_inner
  
  have h_tanh : Real.tanh (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3)) ∈
      tanhInterval (IntervalRat.mul ⟨797884/1000000, 797884/1000000 + 1/1000000, by norm_num⟩
        (IntervalRat.add I (IntervalRat.scale (44715/1000000) (IntervalRat.pow I 3)))) :=
    mem_tanhInterval h_arg
  
  have h_one_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ IntervalRat.singleton 1 := by
    rw [h_one]; exact IntervalRat.mem_singleton 1
  have h_one_plus_tanh : (1 : ℝ) + Real.tanh (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3)) ∈
      IntervalRat.add (IntervalRat.singleton 1)
        (tanhInterval (IntervalRat.mul ⟨797884/1000000, 797884/1000000 + 1/1000000, by norm_num⟩
          (IntervalRat.add I (IntervalRat.scale (44715/1000000) (IntervalRat.pow I 3))))) :=
    IntervalRat.mem_add h_one_mem h_tanh
  
  have h_half_x : (1 / 2 : ℚ) * x ∈ IntervalRat.scale (1/2) I :=
    IntervalRat.mem_scale (1/2) hx
  
  have h_final : (1 / 2 : ℚ) * x *
      ((1 : ℝ) + Real.tanh (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3))) ∈
      IntervalRat.mul (IntervalRat.scale (1/2) I)
        (IntervalRat.add (IntervalRat.singleton 1)
          (tanhInterval (IntervalRat.mul ⟨797884/1000000, 797884/1000000 + 1/1000000, by norm_num⟩
            (IntervalRat.add I (IntervalRat.scale (44715/1000000) (IntervalRat.pow I 3)))))) :=
    IntervalRat.mem_mul h_half_x h_one_plus_tanh
  
  
  
  
  have h_xxx_assoc : ((44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) : ℝ) * x * x * x = ((44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) : ℝ) * x ^ 3 := by ring
  have h_goal_eq : (0.5 : ℝ) * x * (1 + Real.tanh (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x * x * x)))
      = (1 / 2 : ℚ) * x * ((1 : ℝ) + Real.tanh (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + (44715 / 1000000 : ℚ) * x ^ 3))) := by
    rw [h_half_eq, hc2_eq, h_xxx_assoc]
  rw [h_goal_eq]
  exact h_final

proof:

name: LeanCert.ML.Transformer.mem_mulRounded

theorem mem_mulRounded {x y : ℝ} {I J : IntervalDyadic} (hx : x ∈ I) (hy : y ∈ J) (prec : Int) :
